# ==============================================================================
# LLM Provider Configuration
# Supported providers:
#   - "huggingface" : Free Serverless Hugging Face Inference API with DeepSeek model
#   - "mock"        : Deterministic mock generator (offline, reproducible testing)
# ==============================================================================
PLANFORGE_LLM_PROVIDER=huggingface

# Model Name:
# Recommended DeepSeek models:
#   - "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B" (Fast, high quality reasoning & JSON)
#   - "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3"
#   - "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B"
PLANFORGE_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B

# Hugging Face Inference Endpoint Configuration
# Standard model inference endpoint:
PLANFORGE_HF_BASE_URL=https://router.huggingface.co/v1/chat/completions
# Or OpenAI-compatible router endpoint:
# PLANFORGE_HF_BASE_URL=https://router.huggingface.co/hf-inference/v1/chat/completions

# Hugging Face API Key / Token (Free user access token from huggingface.co/settings/tokens)
# PLANFORGE_HF_API_KEY=hf_your_free_huggingface_token_here

# Request Timeout in seconds (120.0s recommended for remote API)
PLANFORGE_LLM_TIMEOUT=120.0

# Sampling parameters
PLANFORGE_LLM_TEMPERATURE=0.2
PLANFORGE_LLM_MAX_TOKENS=4096

"""Execution budget for an agentic run: steps, LLM calls, tool calls and wall-clock time."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, Optional


@dataclass
class Budget:
    """Hard limits for one run. ``exhausted()`` returns a human-readable reason or ``None``."""

    max_steps: int = 25
    max_llm_calls: int = 20
    max_tool_calls: int = 40
    max_wall_seconds: float = 120.0
    steps_used: int = 0
    llm_calls_used: int = 0
    tool_calls_used: int = 0
    clock: Callable[[], float] = field(default=time.monotonic, repr=False, compare=False)
    _started: Optional[float] = field(default=None, repr=False, compare=False)

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self._started is None:
            self._started = self.clock()

    def elapsed(self) -> float:
        return 0.0 if self._started is None else max(0.0, self.clock() - self._started)

    def exhausted(self) -> Optional[str]:
        if self.steps_used >= self.max_steps:
            return f"step budget exhausted ({self.steps_used}/{self.max_steps})"
        if self.llm_calls_used >= self.max_llm_calls:
            return f"LLM-call budget exhausted ({self.llm_calls_used}/{self.max_llm_calls})"
        if self.tool_calls_used >= self.max_tool_calls:
            return f"tool-call budget exhausted ({self.tool_calls_used}/{self.max_tool_calls})"
        if self._started is not None and self.elapsed() >= self.max_wall_seconds:
            return f"time budget exhausted ({self.elapsed():.1f}s/{self.max_wall_seconds:.1f}s)"
        return None

    def remaining(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "steps": max(0, self.max_steps - self.steps_used),
            "llm_calls": max(0, self.max_llm_calls - self.llm_calls_used),
            "tool_calls": max(0, self.max_tool_calls - self.tool_calls_used),
            "seconds": round(max(0.0, self.max_wall_seconds - self.elapsed()), 1),
        }

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "max_steps": self.max_steps,
            "max_llm_calls": self.max_llm_calls,
            "max_tool_calls": self.max_tool_calls,
            "max_wall_seconds": self.max_wall_seconds,
            "steps_used": self.steps_used,
            "llm_calls_used": self.llm_calls_used,
            "tool_calls_used": self.tool_calls_used,
            "elapsed_seconds": round(self.elapsed(), 3),
        }

"""Candidate management and design quality evaluation for agentic refinement.

Provides authoritative candidate comparison, metric evaluation, best-valid preservation,
and regression rejection to ensure worse designs never overwrite better valid candidates.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from app.agentic.util import to_jsonable
from app.models.validation import ValidationIssue, ValidationReport
from app.utils.ids import generate_id

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class CandidateEvaluation:
    """Structured quality assessment of a design candidate."""

    candidate_id: str
    is_valid: bool
    overall_score: float
    hard_error_count: int
    warning_count: int
    defect_categories: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metric_breakdown: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    comparison_with_predecessor: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    acceptance_decision: str = "pending"  # "accepted_best" | "accepted_progress" | "rejected_regression" | "rejected_invalid"
    decision_reason: str = ""
    evidence_refs: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def validation_score(self) -> float:
        return self.overall_score

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return to_jsonable(self.__dict__)


@dataclass
class CandidateRecord:
    """Immutable snapshot of an evaluated design candidate."""

    id: str
    step: int
    source_action: str
    evaluation: CandidateEvaluation
    fingerprint: str
    floor_plan_set: Any = field(repr=False)
    architectural_design_set: Any = field(repr=False, default=None)
    allocation_set: Any = field(repr=False, default=None)
    planning_spec: Any = field(repr=False, default=None)
    validation_report: Optional[ValidationReport] = field(repr=False, default=None)
    parent_candidate_id: Optional[str] = None
    status: str = "evaluated"  # "accepted_best" | "rejected" | "superseded" | "diagnostic_only"

    @property
    def candidate_id(self) -> str:
        return self.id

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "step": self.step,
            "source_action": self.source_action,
            "is_valid": self.evaluation.is_valid,
            "overall_score": self.evaluation.overall_score,
            "hard_error_count": self.evaluation.hard_error_count,
            "warning_count": self.evaluation.warning_count,
            "acceptance_decision": self.evaluation.acceptance_decision,
            "decision_reason": self.evaluation.decision_reason,
            "fingerprint": self.fingerprint,
            "parent_candidate_id": self.parent_candidate_id,
            "status": self.status,
            "defect_categories": self.evaluation.defect_categories,
        }


class DesignQualityEvaluator:
    """Authoritative evaluator comparing candidates against predecessors and best-known designs."""

    @classmethod
    def evaluate(
        cls,
        candidate_id: str,
        validation_report: Optional[ValidationReport],
        floor_plan_set: Any,
        predecessor_eval: Optional[CandidateEvaluation] = None,
        planning_spec: Any = None,
        requirements: Any = None,
    ) -> CandidateEvaluation:
        """Compute structured metrics and evaluate candidate quality."""
        if validation_report is None:
            return CandidateEvaluation(
                candidate_id=candidate_id,
                is_valid=False,
                overall_score=0.0,
                hard_error_count=999,
                warning_count=0,
                defect_categories=["missing_validation"],
                acceptance_decision="rejected_invalid",
                decision_reason="Candidate has no validation report",
            )

        is_valid = bool(validation_report.overall_valid)
        overall_score = float(validation_report.overall_score)
        hard_errors = validation_report.total_errors
        warnings = validation_report.total_warnings

        # Extract defect categories from issues
        defect_cats: List[str] = []
        for issue in validation_report.all_issues():
            cat = issue.category or issue.check or "general"
            if cat not in defect_cats:
                defect_cats.append(cat)

        # Metric breakdown
        metrics: Dict[str, float] = {
            "validation_score": round(overall_score, 1),
            "hard_errors": float(hard_errors),
            "warnings": float(warnings),
        }

        # Check room count adherence if requirements available
        if requirements and hasattr(requirements, "floors") and floor_plan_set and hasattr(floor_plan_set, "floor_plans"):
            expected_rooms = sum(
                len(getattr(f, "room_requirements", [])) for f in requirements.floors
            )
            actual_rooms = 0
            for fp in floor_plan_set.floor_plans:
                fp_rooms = getattr(fp, "rooms", [])
                if not fp_rooms and getattr(fp, "geometry", None):
                    fp_rooms = getattr(fp.geometry, "rooms", [])
                actual_rooms += len(fp_rooms)
            metrics["expected_rooms"] = float(expected_rooms)
            metrics["actual_rooms"] = float(actual_rooms)
            metrics["room_coverage_ratio"] = round(actual_rooms / max(1, expected_rooms), 3)

        # Comparison with predecessor
        comparison: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        if predecessor_eval is not None:
            score_delta = round(overall_score - predecessor_eval.overall_score, 2)
            errors_delta = hard_errors - predecessor_eval.hard_error_count
            warnings_delta = warnings - predecessor_eval.warning_count

            # Determine issues resolved and introduced
            prev_cats = set(predecessor_eval.defect_categories)
            curr_cats = set(defect_cats)
            resolved = list(prev_cats - curr_cats)
            introduced = list(curr_cats - prev_cats)

            comparison = {
                "predecessor_id": predecessor_eval.candidate_id,
                "score_delta": score_delta,
                "errors_delta": errors_delta,
                "warnings_delta": warnings_delta,
                "defects_resolved": resolved,
                "defects_introduced": introduced,
            }

        evidence = [f"score={overall_score:.1f}", f"hard_errors={hard_errors}"]
        if defect_cats:
            evidence.append(f"defects={','.join(defect_cats[:3])}")

        return CandidateEvaluation(
            candidate_id=candidate_id,
            is_valid=is_valid,
            overall_score=overall_score,
            hard_error_count=hard_errors,
            warning_count=warnings,
            defect_categories=defect_cats,
            metric_breakdown=metrics,
            comparison_with_predecessor=comparison,
            evidence_refs=evidence,
        )

    @classmethod
    def should_accept_as_best(
        cls,
        new_eval: CandidateEvaluation,
        current_best: Optional[CandidateEvaluation],
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Determine whether new_eval qualifies to replace current_best.

        Strict Rules:
        1. A valid design ALWAYS beats an invalid design.
        2. An invalid design can NEVER overwrite a valid design.
        3. If both valid: new must not have more hard errors (0) and must have higher/equal score.
        4. If both invalid: new must have fewer hard errors or strictly better diagnostic score.
        5. A design that introduces new hard errors is ALWAYS rejected as a regression.
        """
        if current_best is None:
            reason = "Initial baseline candidate established" if new_eval.is_valid else "Initial diagnostic baseline candidate"
            return True, reason

        # Rule 1 & 2: Validity takes absolute precedence
        if new_eval.is_valid and not current_best.is_valid:
            return True, "Valid candidate achieved; replacing invalid predecessor"

        if not new_eval.is_valid and current_best.is_valid:
            return False, f"Regression rejected: Candidate has {new_eval.hard_error_count} hard error(s); cannot replace valid best"

        # Rule 3: Both valid
        if new_eval.is_valid and current_best.is_valid:
            if new_eval.overall_score > current_best.overall_score:
                return True, f"Score improved from {current_best.overall_score:.1f} to {new_eval.overall_score:.1f}"
            if new_eval.overall_score == current_best.overall_score and new_eval.warning_count < current_best.warning_count:
                return True, f"Soft warnings reduced from {current_best.warning_count} to {new_eval.warning_count}"
            return False, f"No quality improvement over best valid score ({current_best.overall_score:.1f})"

        # Rule 4 & 5: Both invalid (diagnostic comparison)
        if new_eval.hard_error_count < current_best.hard_error_count:
            return True, f"Hard errors reduced from {current_best.hard_error_count} to {new_eval.hard_error_count}"

        if new_eval.hard_error_count > current_best.hard_error_count:
            return False, f"Hard error regression: increased from {current_best.hard_error_count} to {new_eval.hard_error_count}"

        if new_eval.overall_score > current_best.overall_score:
            return True, f"Diagnostic score improved from {current_best.overall_score:.1f} to {new_eval.overall_score:.1f}"

        return False, "No diagnostic improvement over existing candidate"


class CandidateManager:
    """Tracks candidate history, evaluates candidate progressions, and preserves best valid designs."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.candidates: List[CandidateRecord] = []
        self.best_valid_candidate: Optional[CandidateRecord] = None
        self.best_diagnostic_candidate: Optional[CandidateRecord] = None

    def compute_fingerprint(self, floor_plan_set: Any) -> str:
        """Compute structural hash of floor plan geometry."""
        if not floor_plan_set or not hasattr(floor_plan_set, "floor_plans"):
            return "empty"
        data = []
        for fp in floor_plan_set.floor_plans:
            rooms = getattr(fp, "rooms", [])
            if not rooms and getattr(fp, "geometry", None):
                rooms = getattr(fp.geometry, "rooms", [])
            for r in rooms:
                poly_coords = []
                poly = getattr(r, "polygon", None)
                if poly:
                    if hasattr(poly, "exterior"):
                        poly_coords = [(round(x, 2), round(y, 2)) for x, y in poly.exterior.coords]
                    elif isinstance(poly, (list, tuple)):
                        poly_coords = [(round(p[0], 2), round(p[1], 2)) for p in poly]
                data.append({"floor": getattr(fp, "floor_number", 1), "id": getattr(r, "id", ""), "poly": poly_coords})
        raw = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True)
        return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]

    def register_candidate(
        self,
        step: int,
        source_action: str,
        floor_plan_set: Any,
        validation_report: Optional[ValidationReport],
        architectural_design_set: Any = None,
        allocation_set: Any = None,
        planning_spec: Any = None,
        requirements: Any = None,
    ) -> Tuple[CandidateRecord, bool]:
        """Evaluate, record, and check if candidate improves the best valid design.

        Returns:
            Tuple of (candidate_record, is_new_best)
        """
        cid = f"cand_{len(self.candidates) + 1}"
        fp_hash = self.compute_fingerprint(floor_plan_set)

        predecessor_eval = self.candidates[-1].evaluation if self.candidates else None
        current_best_eval = self.best_valid_candidate.evaluation if self.best_valid_candidate else (
            self.best_diagnostic_candidate.evaluation if self.best_diagnostic_candidate else None
        )

        evaluation = DesignQualityEvaluator.evaluate(
            candidate_id=cid,
            validation_report=validation_report,
            floor_plan_set=floor_plan_set,
            predecessor_eval=predecessor_eval,
            planning_spec=planning_spec,
            requirements=requirements,
        )

        is_new_best, decision_reason = DesignQualityEvaluator.should_accept_as_best(
            new_eval=evaluation,
            current_best=current_best_eval,
        )

        evaluation.decision_reason = decision_reason

        record = CandidateRecord(
            id=cid,
            step=step,
            source_action=source_action,
            evaluation=evaluation,
            fingerprint=fp_hash,
            floor_plan_set=floor_plan_set,
            architectural_design_set=architectural_design_set,
            allocation_set=allocation_set,
            planning_spec=planning_spec,
            validation_report=validation_report,
            parent_candidate_id=self.candidates[-1].id if self.candidates else None,
        )

        if evaluation.is_valid:
            if is_new_best:
                evaluation.acceptance_decision = "accepted_best"
                record.status = "accepted_best"
                if self.best_valid_candidate:
                    self.best_valid_candidate.status = "superseded"
                self.best_valid_candidate = record
            else:
                evaluation.acceptance_decision = "rejected_regression"
                record.status = "rejected"
        else:
            if is_new_best:
                evaluation.acceptance_decision = "accepted_progress"
                record.status = "diagnostic_only"
                self.best_diagnostic_candidate = record
            else:
                evaluation.acceptance_decision = "rejected_invalid"
                record.status = "rejected"

        self.candidates.append(record)
        return record, is_new_best

    def get_best_valid(self) -> Optional[CandidateRecord]:
        """Return the highest quality valid candidate, or None if no valid candidate exists."""
        return self.best_valid_candidate

    def get_best_overall(self) -> Optional[CandidateRecord]:
        """Return best valid candidate if available, else best diagnostic candidate."""
        return self.best_valid_candidate or self.best_diagnostic_candidate

    def has_valid_candidate(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if any candidate satisfies all mandatory acceptance criteria."""
        return self.best_valid_candidate is not None

    @property
    def best_record(self) -> Optional[CandidateRecord]:
        """Convenience property returning best overall candidate."""
        return self.get_best_overall()

    def all_summaries(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return public list of candidate records for reporting/observability."""
        return [c.to_dict() for c in self.candidates]

"""Phase 7: Interactive Agentic Clarification and Resumable Floor-Plan Generation.

Provides typed schemas, decision policies, grounded alternative generation,
response validation, and provenance records for interactive user clarification.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import math
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

from app.agentic.util import to_jsonable
from app.models.requirements import FloorRequirement, Requirements, RoomRequirement
from app.utils.ids import generate_id


class ClarificationCategory(str, Enum):
    """Categorization of clarification decisions."""

    PROCEED = "PROCEED"
    CLARIFY = "CLARIFY"
    OFFER_ALTERNATIVES = "OFFER_ALTERNATIVES"
    REQUEST_CONSTRAINT_REVISION = "REQUEST_CONSTRAINT_REVISION"
    TERMINATE = "TERMINATE"


class AlternativeFeasibilityType(str, Enum):
    """Truthful classification of alternative feasibility status."""

    VERIFIED_FEASIBLE = "VERIFIED_FEASIBLE"
    SUGGESTED_ALTERNATIVE = "SUGGESTED_ALTERNATIVE"
    UNVERIFIED_HYPOTHETICAL = "UNVERIFIED_HYPOTHETICAL"


class ClarificationStatus(str, Enum):
    """Status lifecycle of a clarification request."""

    PENDING = "pending"
    ANSWERED = "answered"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    EXPIRED = "expired"


@dataclass
class ClarificationOption:
    """A concrete, selectable option presented to the user during clarification."""

    option_id: str
    label: str = ""
    title: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    proposed_changes: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    numeric_changes: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    affected_rooms: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    feasibility_type: Union[AlternativeFeasibilityType, str] = AlternativeFeasibilityType.SUGGESTED_ALTERNATIVE
    is_verified_feasible: bool = False
    requires_confirmation: bool = True
    grounded_evidence: Optional[str] = None
    action_type: str = "custom"  # "expand_plot", "add_floor", "scale_rooms", "remove_optional_room", "cancel"

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.title and self.label:
            self.title = self.label
        elif not self.label and self.title:
            self.label = self.title
        if not self.numeric_changes and self.proposed_changes:
            for k, v in self.proposed_changes.items():
                if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
                    self.numeric_changes[k] = float(v)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return to_jsonable(asdict(self))


@dataclass
class ClarificationRequest:
    """A structured request for user intervention when requirements are incomplete,
    ambiguous, contradictory, or infeasible.
    """

    request_id: str
    project_id: str
    state_version: int
    category: ClarificationCategory
    issue_explanation: str = ""
    question: str = ""
    evidence: str = ""
    supporting_evidence: List[Any] = field(default_factory=list)
    is_mandatory: bool = True
    suggested_options: List[ClarificationOption] = field(default_factory=list)
    options: List[ClarificationOption] = field(default_factory=list)
    default_behavior: Optional[str] = None
    affected_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    affected_constraints: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    paused_stage: str = "requirements"
    status: ClarificationStatus = ClarificationStatus.PENDING
    questions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    measured_deficit_sqm: Optional[float] = None
    available_sqm: Optional[float] = None
    required_sqm: Optional[float] = None
    target_component: Optional[str] = None
    allow_free_text: bool = True
    allow_numeric_input: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.options and self.suggested_options:
            self.options = self.suggested_options
        elif not self.suggested_options and self.options:
            self.suggested_options = self.options
        if not self.question and self.questions:
            self.question = self.questions[0]
        elif not self.questions and self.question:
            self.questions = [self.question]
        if not self.evidence and self.issue_explanation:
            self.evidence = self.issue_explanation
        elif not self.issue_explanation and self.evidence:
            self.issue_explanation = self.evidence
        if not self.affected_constraints and self.affected_requirements:
            self.affected_constraints = self.affected_requirements
        elif not self.affected_requirements and self.affected_constraints:
            self.affected_requirements = self.affected_constraints

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = to_jsonable(asdict(self))
        d["question"] = self.question or (self.questions[0] if self.questions else self.issue_explanation)
        d["evidence"] = self.evidence or self.issue_explanation
        d["options"] = [o.to_dict() for o in (self.options or self.suggested_options)]
        return d

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> ClarificationRequest:
        raw_opts = data.get("options") or data.get("suggested_options") or []
        parsed_opts = [
            ClarificationOption(
                option_id=o.get("option_id", ""),
                title=o.get("title") or o.get("label", ""),
                label=o.get("label") or o.get("title", ""),
                description=o.get("description", ""),
                proposed_changes=o.get("proposed_changes", {}),
                numeric_changes=o.get("numeric_changes", {}),
                affected_rooms=o.get("affected_rooms", []),
                feasibility_type=o.get("feasibility_type", AlternativeFeasibilityType.SUGGESTED_ALTERNATIVE),
                is_verified_feasible=o.get("is_verified_feasible", False),
                grounded_evidence=o.get("grounded_evidence"),
                action_type=o.get("action_type", "custom"),
            )
            for o in raw_opts
        ]
        cat_str = data.get("category", "CLARIFY")
        cat = ClarificationCategory(cat_str) if cat_str in ClarificationCategory.__members__ else ClarificationCategory.CLARIFY
        return cls(
            request_id=data.get("request_id", ""),
            project_id=data.get("project_id", ""),
            state_version=int(data.get("state_version", 1)),
            category=cat,
            issue_explanation=data.get("issue_explanation", ""),
            question=data.get("question", ""),
            evidence=data.get("evidence", ""),
            is_mandatory=bool(data.get("is_mandatory", True)),
            suggested_options=parsed_opts,
            options=parsed_opts,
            default_behavior=data.get("default_behavior"),
            affected_requirements=data.get("affected_requirements", []),
            affected_constraints=data.get("affected_constraints", []),
            created_at=float(data.get("created_at", time.time())),
            paused_stage=data.get("paused_stage", "requirements"),
            status=ClarificationStatus(data.get("status", "pending")),
            questions=data.get("questions", []),
            measured_deficit_sqm=data.get("measured_deficit_sqm"),
            available_sqm=data.get("available_sqm"),
            required_sqm=data.get("required_sqm"),
            allow_free_text=bool(data.get("allow_free_text", True)),
            allow_numeric_input=bool(data.get("allow_numeric_input", False)),
        )

    def is_pending(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == ClarificationStatus.PENDING


@dataclass
class ClarificationResponse:
    """User response authorizing requirement changes or selecting an alternative."""

    request_id: str = ""
    project_id: str = ""
    response_id: str = ""
    selected_option_id: Optional[str] = None
    user_text: Optional[str] = None
    user_response_text: Optional[str] = None
    numeric_values: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    numeric_overrides: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    revised_requirements: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    validation_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    status: str = "accepted"  # "accepted", "rejected"
    resulting_state_version: Optional[int] = None
    expected_state_version: Optional[int] = None
    rejection_reason: Optional[str] = None
    timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.response_id:
            self.response_id = f"resp_{generate_id()}"
        if not self.user_text and self.user_response_text:
            self.user_text = self.user_response_text
        elif not self.user_response_text and self.user_text:
            self.user_response_text = self.user_text
        if not self.numeric_values and self.numeric_overrides:
            self.numeric_values = dict(self.numeric_overrides)
        elif not self.numeric_overrides and self.numeric_values:
            self.numeric_overrides = dict(self.numeric_values)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return to_jsonable(asdict(self))

# ============================================================================
# Clarification Decision Class (Dual Interface: Object and 2-Tuple)
# ============================================================================

class ClarificationDecision:
    """Decision container supporting attribute access and tuple unpacking."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        category: ClarificationCategory,
        clarification_request: Optional[ClarificationRequest] = None,
    ):
        self.category = category
        self.clarification_request = clarification_request

    @property
    def should_pause(self) -> bool:
        return self.category != ClarificationCategory.PROCEED

    def __iter__(self):
        yield self.category
        yield self.clarification_request

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        return (self.category, self.clarification_request)[index]

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"ClarificationDecision(category={self.category.value}, should_pause={self.should_pause})"


# ============================================================================
# Clarification Decision Policy & Grounded Option Generation
# ============================================================================

class ClarificationDecisionPolicy:
    """Authoritative decision policy evaluating project state, completeness,
    and feasibility to determine whether user clarification is necessary.
    """

    @classmethod
    def evaluate(
        cls,
        project_id_or_state: Any = None,
        state_version: Optional[int] = None,
        requirements: Optional[Requirements] = None,
        completeness_result: Optional[Any] = None,
        feasibility_facts: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        open_questions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        *,
        project_id: Optional[str] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> ClarificationDecision:
        """Determine next clarification action.

        Supports both:
          evaluate(state: ProjectState)
          evaluate(project_id=..., state_version=..., ...)
        """
        # 1. Adapt from ProjectState if passed
        state_obj = project_id_or_state if (project_id_or_state and hasattr(project_id_or_state, "project_id") and hasattr(project_id_or_state, "version")) else kwargs.get("state")

        if state_obj:
            project_id = project_id or state_obj.project_id
            state_version = state_version if state_version is not None else state_obj.version
            requirements = requirements or state_obj.get_artifact("requirements")
            completeness_result = completeness_result or state_obj.get_artifact("completeness_result")
            feasibility_facts = feasibility_facts or state_obj.facts.get("feasibility_facts", state_obj.facts)
            open_questions = open_questions or list(state_obj.open_questions)
        else:
            project_id = str(project_id or project_id_or_state or "proj_unknown")
            state_version = int(state_version or 1)
            feasibility_facts = feasibility_facts or {}
            open_questions = list(open_questions or [])
            feasibility_facts = feasibility_facts or {}
            open_questions = list(open_questions or [])

        req_id = f"clarif_{generate_id()}"
        questions = list(open_questions)

        # 2. Mathematical Boundary Capacity & Deficit Pre-Check
        if requirements:
            w, l = getattr(requirements, "plot_dimensions", None) or (0.0, 0.0)
            sb = getattr(requirements, "setbacks", {}) or {}
            front = float(sb.get("front", 0.0))
            rear = float(sb.get("rear", 0.0))
            left = float(sb.get("left", 0.0))
            right = float(sb.get("right", 0.0))

            # Contradictory setbacks exceeding plot boundaries
            if (l > 0 and (front + rear >= l)) or (w > 0 and (left + right >= w)):
                explanation = (
                    f"Contradictory plot setbacks: front ({front}m) + rear ({rear}m) = {front + rear}m "
                    f"exceeds or equals plot depth {l}m."
                )
                req = ClarificationRequest(
                    request_id=req_id,
                    project_id=project_id,
                    state_version=state_version,
                    category=ClarificationCategory.REQUEST_CONSTRAINT_REVISION,
                    issue_explanation=explanation,
                    question=explanation,
                    evidence=f"Plot: {w}m x {l}m; Setbacks: Front={front}m, Rear={rear}m, Left={left}m, Right={right}m",
                    is_mandatory=True,
                    affected_requirements=["setbacks", "plot_dimensions"],
                    affected_constraints=["plot_boundary"],
                    paused_stage="requirements",
                )
                return ClarificationDecision(ClarificationCategory.REQUEST_CONSTRAINT_REVISION, req)

            # Check if total rooms is zero
            if requirements.total_rooms() == 0:
                explanation = "Room requirements are incomplete: no rooms have been specified for this floor plan."
                req = ClarificationRequest(
                    request_id=req_id,
                    project_id=project_id,
                    state_version=state_version,
                    category=ClarificationCategory.CLARIFY,
                    issue_explanation=explanation,
                    question=explanation,
                    evidence="Requirements contains 0 room requirements.",
                    is_mandatory=True,
                    affected_requirements=["room_requirements"],
                    paused_stage="requirements",
                    questions=["Please specify which rooms you require (e.g. bedrooms, living, kitchen)."],
                )
                return ClarificationDecision(ClarificationCategory.CLARIFY, req)

            # Calculate physical buildable footprint capacity
            bw = max(0.0, w - left - right)
            bl = max(0.0, l - front - rear)
            buildable_sqm = bw * bl
            target_floors = requirements.target_floors or (len(requirements.floors) if requirements.floors else 1)
            max_capacity = buildable_sqm * target_floors

            total_min_req_sqm = 0.0
            for fl in requirements.floors or []:
                for rm in fl.room_requirements:
                    total_min_req_sqm += float(rm.min_area_sqm or rm.preferred_area_sqm or rm.target_area_sqm or 0.0)

            if buildable_sqm > 0 and total_min_req_sqm > max_capacity:
                deficit = total_min_req_sqm - max_capacity
                feasibility_facts = {
                    "feasible": False,
                    "deficits": [
                        {
                            "floor": 1,
                            "deficit_sqm": round(deficit, 2),
                            "available_sqm": round(max_capacity, 2),
                            "required_sqm": round(total_min_req_sqm, 2),
                        }
                    ],
                    "buildable_area_sqm": round(max_capacity, 2),
                }

        # 3. Check Infeasibility & Physical Deficits (Category: REQUEST_CONSTRAINT_REVISION)
        if feasibility_facts.get("feasible") is False or feasibility_facts.get("deficits"):
            deficits = feasibility_facts.get("deficits", [])
            total_deficit = sum(float(d.get("deficit_sqm", 0.0)) for d in deficits) if deficits else 0.0
            available_buildable = float(feasibility_facts.get("buildable_area_sqm", 0.0))
            required_sqm = None
            if deficits:
                available_buildable = float(deficits[0].get("available_sqm", available_buildable))
                required_sqm = float(deficits[0].get("required_sqm", available_buildable + total_deficit))

            options = cls._generate_grounded_infeasibility_options(
                requirements=requirements,
                deficit_sqm=total_deficit,
                available_sqm=available_buildable,
                deficits=deficits,
            )

            explanation = (
                f"The requested room program is physically infeasible: Total minimum required area "
                f"exceeds available buildable footprint by {total_deficit:.1f} m². "
                f"Please choose an authorized adjustment to proceed."
            )

            req = ClarificationRequest(
                request_id=req_id,
                project_id=project_id,
                state_version=state_version,
                category=ClarificationCategory.REQUEST_CONSTRAINT_REVISION,
                issue_explanation=explanation,
                question=explanation,
                evidence=f"Measured required: {required_sqm:.1f} m²; Available buildable: {available_buildable:.1f} m²; Deficit: {total_deficit:.1f} m²",
                is_mandatory=True,
                suggested_options=options,
                options=options,
                default_behavior="Decline revision and terminate as infeasible",
                affected_requirements=["room_areas", "plot_boundary", "floor_count"],
                affected_constraints=["physical_feasibility", "plot_boundary"],
                paused_stage="feasibility_check",
                questions=[explanation],
                measured_deficit_sqm=round(total_deficit, 2),
                available_sqm=round(available_buildable, 2),
                required_sqm=round(required_sqm or (available_buildable + total_deficit), 2),
                allow_free_text=True,
                allow_numeric_input=True,
            )
            return ClarificationDecision(ClarificationCategory.REQUEST_CONSTRAINT_REVISION, req)

        # 4. Check Completeness Gate (Category: CLARIFY)
        if completeness_result and not getattr(completeness_result, "can_proceed", True):
            missing = list(getattr(completeness_result, "missing_fields", []))
            comp_questions = list(getattr(completeness_result, "clarification_questions", []))
            all_questions = list(set(questions + comp_questions))

            options = cls._generate_completeness_options(missing, requirements)
            explanation = f"Essential architectural requirements are missing: {', '.join(missing)}."

            req = ClarificationRequest(
                request_id=req_id,
                project_id=project_id,
                state_version=state_version,
                category=ClarificationCategory.CLARIFY,
                issue_explanation=explanation,
                question=all_questions[0] if all_questions else explanation,
                evidence=f"Completeness check reported missing: {', '.join(missing)}",
                is_mandatory=True,
                suggested_options=options,
                options=options,
                default_behavior="Apply standard residential defaults where permitted",
                affected_requirements=missing,
                affected_constraints=missing,
                paused_stage="requirements",
                questions=all_questions or [explanation],
            )
            return ClarificationDecision(ClarificationCategory.CLARIFY, req)

        # 5. Check for Open Questions (Category: CLARIFY)
        if questions:
            req = ClarificationRequest(
                request_id=req_id,
                project_id=project_id,
                state_version=state_version,
                category=ClarificationCategory.CLARIFY,
                issue_explanation="Unresolved requirement questions need your clarification.",
                question=questions[0],
                evidence="Ambiguous or missing requirement specifications in user brief.",
                is_mandatory=True,
                suggested_options=[],
                options=[],
                default_behavior=None,
                affected_requirements=["requirements"],
                paused_stage="requirements",
                questions=questions,
            )
            return ClarificationDecision(ClarificationCategory.CLARIFY, req)

        # 6. Requirements are complete and feasible (Category: PROCEED)
        return ClarificationDecision(ClarificationCategory.PROCEED, None)

    @classmethod
    def _generate_grounded_infeasibility_options(
        cls,
        requirements: Optional[Requirements],
        deficit_sqm: float,
        available_sqm: float,
        deficits: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> List[ClarificationOption]:
        """Generate options mathematically grounded in the actual deficit."""
        options: List[ClarificationOption] = []

        # Option A: Expand site boundary / buildable footprint
        needed_buildable = available_sqm + deficit_sqm + 5.0
        w, current_depth = getattr(requirements, "plot_dimensions", None) or (10.0, 10.0)
        bw = max(1.0, w - 3.0)  # estimate side setbacks
        new_depth = round((needed_buildable / bw) + 4.0, 1)

        options.append(
            ClarificationOption(
                option_id="expand_plot_depth",
                label="Expand Plot Depth",
                title="Expand Plot Depth",
                description=(
                    f"Increase plot length from {current_depth:.1f}m to {new_depth:.1f}m "
                    f"to provide sufficient buildable footprint ({needed_buildable:.1f} m²)."
                ),
                proposed_changes={
                    "action": "expand_plot",
                    "plot_length": new_depth,
                    "target_buildable_sqm": needed_buildable,
                },
                numeric_changes={"plot_length": new_depth},
                feasibility_type=AlternativeFeasibilityType.SUGGESTED_ALTERNATIVE,
                is_verified_feasible=False,
                grounded_evidence=f"Calculated from deficit {deficit_sqm:.1f} m² + current {available_sqm:.1f} m²",
                action_type="expand_plot",
            )
        )

        # Option B: Distribute rooms across additional floor(s)
        current_floors = requirements.target_floors or (len(requirements.floors) if requirements and requirements.floors else 1)
        new_floors = current_floors + 1
        options.append(
            ClarificationOption(
                option_id="opt_add_floor",
                label=f"Distribute Across {new_floors} Floors",
                title=f"Distribute Across {new_floors} Floors",
                description=(
                    f"Add an upper floor to distribute rooms vertically across {new_floors} floors, "
                    f"reducing footprint pressure on Floor 1."
                ),
                proposed_changes={
                    "action": "add_floor",
                    "target_floors": new_floors,
                    "new_floor_count": new_floors,
                },
                numeric_changes={"target_floors": float(new_floors)},
                feasibility_type=AlternativeFeasibilityType.SUGGESTED_ALTERNATIVE,
                is_verified_feasible=False,
                grounded_evidence=f"Spreads {deficit_sqm:.1f} m² program across {new_floors} floors",
                action_type="add_floor",
            )
        )

        # Option C: Reduce optional rooms or scale down room target sizes
        optional_rooms: List[str] = []
        if requirements:
            for f in requirements.floors or []:
                for r in getattr(f, "room_requirements", []) or []:
                    rtype = getattr(r, "room_type", "").lower()
                    desc = getattr(r, "description", "").lower()
                    if rtype in ("study", "office", "balcony", "guest_room", "utility", "powder_room") or "optional" in desc:
                        optional_rooms.append(rtype)

        if optional_rooms:
            opt_room = optional_rooms[0]
            options.append(
                ClarificationOption(
                    option_id=f"remove_optional_{opt_room}",
                    label=f"Remove Optional {opt_room.title()}",
                    title=f"Remove Optional {opt_room.title()}",
                    description=(
                        f"Remove the {opt_room.title()} from requirements to fit the essential rooms "
                        f"within the current site boundaries."
                    ),
                    proposed_changes={
                        "action": "remove_room",
                        "room_type": opt_room,
                    },
                    affected_rooms=[opt_room],
                    feasibility_type=AlternativeFeasibilityType.UNVERIFIED_HYPOTHETICAL,
                    is_verified_feasible=False,
                    grounded_evidence=f"Identified {opt_room} as non-mandatory secondary space",
                    action_type="remove_optional_room",
                )
            )

        # Option D: Decline revision and terminate
        options.append(
            ClarificationOption(
                option_id="opt_terminate_infeasible",
                label="Decline Revision (Terminate Workflow)",
                title="Decline Revision (Terminate Workflow)",
                description="Keep current constraints unchanged and conclude workflow with truthful infeasibility status.",
                proposed_changes={"action": "terminate"},
                feasibility_type=AlternativeFeasibilityType.VERIFIED_FEASIBLE,
                is_verified_feasible=True,
                grounded_evidence="Maintains strict user constraints without fabrication",
                action_type="cancel",
            )
        )

        return options

    @classmethod
    def _generate_completeness_options(
        cls,
        missing_fields: List[str],
        requirements: Optional[Requirements],
    ) -> List[ClarificationOption]:
        """Generate options for missing fields."""
        options: List[ClarificationOption] = []
        if "plot_boundary" in missing_fields or "plot_shape" in missing_fields:
            options.append(
                ClarificationOption(
                    option_id="opt_default_rectangular_plot",
                    label="Use Standard Rectangular Plot (15m × 20m)",
                    title="Use Standard Rectangular Plot (15m × 20m)",
                    description="Adopt standard 300 m² rectangular plot with standard 1.5m setbacks.",
                    proposed_changes={
                        "action": "set_plot_shape",
                        "plot_length": 20.0,
                        "plot_width": 15.0,
                    },
                    numeric_changes={"plot_length": 20.0, "plot_width": 15.0},
                    feasibility_type=AlternativeFeasibilityType.SUGGESTED_ALTERNATIVE,
                    is_verified_feasible=True,
                    action_type="custom",
                )
            )
        return options


# ============================================================================
# Response Validation & Atomic Requirement Mutation
# ============================================================================

class ClarificationResponseValidator:
    """Strict validator for incoming user clarification responses."""

    @classmethod
    def validate_and_apply(
        cls,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str, Any, Optional[Any]]:
        """Validate response and compute updated Requirements atomically.

        Supports two call signatures:
        1. validate_and_apply(state: ProjectState, request_id: str, selected_option_id=..., ...)
        2. validate_and_apply(request: ClarificationRequest, response: ClarificationResponse, current_state_version: int, current_requirements: Optional[Requirements])
        """
        # Signature 1: called with ProjectState
        if "state" in kwargs or (len(args) > 0 and hasattr(args[0], "project_id") and hasattr(args[0], "pending_clarification")):
            state = kwargs.get("state") if "state" in kwargs else args[0]
            request_id = kwargs.get("request_id") if "request_id" in kwargs else (args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "")
            selected_option_id = kwargs.get("selected_option_id")
            user_response_text = kwargs.get("user_response_text")
            numeric_overrides = kwargs.get("numeric_overrides")
            expected_state_version = kwargs.get("expected_state_version")

            return cls._apply_to_project_state(
                state=state,
                request_id=request_id,
                selected_option_id=selected_option_id,
                user_response_text=user_response_text,
                numeric_overrides=numeric_overrides,
                expected_state_version=expected_state_version,
            )

        # Signature 2: called with (request, response, current_state_version, current_requirements)
        request = kwargs.get("request") if "request" in kwargs else args[0]
        response = kwargs.get("response") if "response" in kwargs else args[1]
        current_state_version = kwargs.get("current_state_version") if "current_state_version" in kwargs else args[2]
        current_requirements = kwargs.get("current_requirements") if "current_requirements" in kwargs else args[3]

        return cls._apply_lower_level(
            request=request,
            response=response,
            current_state_version=current_state_version,
            current_requirements=current_requirements,
        )

    @classmethod
    def _apply_to_project_state(
        cls,
        state: Any,
        request_id: str,
        selected_option_id: Optional[str] = None,
        user_response_text: Optional[str] = None,
        numeric_overrides: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None,
        expected_state_version: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[ClarificationResponse]]:
        """Validate and atomically apply changes to a ProjectState."""
        from app.agentic.state import RunStatus

        pending: Optional[ClarificationRequest] = state.pending_clarification
        if not pending:
            return False, f"No pending clarification request for project '{state.project_id}'.", None

        # Request ID check
        if pending.request_id != request_id:
            return (
                False,
                f"Clarification request ID mismatch: pending '{pending.request_id}' != submitted '{request_id}'.",
                None,
            )

        # Stale state version check
        if expected_state_version is not None and expected_state_version != state.version:
            return (
                False,
                f"Stale response rejected: expected state version {expected_state_version} but current is {state.version}.",
                None,
            )

        # Validate option if specified
        matched_option: Optional[ClarificationOption] = None
        available_options = pending.options or pending.suggested_options
        if selected_option_id:
            for opt in available_options:
                if opt.option_id == selected_option_id:
                    matched_option = opt
                    break
            if not matched_option:
                return (
                    False,
                    f"Invalid selected_option_id '{selected_option_id}'. Options: {[o.option_id for o in available_options]}",
                    None,
                )

        # Handle user termination selection
        if selected_option_id == "opt_terminate_infeasible":
            pending.status = ClarificationStatus.ANSWERED
            state.clarification_history.append(pending)
            state.pending_clarification = None
            state.status = RunStatus.INFEASIBLE
            state.status_reason = "User declined constraint revision; design confirmed infeasible under original inputs."
            clarif_resp = ClarificationResponse(
                response_id=f"resp_{generate_id()}",
                request_id=request_id,
                project_id=state.project_id,
                selected_option_id=selected_option_id,
                status="accepted",
                resulting_state_version=state.version,
            )
            return True, "User authorized termination under original infeasible constraints.", clarif_resp

        # Atomically mutate cloned requirements
        current_req = state.get_artifact("requirements")
        req_clone: Requirements = copy.deepcopy(current_req) if current_req else Requirements()

        reason_parts: List[str] = []

        if matched_option:
            reason_parts.append(f"Selected option '{matched_option.title or matched_option.label}'")
            # Apply option numeric changes
            for k, v in matched_option.numeric_changes.items():
                if k == "plot_length":
                    w = req_clone.plot_dimensions[0] if req_clone.plot_dimensions else 10.0
                    req_clone.plot_dimensions = (w, float(v))
                    reason_parts.append(f"Updated plot length to {v}m")
                elif k == "plot_width":
                    l = req_clone.plot_dimensions[1] if req_clone.plot_dimensions else 10.0
                    req_clone.plot_dimensions = (float(v), l)
                    reason_parts.append(f"Updated plot width to {v}m")
                elif k == "target_floors":
                    req_clone.target_floors = int(v)
                    reason_parts.append(f"Set target floors to {int(v)}")

            # Apply option action type
            if matched_option.action_type == "add_floor" or "target_floors" in matched_option.proposed_changes:
                new_fl_count = int(matched_option.proposed_changes.get("target_floors", req_clone.target_floors or 2))
                req_clone.target_floors = new_fl_count
                while len(req_clone.floors) < new_fl_count:
                    next_fl_num = len(req_clone.floors) + 1
                    req_clone.floors.append(
                        FloorRequirement(floor_number=next_fl_num, floor_name=f"Floor {next_fl_num}", room_requirements=[])
                    )
                reason_parts.append(f"Expanded floor program to {new_fl_count} floors")

            elif matched_option.action_type == "remove_optional_room" or matched_option.affected_rooms:
                for rm_to_rm in matched_option.affected_rooms:
                    for fl in req_clone.floors or []:
                        fl.room_requirements = [
                            r for r in fl.room_requirements
                            if r.room_type.lower() != rm_to_rm.lower()
                        ]
                    reason_parts.append(f"Removed optional room '{rm_to_rm}'")

        # Direct user numeric overrides
        if numeric_overrides:
            for k, v in numeric_overrides.items():
                if k == "plot_length":
                    w = req_clone.plot_dimensions[0] if req_clone.plot_dimensions else 10.0
                    req_clone.plot_dimensions = (w, float(v))
                    reason_parts.append(f"User overrode plot length to {v}m")
                elif k == "plot_width":
                    l = req_clone.plot_dimensions[1] if req_clone.plot_dimensions else 10.0
                    req_clone.plot_dimensions = (float(v), l)
                    reason_parts.append(f"User overrode plot width to {v}m")
                elif k == "target_floors":
                    req_clone.target_floors = int(v)
                    reason_parts.append(f"User overrode target floors to {int(v)}")

        if user_response_text:
            reason_parts.append(f"User text: {user_response_text}")

        # Update ProjectState artifacts and lifecycle
        old_version = state.version
        state.set_artifact("requirements", req_clone)
        state.status = RunStatus.RESUMABLE
        state.status_reason = "Clarification response accepted; ready to resume workflow."

        pending.status = ClarificationStatus.ANSWERED
        state.clarification_history.append(pending)
        state.pending_clarification = None

        # Downstream invalidation: wipe planning_spec, allocation_set, architectural_design_set, floor_plan_set
        state.invalidate_downstream("requirements")

        change_record = RequirementChangeRecord(
            change_id=f"change_{generate_id()}",
            timestamp=time.time(),
            request_id=request_id,
            response_id=f"resp_{generate_id()}",
            previous_state_version=old_version,
            new_state_version=state.version,
            original_requirement=to_jsonable(asdict(current_req)) if current_req else {},
            new_requirement=to_jsonable(asdict(req_clone)) if req_clone else {},
            reason="; ".join(reason_parts) or "User clarification applied.",
            provenance="user_authorized",
        )
        state.requirement_changes.append(change_record)

        clarif_resp = ClarificationResponse(
            response_id=change_record.response_id,
            request_id=request_id,
            project_id=state.project_id,
            selected_option_id=selected_option_id,
            user_text=user_response_text,
            numeric_values=numeric_overrides or {},
            status="accepted",
            resulting_state_version=state.version,
        )

        return True, "Clarification response accepted and requirements updated.", clarif_resp

    @classmethod
    def _apply_lower_level(
        cls,
        request: ClarificationRequest,
        response: ClarificationResponse,
        current_state_version: int,
        current_requirements: Optional[Requirements],
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[Requirements], Optional[RequirementChangeRecord]]:
        """Validate response and compute updated Requirements atomically (lower-level signature)."""
        exp_ver = response.expected_state_version if response.expected_state_version is not None else response.resulting_state_version
        if exp_ver is not None and exp_ver != current_state_version:
            return (
                False,
                f"Stale response rejected: Response referenced state_version {exp_ver} "
                f"but current state_version is {current_state_version}.",
                None,
                None,
            )

        if response.request_id != request.request_id:
            return (
                False,
                f"Request ID mismatch: Response referenced '{response.request_id}' "
                f"but pending request is '{request.request_id}'.",
                None,
                None,
            )

        if not request.is_pending():
            return (
                False,
                f"Clarification request '{request.request_id}' is no longer pending (status: {request.status.value}).",
                None,
                None,
            )

        selected_opt: Optional[ClarificationOption] = None
        available_options = request.options or request.suggested_options
        if response.selected_option_id:
            for opt in available_options:
                if opt.option_id == response.selected_option_id:
                    selected_opt = opt
                    break
            if not selected_opt:
                return (
                    False,
                    f"Invalid option ID '{response.selected_option_id}'. Allowed: {[o.option_id for o in available_options]}",
                    None,
                    None,
                )

        req_clone: Optional[Requirements] = copy.deepcopy(current_requirements) if current_requirements else None
        reason = f"Selected option '{selected_opt.title or selected_opt.label}'" if selected_opt else "Clarification applied."
        orig_dict = to_jsonable(asdict(current_requirements)) if current_requirements else {}

        if selected_opt and req_clone:
            for k, v in selected_opt.numeric_changes.items():
                if k == "plot_length":
                    w = req_clone.plot_dimensions[0] if req_clone.plot_dimensions else 10.0
                    req_clone.plot_dimensions = (w, float(v))
                elif k == "plot_width":
                    l = req_clone.plot_dimensions[1] if req_clone.plot_dimensions else 10.0
                    req_clone.plot_dimensions = (float(v), l)
                elif k == "target_floors":
                    req_clone.target_floors = int(v)

        if response.numeric_values and req_clone:
            for k, v in response.numeric_values.items():
                if k == "plot_length":
                    w = req_clone.plot_dimensions[0] if req_clone.plot_dimensions else 10.0
                    req_clone.plot_dimensions = (w, float(v))
                elif k == "plot_width":
                    l = req_clone.plot_dimensions[1] if req_clone.plot_dimensions else 10.0
                    req_clone.plot_dimensions = (float(v), l)
                elif k == "target_floors":
                    req_clone.target_floors = int(v)

        change_rec = RequirementChangeRecord(
            change_id=f"change_{generate_id()}",
            timestamp=time.time(),
            request_id=request.request_id,
            response_id=response.response_id,
            previous_state_version=current_state_version,
            new_state_version=current_state_version + 1,
            original_requirement=orig_dict,
            new_requirement=to_jsonable(asdict(req_clone)) if req_clone else {},
            reason=reason,
            provenance="user_authorized",
        )

        return True, "Clarification response accepted and applied.", req_clone, change_rec

"""Hybrid Hierarchical Multi-Agent Coordination for PlanForge.

Defines typed communication schemas, constraint evidence structures,
the evidence-based ConflictResolver, and specialized agent coordinators.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import enum
import logging
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from app.agentic.budget import Budget
from app.agentic.candidates import CandidateEvaluation, CandidateManager, CandidateRecord
from app.agentic.events import InMemoryEventLog
from app.agentic.state import Finding, ProjectState, RunStatus
from app.agentic.util import to_jsonable
from app.models.requirements import Requirements
from app.models.validation import ValidationIssue, ValidationReport
from app.utils.ids import generate_id

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# ============================================================================
# 1. Structured Coordination Schemas
# ============================================================================

class ConstraintPriority(enum.IntEnum):
    """5-tier priority hierarchy for evidence-based conflict resolution.

    Lower value indicates higher priority (Level 1 is supreme authority).
    """
    MANDATORY_USER = 1        # Explicit user requirements & hard statutory minimums
    PHYSICAL_FEASIBILITY = 2  # Physical site boundaries & geometric non-overlap
    VALIDATOR_FINDING = 3     # Independent FloorPlanValidator verdicts (authoritative)
    PLANNING_INTENT = 4       # Approved spatial relationships & zoning hierarchy
    SOFT_PREFERENCE = 5       # User styling preferences, aspect ratios, soft warnings


@dataclass
class ConstraintEvidence:
    """Structured evidence item supporting or challenging an agent proposal."""

    constraint_id: str
    category: str  # "mandatory_user", "physical_feasibility", "validator_finding", "planning_intent", "soft_preference"
    priority: int = ConstraintPriority.MANDATORY_USER
    description: str = ""
    is_hard: bool = True
    metric_value: Optional[float] = None
    threshold: Optional[float] = None
    source: str = ""  # e.g., "requirements", "shapely_geometry", "validator", "asaa"

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return to_jsonable(asdict(self))


@dataclass
class AgentTask:
    """A formal task delegated to a specialized agent by the Hierarchical Orchestrator."""

    task_id: str
    target_agent: str
    task_type: str
    description: str
    context: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    state_version: int = 1
    input_artifacts: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    @property
    def assigned_agent(self) -> str:
        return self.target_agent

    @property
    def intent(self) -> str:
        return self.task_type

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return to_jsonable(asdict(self))


@dataclass
class AgentProposal:
    """A structured action proposal submitted by an agent for orchestrator review."""

    proposal_id: str
    task_id: str
    agent_id: str
    state_version: int
    proposed_action: str
    parameters: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    supporting_evidence: List[ConstraintEvidence] = field(default_factory=list)
    expected_benefit: str = ""
    affected_components: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    dependencies: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    risks: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    confidence: float = 1.0
    requires_review_by: Optional[str] = None
    status: str = "proposed"  # "proposed", "accepted", "rejected", "superseded"
    rejection_reason: Optional[str] = None
    evidence: Optional[List[ConstraintEvidence]] = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.evidence and not self.supporting_evidence:
            self.supporting_evidence = self.evidence
        elif self.supporting_evidence and not self.evidence:
            self.evidence = self.supporting_evidence

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return to_jsonable(asdict(self))

# ============================================================================
# 2. Evidence-Based Conflict Resolver
# ============================================================================

class ConflictResolver:
    """Authoritative arbiter resolving disagreements between specialized agent proposals.

    Enforces the strict 5-tier priority hierarchy:
    1. Explicit user requirements and mandatory constraints (Level 1)
    2. Physical feasibility and deterministic geometry (Level 2)
    3. Independent validator findings (Level 3)
    4. Approved spatial planning intent (Level 4)
    5. Soft preferences and design-quality objectives (Level 5)

    Disqualifies any proposal that violates a higher-level constraint.
    Never relies on ungrounded confidence scores or majority voting.
    """

    @classmethod
    def resolve(
        cls,
        task_id: str,
        proposals: List[AgentProposal],
        state: ProjectState,
    ) -> Tuple[Optional[AgentProposal], ConflictRecord]:
        """Resolve a conflict between multiple competing proposals based on evidence.

        Returns:
            Tuple of (accepted_proposal, conflict_record)
        """
        cid = f"conflict_{generate_id()}"
        agents = [p.agent_id for p in proposals]
        rejection_reasons: Dict[str, str] = {}
        disputed: List[str] = []

        valid_candidates: List[Tuple[AgentProposal, int, float]] = []

        for p in proposals:
            # Check 1: Mandatory user requirements & hard constraints (Level 1)
            violates_user_req = False
            for evid in p.supporting_evidence:
                if evid.priority == ConstraintPriority.MANDATORY_USER:
                    if not evid.is_hard:
                        disputed.append(evid.constraint_id)
                    elif any(term in evid.description.lower() for term in ("omit", "violat", "breach", "remove", "disregard", "below minimum")):
                        violates_user_req = True
                        rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id] = (
                            f"Violates hard constraint: {evid.description}"
                        )
            # Check for explicit illegal parameter (e.g. attempting to remove mandatory room)
            if p.parameters.get("relax_mandatory_rooms") or p.parameters.get("reduce_rooms"):
                violates_user_req = True
                rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id] = (
                    "Violates Level 1 Priority: Cannot silently relax or omit mandatory room requirements."
                )
            if p.parameters.get("target_area_sqm", 0.0) < 0:
                violates_user_req = True
                rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id] = (
                    "Violates Level 1 Priority: Negative target area specified."
                )

            if violates_user_req:
                p.status = "rejected"
                p.rejection_reason = rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id]
                continue

            # Check 2: Physical feasibility & site boundary (Level 2)
            violates_feasibility = False
            for evid in p.supporting_evidence:
                if evid.priority == ConstraintPriority.PHYSICAL_FEASIBILITY:
                    if evid.metric_value is not None and evid.threshold is not None:
                        if evid.metric_value > evid.threshold:
                            violates_feasibility = True
                            rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id] = (
                                f"Violates Level 2 Priority: Physical feasibility exceeded ({evid.metric_value} > {evid.threshold})."
                            )
            if violates_feasibility:
                p.status = "rejected"
                p.rejection_reason = rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id]
                continue

            # Check 3: Validator authority (Level 3)
            # A proposal cannot claim a hard error is ignored
            if p.parameters.get("ignore_hard_errors"):
                p.status = "rejected"
                p.rejection_reason = "Violates Level 3 Priority: FloorPlanValidator authority cannot be bypassed."
                rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id] = p.rejection_reason
                continue

            # Compute effective priority score
            # Highest priority among supporting evidence
            min_priority_level = min(
                (ev.priority for ev in p.supporting_evidence),
                default=ConstraintPriority.SOFT_PREFERENCE,
            )
            valid_candidates.append((p, int(min_priority_level), p.confidence))

        if not valid_candidates:
            record = ConflictRecord(
                conflict_id=cid,
                task_id=task_id,
                disagreeing_agents=agents,
                proposals=proposals,
                disputed_constraints=disputed,
                resolution_strategy="all_rejected_mandatory_violation",
                accepted_proposal_id=None,
                rejection_reasons=rejection_reasons,
                rationale="All proposals rejected due to mandatory constraint or physical feasibility violations.",
                evidence=["mandatory_constraint_protection"],
            )
            return None, record

        # Sort valid candidates:
        # 1. Lower priority level integer = higher authority (Level 1 > Level 2 > ...)
        # 2. Higher confidence
        # 3. Deterministic tie-breaking on proposal_id
        valid_candidates.sort(key=lambda item: (item[1], -item[2], item[0].proposal_id))
        winning_proposal, winning_level, win_conf = valid_candidates[0]

        winning_proposal.status = "accepted"

        # Mark superseded
        for p, _, _ in valid_candidates[1:]:
            p.status = "superseded"
            rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id] = (
                f"Superseded by {winning_proposal.agent_id} (Level {winning_level} authority, confidence {win_conf:.2f})"
            )
            p.rejection_reason = rejection_reasons[p.proposal_id]

        record = ConflictRecord(
            conflict_id=cid,
            task_id=task_id,
            disagreeing_agents=agents,
            proposals=proposals,
            disputed_constraints=disputed,
            resolution_strategy=f"priority_hierarchy_level_{winning_level}",
            accepted_proposal_id=winning_proposal.proposal_id,
            rejection_reasons=rejection_reasons,
            rationale=(
                f"Accepted proposal {winning_proposal.proposal_id} from {winning_proposal.agent_id} "
                f"under Priority Level {winning_level} ({winning_proposal.expected_benefit})."
            ),
            evidence=[e.description for e in winning_proposal.supporting_evidence[:3]],
        )
        return winning_proposal, record

"""Append-only runtime event log for agentic runs.

Events are emitted *while the workflow executes* (never reconstructed afterwards), so a UI can poll
``since(seq)`` and show genuine progress. Payloads are JSON-safe and contain no prompts, raw LLM replies
or credentials.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Protocol

from app.agentic.util import to_jsonable


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AgentEvent:
    seq: int
    ts: float
    type: str
    agent: str
    summary: str
    data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class EventSink(Protocol):
    def emit(self, type: str, agent: str, summary: str, data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> AgentEvent: ...


class InMemoryEventLog:
    """Thread-safe in-memory sink. Listener errors never affect the run."""

    def __init__(self, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time) -> None:
        self._clock = clock
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._events: List[AgentEvent] = []
        self._listeners: List[Callable[[AgentEvent], None]] = []

    def add_listener(self, listener: Callable[[AgentEvent], None]) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._listeners.append(listener)

    def emit(self, type: str, agent: str, summary: str, data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> AgentEvent:
        with self._lock:
            event = AgentEvent(
                seq=len(self._events) + 1,
                ts=self._clock(),
                type=type,
                agent=agent,
                summary=summary,
                data=to_jsonable(data or {}),
            )
            self._events.append(event)
            listeners = list(self._listeners)
        for cb in listeners:
            try:
                cb(event)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - observers must never break a run
                pass
        return event

    def since(self, seq: int = 0) -> List[AgentEvent]:
        with self._lock:
            return [e for e in self._events if e.seq > seq]

    def all(self) -> List[AgentEvent]:
        return self.since(0)

    @property
    def events(self) -> List[AgentEvent]:
        return self.all()

    def types(self) -> List[str]:
        return [e.type for e in self.all()]

[9/252] FILE: app/agentic/schema.py

"""Minimal JSON-Schema subset validator for tool inputs (stdlib only).

Supported keywords: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, enum, minimum, maximum,
minLength, items, minItems, maxItems. Unknown keywords are ignored. ``bool`` is never accepted as a number.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List

_TYPE_CHECKS = {
    "string": lambda v: isinstance(v, str),
    "integer": lambda v: isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool),
    "number": lambda v: isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool),
    "boolean": lambda v: isinstance(v, bool),
    "array": lambda v: isinstance(v, (list, tuple)),
    "object": lambda v: isinstance(v, dict),
    "null": lambda v: v is None,
}


def validate_args(schema: Dict[str, Any], value: Any, path: str = "args") -> List[str]:
    """Return a list of human-readable validation errors (empty when valid)."""
    errors: List[str] = []
    if not schema:
        return errors

    expected = schema.get("type")
    if expected is not None:
        types = expected if isinstance(expected, list) else [expected]
        if not any(_TYPE_CHECKS.get(t, lambda _v: True)(value) for t in types):
            errors.append(f"{path}: expected {'/'.join(types)}, got {type(value).__name__}")
            return errors

    if "enum" in schema and value not in schema["enum"]:
        errors.append(f"{path}: {value!r} is not one of {list(schema['enum'])}")

    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        if "minimum" in schema and value < schema["minimum"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: {value} is below minimum {schema['minimum']}")
        if "maximum" in schema and value > schema["maximum"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: {value} is above maximum {schema['maximum']}")

    if isinstance(value, str) and "minLength" in schema and len(value) < schema["minLength"]:
        errors.append(f"{path}: string shorter than {schema['minLength']}")

    if isinstance(value, dict):
        props = schema.get("properties", {})
        for req in schema.get("required", []):
            if req not in value:
                errors.append(f"{path}: missing required property '{req}'")
        if schema.get("additionalProperties", True) is False:
            for k in value:
                if k not in props:
                    errors.append(f"{path}: unexpected property '{k}'")
        for k, sub in props.items():
            if k in value:
                errors.extend(validate_args(sub, value[k], f"{path}.{k}"))

    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        if "minItems" in schema and len(value) < schema["minItems"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: fewer than {schema['minItems']} items")
        if "maxItems" in schema and len(value) > schema["maxItems"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: more than {schema['maxItems']} items")
        item_schema = schema.get("items")
        if item_schema:
            for i, item in enumerate(value):
                errors.extend(validate_args(item_schema, item, f"{path}[{i}]"))

    return errors

"""Shared, structured project state for the observe-decide-act-evaluate loop.

``ProjectState`` is the single source of truth an agentic run reads and writes. Domain objects
(requirements, allocations, geometry, ...) live in ``artifacts`` (private, never serialized);
everything else is small and JSON-safe so it can be logged, traced and shown in the UI.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Set, Tuple

from app.agentic.budget import Budget
