"""Conversational requirement assistant service for PlanForge AI.

Coordinates multi-turn requirement collection between the user and the authoritative
RequirementAgent, generating structured dynamic question cards, progress tracking,
and final confirmation summaries without inventing requirements.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
import re

from app.agents.requirement_agent.agent import RequirementAgent
from app.agents.requirement_agent.normalizer import ROOM_SYNONYMS
from app.agents.requirement_agent.completeness_gate import (
    CompletenessGate,
    CompletenessResult,
    STATUS_COMPLETE,
    STATUS_INCOMPLETE,
)
from app.models.requirements import FloorRequirement, Requirements, RoomRequirement


@dataclass
class QuestionCardData:
    """Metadata defining the dynamic question card rendered in the chat."""
    question: str
    input_type: str  # "single_choice" | "multi_choice" | "direction" | "number" | "text" | "confirmation"
    options: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    field_key: Optional[str] = None
    default_value: Optional[Any] = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "question": self.question,
            "input_type": self.input_type,
            "options": self.options,
            "field_key": self.field_key,
            "default_value": self.default_value,
        }


@dataclass
class RequirementProgressItem:
    """Single item in the requirement progress checklist."""
    name: str
    status: str  # "completed" | "current" | "pending"
    value: Optional[str] = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "status": self.status,
            "value": self.value,
        }


@dataclass
class ChatTurnResult:
    """Consolidated outcome of an assistant chat turn."""
    message: str
    question_card: Optional[QuestionCardData] = None
    is_ready_for_generation: bool = False
    requirements_text: str = ""
    requirements_summary: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None
    progress: list[RequirementProgressItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    remaining_count: int = 0
    project_name: str = "PlanForge Project"
    status: str = "NEEDS_CLARIFICATION"
    requirements: Optional[Requirements] = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "message": self.message,
            "question_card": self.question_card.to_dict() if self.question_card else None,
            "is_ready_for_generation": self.is_ready_for_generation,
            "requirements_text": self.requirements_text,
            "requirements_summary": self.requirements_summary,
            "progress": [p.to_dict() for p in self.progress],
            "remaining_count": self.remaining_count,
            "project_name": self.project_name,
            "status": self.status,
            "requirements": asdict(self.requirements) if self.requirements else None,
        }


def format_canonical_brief(reqs: Requirements, project_name: str = "") -> str:
    """Generate canonical multi-floor brief text from Requirements."""
    lines = []
    pname = project_name or reqs.project_name or "Residential Project"
    lines.append(f"Project: {pname}")

    if reqs.plot_shape:
        coords_str = ", ".join(f"({round(float(x), 2)}, {round(float(y), 2)})" for x, y in reqs.plot_shape)
        lines.append(f"Plot polygon: {coords_str}")
        if reqs.plot_area_sqm:
            lines.append(f"Plot area: {round(reqs.plot_area_sqm, 2)} sqm")
    elif reqs.plot_dimensions:
        w, d = reqs.plot_dimensions
        lines.append(f"Plot dimensions: {round(w, 2)}m by {round(d, 2)}m")
    elif reqs.plot_area_sqm:
        lines.append(f"Plot area: {round(reqs.plot_area_sqm, 2)} sqm")

    if reqs.orientation:
        lines.append(f"Orientation: {reqs.orientation.capitalize()}")
    if reqs.entrance_facing:
        lines.append(f"Entrance: {reqs.entrance_facing.capitalize()}")

    if reqs.setbacks:
        sb_parts = [f"{k} setback: {v}m" for k, v in reqs.setbacks.items()]
        lines.append(", ".join(sb_parts))

    if reqs.target_floors is not None:
        lines.append(f"Target floors: {reqs.target_floors}")

    tf = reqs.target_floors or (len(reqs.floors) if reqs.floors else 0)
    if tf > 0:
        for fn in range(1, tf + 1):
            fl = reqs.get_floor(fn)
            fname = f"Floor {fn}" if fn > 1 else "Floor 1 (Ground Floor)"
            lines.append(f"\n{fname}:")
            if fl and fl.room_requirements:
                for r in fl.room_requirements:
                    cnt = r.min_count or 1
                    r_name = r.room_type.replace("_", " ").title()
                    details: list[str] = []
                    if r.user_dimensions:
                        w, l = r.user_dimensions
                        details.append(f"{round(w, 2)}m x {round(l, 2)}m")
                    if r.min_area_sqm is not None and r.max_area_sqm is not None:
                        details.append(f"min {round(r.min_area_sqm, 1)} sqm, max {round(r.max_area_sqm, 1)} sqm")
                    elif r.min_area_sqm is not None:
                        details.append(f"min {round(r.min_area_sqm, 1)} sqm")
                    elif r.max_area_sqm is not None:
                        details.append(f"max {round(r.max_area_sqm, 1)} sqm")
                    elif r.preferred_area_sqm is not None:
                        details.append(f"{round(r.preferred_area_sqm, 1)} sq m")

                    if r.attached_to:
                        details.append(f"attached to {r.attached_to.replace('_', ' ').title()}")
                    if r.adjacency:
                        adj_str = ", ".join(a.replace("_", " ").title() for a in r.adjacency)
                        details.append(f"adjacent to {adj_str}")
                    if r.separation:
                        sep_str = ", ".join(s.replace("_", " ").title() for s in r.separation)
                        details.append(f"separate from {sep_str}")

                    detail_suffix = f" ({', '.join(details)})" if details else ""
                    lines.append(f"- {cnt} {r_name}{detail_suffix}")
            else:
                lines.append("- Rooms not yet specified")

    return "\n".join(lines).strip()


class ConversationalRequirementAssistant:
    """Authoritative multi-turn conversational coordinator for floor-plan requirements."""

    def __init__(self, requirement_agent: Optional[RequirementAgent] = None) -> None:
        self.requirement_agent = requirement_agent or RequirementAgent()

    def handle_turn(
        self,
        message: str,
        existing_brief: Optional[str] = None,
        project_name: Optional[str] = None,
        active_floor: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> ChatTurnResult:
        """Process a single conversational user message and return next step guidance."""
        clean_msg = message.strip()
        pname = project_name or "PlanForge Residential Project"

        # Check for initial greeting/empty prompt
        if not clean_msg and not existing_brief:
            return self._initial_greeting(pname)

        # Detect edit request
        if clean_msg.lower() in ["edit requirements", "✏ edit requirements", "edit", "modify"]:
            return self._handle_edit_request(existing_brief or "", pname)

        # 1. Parse or update requirements using the authoritative agent
        if existing_brief:
            # Parse existing requirements first
            base_res = self.requirement_agent.process(existing_brief, project_name=pname)
            # Apply user message update with active_floor context
            res = self.requirement_agent.update(
                base_res.requirements, clean_msg, active_floor=active_floor
            )
        else:
            res = self.requirement_agent.process(
                clean_msg, project_name=pname, active_floor=active_floor
            )

        reqs = res.requirements
        comp = res.completeness
        val = res.validation

        # 2. Build progress checklist
        progress, remaining_count = self._build_progress(reqs, comp)

        # 3. Determine next question / card
        card, reply_msg = self._determine_next_step(clean_msg, reqs, comp, val, pname)

        # 4. Canonical brief
        canonical_brief = format_canonical_brief(reqs, pname)

        # 5. Check readiness
        is_ready = comp.can_proceed and val.is_valid and (card is not None and card.input_type == "confirmation")

        return ChatTurnResult(
            message=reply_msg,
            question_card=card,
            is_ready_for_generation=is_ready,
            requirements_text=canonical_brief,
            requirements_summary=self._build_summary_dict(reqs),
            progress=progress,
            remaining_count=remaining_count,
            project_name=pname,
            status=res.status,
            requirements=reqs,
        )

    def build_turn_result_from_reqs(
        self,
        reqs: Requirements,
        last_user_msg: str,
        project_name: str,
    ) -> ChatTurnResult:
        """Build progress, next step, and turn result directly from structured Requirements."""
        self.requirement_agent.pipeline._normalize_requirements(reqs)
        comp = self.requirement_agent.completeness_gate.check(reqs)
        val = self.requirement_agent.validator.validate(reqs)
        progress, remaining_count = self._build_progress(reqs, comp)
        card, reply_msg = self._determine_next_step(last_user_msg, reqs, comp, val, project_name)
        canonical_brief = format_canonical_brief(reqs, project_name)
        is_ready = comp.can_proceed and val.is_valid and (card is not None and card.input_type == "confirmation")
        status = "READY_FOR_PLANNING" if (comp.can_proceed and val.is_valid) else ("NEEDS_CLARIFICATION" if not comp.is_complete else "VALIDATION_FAILED")
        return ChatTurnResult(
            message=reply_msg,
            question_card=card,
            is_ready_for_generation=is_ready,
            requirements_text=canonical_brief,
            requirements_summary=self._build_summary_dict(reqs),
            progress=progress,
            remaining_count=remaining_count,
            project_name=project_name,
            status=status,
            requirements=reqs,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chat-orchestrator support (no LLM involvement, deterministic)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    _REMOVAL_CLAUSE_RE = re.compile(
        r"\b(?:remove|delete|drop|eliminate|scrap|cancel|get\s+rid\s+of|take\s+out|exclude|omit|"
        r"no|without|don'?t\s+(?:want|need|have)|do\s+not\s+(?:want|need|have)|not\s+(?:want|need))\b",
        re.I,
    )

    def snapshot(
        self,
        existing_brief: Optional[str],
        project_name: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> ChatTurnResult:
        """Return the CURRENT requirement state without modifying it.

        Used when a conversational message is answered by the LLM: the structured
        requirement state (progress, readiness, summary) must be reported exactly as
        it is, never altered by the content of a general question.
        """
        pname = project_name or "PlanForge Residential Project"
        if not existing_brief or not existing_brief.strip():
            return self._initial_greeting(pname)

        res = self.requirement_agent.process(existing_brief, project_name=pname)
        reqs, comp, val = res.requirements, res.completeness, res.validation
        progress, remaining_count = self._build_progress(reqs, comp)
        card, reply_msg = self._determine_next_step("", reqs, comp, val, pname)
        is_ready = comp.can_proceed and val.is_valid and (card is not None and card.input_type == "confirmation")

        return ChatTurnResult(
            message=reply_msg,
            question_card=card,
            is_ready_for_generation=is_ready,
            requirements_text=existing_brief,
            requirements_summary=self._build_summary_dict(reqs),
            progress=progress,
            remaining_count=remaining_count,
            project_name=pname,
            status=res.status,
        )

    def handle_removal(
        self,
        message: str,
        existing_brief: Optional[str] = None,
        project_name: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> ChatTurnResult:
        """Remove explicitly named rooms from the structured requirements.

        The requirement parser has no notion of removal (it would turn
        "remove the dining room" into an ADDED dining room), so removal is
        handled here, deterministically. Only rooms the user names inside a
        removal/negation clause are removed; nothing is ever added by a removal.
        Clauses without removal wording are passed to the Requirement Agent as
        normal additions.
        """
        pname = project_name or "PlanForge Residential Project"
        clean = message.strip()

        if not existing_brief or not existing_brief.strip():
            snap = self.snapshot(None, pname)
            snap.message = "There are no recorded requirements to remove yet.\n\n" + snap.message
            return snap

        targets: list[tuple[str, Optional[int]]] = []
        keep_clauses: list[str] = []
        for clause in re.split(r"[;\n,]|\.(?!\d)", clean):
            c = clause.strip()
            if not c:
                continue
            if self._REMOVAL_CLAUSE_RE.search(c):
                floor_no = self._floor_in_clause(c)
                for rtype in self._room_types_in(c):
                    if (rtype, floor_no) not in targets:
                        targets.append((rtype, floor_no))
            else:
                keep_clauses.append(c)

        if not targets:
            snap = self.snapshot(existing_brief, pname)
            snap.message = (
                "I couldn't tell which room you want to remove, so I haven't changed your requirements. "
                "Try something like *'Remove the dining room'*.\n\n" + snap.message
            )
            return snap

        base = self.requirement_agent.process(existing_brief, project_name=pname)
        reqs = base.requirements

        removed: list[str] = []
        absent: list[str] = []
        for rtype, floor_no in targets:
            found = False
            for fl in reqs.floors:
                if floor_no is not None and fl.floor_number != floor_no:
                    continue
                before = len(fl.room_requirements)
                fl.room_requirements = [r for r in fl.room_requirements if r.room_type != rtype]
                if len(fl.room_requirements) != before:
                    found = True

            label = rtype.replace("_", " ").title() + (f" (Floor {floor_no})" if floor_no else "")
            if found:
                removed.append(label)
                if not any(r.room_type == rtype for r in reqs.all_room_requirements()):
                    for r in reqs.all_room_requirements():
                        r.adjacency = [a for a in r.adjacency if a != rtype]
                        r.separation = [s for s in r.separation if s != rtype]
                        if r.attached_to == rtype:
                            r.attached_to = None
            else:
                absent.append(label)

        # Re-run authoritative checks (and merge any non-removal additions) via the agent.
        res = self.requirement_agent.update(reqs, ". ".join(keep_clauses))
        reqs, comp, val = res.requirements, res.completeness, res.validation
        progress, remaining_count = self._build_progress(reqs, comp)
        card, next_msg = self._determine_next_step(clean, reqs, comp, val, pname)
        is_ready = comp.can_proceed and val.is_valid and (card is not None and card.input_type == "confirmation")

        notes: list[str] = []
        if removed:
            notes.append("Removed from your requirements: " + ", ".join(removed) + ".")
        if absent:
            notes.append("Not in your current requirements (nothing changed): " + ", ".join(absent) + ".")

        return ChatTurnResult(
            message=" ".join(notes) + "\n\n" + next_msg,
            question_card=card,
            is_ready_for_generation=is_ready,
            requirements_text=format_canonical_brief(reqs, pname),
            requirements_summary=self._build_summary_dict(reqs),
            progress=progress,
            remaining_count=remaining_count,
            project_name=pname,
            status=res.status,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _floor_in_clause(clause: str) -> Optional[int]:
        """Floor number explicitly named in a clause (e.g. 'Floor 2: no study'), else None."""
        m = re.search(r"\bfloor\s*(\d+)\b", clause, re.I) or re.search(
            r"\b(\d+)(?:st|nd|rd|th)\s+floor\b", clause, re.I
        )
        if m:
            return int(m.group(1))
        if re.search(r"\bground\s+floor\b", clause, re.I):
            return 1
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _room_types_in(clause: str) -> list[str]:
        """Canonical room types mentioned in a clause (longest synonym wins, no overlaps)."""
        found: list[str] = []
        occupied: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
        for phrase in sorted(ROOM_SYNONYMS, key=len, reverse=True):
            for m in re.finditer(rf"\b{re.escape(phrase)}s?\b", clause, re.I):
                s, e = m.span()
                if any(not (e <= os_ or s >= oe) for os_, oe in occupied):
                    continue
                occupied.append((s, e))
                canonical = ROOM_SYNONYMS[phrase]
                if canonical not in found:
                    found.append(canonical)
        return found

    def _initial_greeting(self, project_name: str) -> ChatTurnResult:
        """Greeting state when conversation starts."""
        progress = [
            RequirementProgressItem("Project type", "current"),
            RequirementProgressItem("Plot dimensions", "pending"),
            RequirementProgressItem("Floors", "pending"),
            RequirementProgressItem("Entrance orientation", "pending"),
            RequirementProgressItem("Floor 1 rooms", "pending"),
        ]

        card = QuestionCardData(
            question="What type of residential project would you like to design?",
            input_type="single_choice",
            options=[
                "🏠 Single-Floor Bungalow",
                "🏘 Two-Floor Duplex Residence",
                "🏢 Three-Floor Townhouse",
                "📐 Custom Dimensions & Program",
            ],
            field_key="project_type",
        )

        return ChatTurnResult(
            message=(
                "Hello! I am **PlanForge AI**, your conversational architectural assistant.\n\n"
                "Tell me about your building requirements in plain language, or choose a project type below to get started."
            ),
            question_card=card,
            is_ready_for_generation=False,
            progress=progress,
            remaining_count=5,
            project_name=project_name,
            status="INITIAL",
        )

    def _handle_edit_request(self, existing_brief: str, project_name: str) -> ChatTurnResult:
        """Handle request to edit requirements."""
        res = self.requirement_agent.process(existing_brief, project_name=project_name)
        progress, remaining_count = self._build_progress(res.requirements, res.completeness)

        card = QuestionCardData(
            question="What would you like to modify?",
            input_type="single_choice",
            options=[
                "Change Plot Dimensions",
                "Change Number of Floors",
                "Change Entrance Direction",
                "Edit Floor 1 Rooms",
                "Edit Floor 2 Rooms",
                "Looks Good, Generate Floor Plan",
            ],
            field_key="edit_selection",
        )

        return ChatTurnResult(
            message=(
                "What would you like to change? You can select a section below, or simply type your changes "
                "(e.g., *'Change plot size to 50ft x 60ft'* or *'Add a study room on Floor 1'*)."
            ),
            question_card=card,
            is_ready_for_generation=False,
            requirements_text=format_canonical_brief(res.requirements, project_name),
            requirements_summary=self._build_summary_dict(res.requirements),
            progress=progress,
            remaining_count=remaining_count,
            project_name=project_name,
            status="EDITING",
        )

    def _build_progress(
        self, reqs: Requirements, comp: CompletenessResult
    ) -> Tuple[list[RequirementProgressItem], int]:
        """Construct the compact requirement progress checklist."""
        items: list[RequirementProgressItem] = []

        # 1. Project type
        items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Project type", "completed", "Residential"))

        # 2. Plot dimensions
        if reqs.plot_shape:
            poly_desc = f"{len(reqs.plot_shape)}-point irregular"
            if reqs.plot_area_sqm:
                poly_desc += f" ({round(reqs.plot_area_sqm, 1)} m²)"
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Plot dimensions", "completed", poly_desc))
        elif reqs.plot_dimensions:
            w, d = reqs.plot_dimensions
            val_str = f"{round(w, 1)}m × {round(d, 1)}m"
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Plot dimensions", "completed", val_str))
        elif reqs.plot_area_sqm:
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Plot dimensions", "completed", f"{round(reqs.plot_area_sqm, 1)} m²"))
        else:
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Plot dimensions", "pending"))

        # 3. Floors
        if reqs.target_floors:
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Floors", "completed", f"{reqs.target_floors} Floor{'s' if reqs.target_floors > 1 else ''}"))
        else:
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Floors", "pending"))

        # 4. Entrance Orientation
        if reqs.entrance_facing or reqs.orientation:
            ent = (reqs.entrance_facing or reqs.orientation or "").capitalize()
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Entrance orientation", "completed", ent))
        else:
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Entrance orientation", "pending"))

        # 5. Floor 1 rooms
        f1 = reqs.get_floor(1)
        if f1 and f1.room_requirements:
            r_count = f1.total_rooms()
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Floor 1 rooms", "completed", f"{r_count} room{'s' if r_count > 1 else ''}"))
        else:
            items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Floor 1 rooms", "pending"))

        # 6. Upper Floors (if target_floors >= 2)
        tf = reqs.target_floors or (len(reqs.floors) if reqs.floors else 1)
        if tf >= 2:
            f2 = reqs.get_floor(2)
            if f2 and f2.room_requirements:
                r_count = f2.total_rooms()
                items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Floor 2 rooms", "completed", f"{r_count} room{'s' if r_count > 1 else ''}"))
            else:
                items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Floor 2 rooms", "pending"))

        if tf >= 3:
            f3 = reqs.get_floor(3)
            if f3 and f3.room_requirements:
                r_count = f3.total_rooms()
                items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Floor 3 rooms", "completed", f"{r_count} room{'s' if r_count > 1 else ''}"))
            else:
                items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Floor 3 rooms", "pending"))

        # 7. Staircase (for multi-floor)
        if tf >= 2:
            stair_mentioned = "stair" in reqs.raw_input.lower()
            if stair_mentioned:
                items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Staircase", "completed", "Configured"))
            else:
                items.append(RequirementProgressItem("Staircase", "pending"))

        # Determine remaining
        remaining = sum(1 for it in items if it.status == "pending")

        # Mark first pending item as 'current'
        found_current = False
        for it in items:
            if it.status == "pending" and not found_current:
                it.status = "current"
                found_current = True

        return items, remaining

    def _determine_next_step(
        self,
        last_user_msg: str,
        reqs: Requirements,
        comp: CompletenessResult,
        val: Any,
        project_name: str,
    ) -> Tuple[Optional[QuestionCardData], str]:
        """Determine what question card and conversational reply to present next."""

        # Priority 1: Plot dimensions missing
        has_plot = bool(reqs.plot_dimensions or reqs.plot_area_sqm or (reqs.plot_shape and len(reqs.plot_shape) >= 3))
        if not has_plot and comp.missing_fields and "plot_dimensions" in comp.missing_fields:
            reply = "What are the dimensions or total area of your plot?"
            card = QuestionCardData(
                question="Choose standard plot dimensions or enter custom size:",
                input_type="single_choice",
                options=[
                    "30ft x 40ft (1,200 sq ft)",
                    "40ft x 50ft (2,000 sq ft)",
                    "50ft x 60ft (3,000 sq ft)",
                    "10m x 15m (150 m²)",
                    "Custom Irregular Plot",
                ],
                field_key="plot_dimensions",
            )
            return card, reply

        # Priority 2: Target floors missing
        if comp.missing_fields and "target_floors" in comp.missing_fields:
            reply = "How many floors do you need for this project?"
            if reqs.plot_shape and any(k in last_user_msg.lower() for k in ["irregular", "polygon", "boundary"]):
                reply = "Got it. I've saved your custom plot boundary. Now let's define the number of floors."
            card = QuestionCardData(
                question="Select number of floors:",
                input_type="single_choice",
                options=[
                    "1 Floor (Single Storey)",
                    "2 Floors (Two Storey / Duplex)",
                    "3 Floors (Three Storey / Townhouse)",
                ],
                field_key="target_floors",
            )
            return card, reply

        # Priority 3: Entrance orientation missing (if not provided)
        if reqs.entrance_facing is None and reqs.orientation is None:
            reply = "Which direction should the main entrance face? This helps optimize solar gain and room placement."
            card = QuestionCardData(
                question="Select entrance facing direction:",
                input_type="direction",
                options=["North", "South", "East", "West"],
                field_key="entrance_facing",
            )
            return card, reply

        # Priority 4: Floor 1 rooms missing
        f1 = reqs.get_floor(1)
        if not f1 or not f1.room_requirements:
            reply = "What rooms do you need on **Floor 1 (Ground Floor)**?"
            card = QuestionCardData(
                question="Select rooms for Floor 1:",
                input_type="multi_choice",
                options=[
                    "Living Room",
                    "Kitchen",
                    "Dining Room",
                    "Master Bedroom",
                    "Bedroom",
                    "Bathroom",
                    "Study Room",
                    "Pooja Room",
                    "Porch",
                ],
                field_key="floor_1_rooms",
            )
            return card, reply

        # Priority 5: Floor 2 rooms missing (if target_floors >= 2)
        tf = reqs.target_floors or (len(reqs.floors) if reqs.floors else 1)
        if tf >= 2:
            f2 = reqs.get_floor(2)
            if not f2 or not f2.room_requirements:
                reply = "Great! Floor 1 is configured. Now, what rooms would you like on **Floor 2**?"
                card = QuestionCardData(
                    question="Select rooms for Floor 2:",
                    input_type="multi_choice",
                    options=[
                        "Master Bedroom",
                        "Bedroom",
                        "Bathroom",
                        "Study Room",
                        "Balcony",
                        "Family Lounge",
                        "Terrace",
                    ],
                    field_key="floor_2_rooms",
                )
                return card, reply

        # Priority 6: Floor 3 rooms missing (if target_floors >= 3)
        if tf >= 3:
            f3 = reqs.get_floor(3)
            if not f3 or not f3.room_requirements:
                reply = "Floor 1 and 2 are recorded. What rooms would you like on **Floor 3**?"
                card = QuestionCardData(
                    question="Select rooms for Floor 3:",
                    input_type="multi_choice",
                    options=[
                        "Bedroom",
                        "Bathroom",
                        "Gym / Fitness",
                        "Media Room",
                        "Open Terrace",
                        "Storage",
                    ],
                    field_key="floor_3_rooms",
                )
                return card, reply

        # Priority 7: Staircase location (for multi-floor, if not explicitly stated)
        if tf >= 2 and "stair" not in reqs.raw_input.lower():
            reply = "Where would you like the staircase located?"
            card = QuestionCardData(
                question="Choose preferred staircase placement:",
                input_type="single_choice",
                options=[
                    "Inside (Living Area)",
                    "Near Entrance",
                    "Central Core",
                    "Rear of House",
                    "External Staircase",
                ],
                field_key="staircase_location",
            )
            return card, reply

        # Priority 8: All requirements complete! Show final summary and confirmation card.
        summary_text = self._format_summary_markdown(reqs)
        reply = (
            f"### Plan Requirements Summary\n\n"
            f"{summary_text}\n\n"
            f"Everything looks complete and verified. Shall I generate the floor plan?"
        )
        card = QuestionCardData(
            question="Ready to generate?",
            input_type="confirmation",
            options=[
                "Generate Floor Plan",
                "Edit Requirements",
            ],
            field_key="confirmation",
        )
        return card, reply

    def _format_summary_markdown(self, reqs: Requirements) -> str:
        """Format clean Markdown summary of requirements."""
        lines = []
        if reqs.plot_dimensions:
            w, d = reqs.plot_dimensions
            w_ft = round(w * 3.28084, 1)
            d_ft = round(d * 3.28084, 1)
            area_m2 = round(w * d, 1)
            lines.append(f"• **Plot**: {round(w, 1)}m × {round(d, 1)}m ({w_ft}ft × {d_ft}ft, ~{area_m2} m²)")
        elif reqs.plot_area_sqm:
            lines.append(f"• **Plot Area**: ~{round(reqs.plot_area_sqm, 1)} m²")

        tf = reqs.target_floors or len(reqs.floors) or 1
        lines.append(f"• **Floors**: {tf}")

        ent = reqs.entrance_facing or reqs.orientation or "North"
        lines.append(f"• **Entrance Facing**: {ent.capitalize()}")

        for fn in range(1, tf + 1):
            fl = reqs.get_floor(fn)
            if fl and fl.room_requirements:
                room_strs = []
                for r in fl.room_requirements:
                    cnt = r.min_count or 1
                    rname = r.room_type.replace("_", " ").title()
                    room_strs.append(f"{cnt} {rname}" if cnt > 1 else rname)
                fname = f"Floor {fn}" if fn > 1 else "Floor 1 (Ground)"
                lines.append(f"• **{fname}**: {', '.join(room_strs)}")

        if tf >= 2:
            lines.append("• **Staircase**: Vertical Core Aligned")

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_summary_dict(self, reqs: Requirements) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert requirements into dictionary for frontend consumption."""
        tf = reqs.target_floors or len(reqs.floors) or 1
        floors_data = []
        for fn in range(1, tf + 1):
            fl = reqs.get_floor(fn)
            rooms = []
            if fl:
                for r in fl.room_requirements:
                    rooms.append({
                        "room_type": r.room_type,
                        "count": r.min_count,
                        "preferred_area_sqm": r.preferred_area_sqm,
                    })
            floors_data.append({"floor_number": fn, "rooms": rooms})

        return {
            "plot_dimensions": list(reqs.plot_dimensions) if reqs.plot_dimensions else None,
            "plot_area_sqm": reqs.plot_area_sqm,
            "target_floors": tf,
            "orientation": reqs.orientation,
            "entrance_facing": reqs.entrance_facing,
            "floors": floors_data,
        }

"""Requirement Normalizer — standardises terminology and values.

Normalises:
- Room synonyms to canonical room types (e.g., 'washroom' -> 'bathroom', 'master bed' -> 'master_bedroom').
- Floor labels to consistent 1-based integers ('ground floor' -> 1, '1st floor' -> 1, '2nd floor' -> 2).
- Word numbers ('three' -> 3, 'a' -> 1).
- Preserves original raw text for explainability without distorting user intent.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Optional
from app.utils.units import parse_area_sqm, parse_dimension_m


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Canonical room types and synonyms table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ROOM_SYNONYMS: dict[str, str] = {
    # Living / Social
    "living room": "living",
    "living": "living",
    "lounge": "living",
    "sitting room": "living",
    "drawing room": "living",
    "reception": "living",
    "family room": "living",
    "living hall": "living",
    # Dining
    "dining room": "dining",
    "dining": "dining",
    "dining area": "dining",
    "dining space": "dining",
    # Kitchen
    "kitchen": "kitchen",
    "kitchenette": "kitchen",
    "open kitchen": "kitchen",
    "modular kitchen": "kitchen",
    "dirty kitchen": "kitchen",
    # Master Bedroom
    "master bedroom": "master_bedroom",
    "master bed": "master_bedroom",
    "primary bedroom": "master_bedroom",
    "mbr": "master_bedroom",
    # Bedroom
    "bedroom": "bedroom",
    "bed room": "bedroom",
    "bed": "bedroom",
    "guest room": "bedroom",
    "guest bedroom": "bedroom",
    "kids room": "bedroom",
    "children bedroom": "bedroom",
    "children room": "bedroom",
    # Bathroom
    "bathroom": "bathroom",
    "bath room": "bathroom",
    "bath": "bathroom",

    "one": 1, "two": 2, "three": 3, "four": 4, "five": 5,

    "floor 5": 5,

CARDINAL_DIRECTIONS: set[str] = {
    "north", "south", "east", "west",
    "northeast", "northwest", "southeast", "southwest",
}


class RequirementNormalizer:
    """Normalizes natural-language requirement expressions into canonical representations."""

    @staticmethod
    def canonical_room_type(phrase: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Convert phrase to canonical room type or return None."""
        phrase_clean = phrase.lower().strip()
        if phrase_clean in ROOM_SYNONYMS:
            return ROOM_SYNONYMS[phrase_clean]

        # Try word boundary match against sorted synonyms
        for syn in sorted(ROOM_SYNONYMS.keys(), key=len, reverse=True):
            if re.search(r"\b" + re.escape(syn) + r"\b", phrase_clean):
                return ROOM_SYNONYMS[syn]
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def normalize_floor_number(label: str) -> Optional[int]:
        """Normalize floor label/string to 1-based integer floor number."""
        clean = label.lower().strip().rstrip(":")
        if clean in FLOOR_LABEL_TO_NUMBER:
            return FLOOR_LABEL_TO_NUMBER[clean]

        # Check for numeric pattern like "floor 2", "floor 3"
        m = re.search(r"\bfloor\s*(\d+)\b", clean)
        if m:
            return int(m.group(1))

        # Check for ordinal pattern like "1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th"
        m = re.search(r"\b(\d+)(?:st|nd|rd|th)(?:\s+floor)?\b", clean)
        if m:
            return int(m.group(1))

        if clean.isdigit():
            val = int(clean)
            return val if val > 0 else None

        return None

    @staticmethod
    def normalize_count(raw: Optional[str]) -> int:
        """Convert raw count token (word or digit) to integer (default 1)."""
        if not raw:
            return 1
        clean = raw.strip().lower()
        if clean.isdigit():
            return int(clean)
        return WORD_NUMBERS.get(clean, 1)

    @staticmethod
    def normalize_direction(raw: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Normalize orientation/direction string."""
        clean = raw.strip().lower()
        clean = clean.replace("-", "").replace(" ", "")
        if clean in CARDINAL_DIRECTIONS:
            return clean
        for d in CARDINAL_DIRECTIONS:
            if d in clean:
                return d
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def normalize_area_value(text: str) -> Optional[float]:
        """Extract and convert area from text using standard units converter."""
        return parse_area_sqm(text)

    @staticmethod
    def normalize_dimension_value(text: str) -> Optional[float]:
        """Extract and convert dimension from text using standard units converter."""
        return parse_dimension_m(text)

"""Requirement Parser — extracts structured requirements from freeform text.

Implements robust extraction for:
- Plot: dimensions (w x d), area, polygon boundary, orientation, setbacks.
- Floors: target floor count, per-floor room requirements.
- Rooms: room type, quantity, isolated min/preferred/max area, attachments.
- Relationships: adjacency, separation, attached-to, circulation.
- Entrance: facing direction, preferred entrance room type.
- Staircase: required flag and location preferences.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Optional

from app.models.requirements import FloorRequirement, Requirements, RoomRequirement
from app.agents.requirement_agent.normalizer import (
    RequirementNormalizer,
    ROOM_SYNONYMS,
    WORD_NUMBERS,
    FLOOR_LABEL_TO_NUMBER,
    CARDINAL_DIRECTIONS,
)
from app.utils.units import parse_area_sqm, parse_dimension_m


class RequirementParser:
    """Extracts architectural requirements from user text using deterministic rules."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.normalizer = RequirementNormalizer()

    def parse(
        self,
        text: str,
        project_name: str = "PlanForge Project",
        active_floor: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> Requirements:
        """Parse raw text into a Requirements instance.

        Never invents unspecified fields or rooms.
        """
        raw_text = text.strip()
        reqs = Requirements(
            project_name=project_name,
            raw_input=raw_text,
        )

        # 1. Plot
        reqs.plot_shape = self.extract_plot_shape(raw_text)
        if reqs.plot_shape:
            reqs.plot_dimensions = None
            try:
                from shapely.geometry import Polygon
                poly = Polygon(reqs.plot_shape)
                if poly.is_valid and not poly.is_empty and poly.area > 0:
                    reqs.plot_area_sqm = round(poly.area, 4)
            except Exception:
                pass
        else:
            reqs.plot_dimensions = self.extract_plot_dimensions(raw_text)
            if reqs.plot_dimensions:
                w, d = reqs.plot_dimensions
                reqs.plot_area_sqm = round(w * d, 4)
            else:
                reqs.plot_area_sqm = self.extract_standalone_area(raw_text)
        reqs.orientation = self.extract_orientation(raw_text)
        reqs.entrance_facing = self.extract_entrance_facing(raw_text)
        reqs.entrance_room_type = self.extract_entrance_room_type(raw_text)
        reqs.setbacks = self.extract_setbacks(raw_text)

        # 2. Target Floors
        reqs.target_floors = self.extract_target_floors(raw_text)

        # 3. Floors & Rooms
        floors = self.extract_floors(
            raw_text,
            reqs.target_floors,
            active_floor=active_floor,
            project_name=project_name,
        )
        reqs.floors = floors
        reqs.floor_requirements = floors

        return reqs

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Plot Extraction
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def extract_plot_dimensions(self, text: str) -> Optional[tuple[float, float]]:
        """Extract plot width and depth in metres.

        Strictly distinguishes plot dimensions from room dimensions (Task 8).
        Room dimensions like 'Bedroom 12ft x 14ft' will NEVER be extracted as plot dimensions.
        """
        dim_pair = re.compile(
            r"([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*"
            r"(m|meters?|metres?|ft|feet|foot|'|\u2019)?\s*"
            r"(?:x|×|\*|by)\s*"
            r"([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*"
            r"(m|meters?|metres?|ft|feet|foot|'|\u2019)?",
            re.I,
        )

        def to_m(val: str, unit: str) -> float:
            token = f"{val} {unit}".strip()
            res = parse_dimension_m(token)
            return res if res is not None else float(val)

        # Room indicators that disqualify a clause or prefix from being a plot specification
        room_keywords = set(ROOM_SYNONYMS.keys()) | {
            "room", "rooms", "hall", "closet", "balcony", "toilet", "bath", "passage",
            "corridor", "kitchen", "bedroom", "living", "dining", "study", "foyer", "pantry",
            "master", "veranda", "porch", "laundry", "office", "stair", "staircase",
        }

        clauses = re.split(r"[\n;]|(?<!\d)\.(?!\d)", text)

        # Pass 1: Look for explicitly marked plot clauses containing plot, site, land, ground, property, lot
        for clause in clauses:
            clean_clause = clause.strip()
            if not clean_clause:
                continue
            is_explicit_plot = bool(re.search(r"\b(?:plot|site|land|ground|property|lot)\b", clean_clause, re.I))
            if is_explicit_plot:
                for m in dim_pair.finditer(clean_clause):
                    prefix = clean_clause[:m.start()].lower()
                    # If a room keyword immediately precedes the dimension within the clause, skip it
                    if any(re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b", prefix) for kw in room_keywords):
                        continue
                    raw_w = m.group(1)
                    raw_d = m.group(3)
                    unit_w = m.group(2)
                    unit_d = m.group(4)
                    common_unit = unit_d or unit_w or ""
                    w = to_m(raw_w, unit_w or common_unit)
                    d = to_m(raw_d, unit_d or common_unit)
                    if w > 0 and d > 0:
                        return (round(w, 4), round(d, 4))

        # Pass 2: Generic bare dimension if NO room keyword appears anywhere in the clause
        for clause in clauses:
            clean_clause = clause.strip()
            if not clean_clause:
                continue
            # If the clause contains any room keyword, it is describing a room, not a plot
            if any(re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b", clean_clause, re.I) for kw in room_keywords):
                continue
            for m in dim_pair.finditer(clean_clause):
                raw_w = m.group(1)
                raw_d = m.group(3)
                unit_w = m.group(2)
                unit_d = m.group(4)
                common_unit = unit_d or unit_w or ""
                w = to_m(raw_w, unit_w or common_unit)
                d = to_m(raw_d, unit_d or common_unit)
                if w > 0 and d > 0:
                    return (round(w, 4), round(d, 4))

        return None

    def extract_standalone_area(self, text: str) -> Optional[float]:
        """Extract standalone plot area (e.g. 200 sqm, 5 marla, 1200 sq ft)."""
        pattern = re.compile(
            r"(?:plot|land|site|property)\s+(?:area|size)[:\s]*([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?\s*[a-zA-Z²]+)|"
            r"([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|ft[²2]|sqm|sq\.?\s*m|m[²2]|marlas?|acres?|kanals?|hectares?|ha))\s+(?:plot|land|site)?",
            re.I,
        )
        m = pattern.search(text)
        if m:
            snippet = m.group(1) or m.group(2)
            val = parse_area_sqm(snippet)
            if val is not None and val > 0:
                return round(val, 4)
        return None

    def extract_plot_shape(self, text: str) -> Optional[tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]]:
        """Extract explicit boundary polygon vertices if given like:

        (0, 0), (15, 0), (15, 20), (0, 20) or [(0,0), (40,0), (40,20), (25,20), (25,40), (0,40)]
        """
        # Look for coordinate pairs: (x, y) or [x, y]
        coord_pat = re.compile(r"[\(\[]\s*([\-+]?[\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*,\s*([\-+]?[\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[\)\]]")
        matches = coord_pat.findall(text)
        if len(matches) >= 3:
            coords = tuple((float(x), float(y)) for x, y in matches)
            return coords
        return None

    def extract_orientation(self, text: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Extract plot orientation (e.g. north-facing)."""
        for d in CARDINAL_DIRECTIONS:
            pattern = re.compile(
                rf"\b{d}[\-\s]?facing\b|\bfacing\s+{d}\b|\b{d}\s+facing\s+(?:plot|house|site)\b|\borientation[:\s]+{d}\b",
                re.I,
            )
            if pattern.search(text):
                return d
        return None

    def extract_entrance_facing(self, text: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Extract entrance facing direction."""
        for d in CARDINAL_DIRECTIONS:
            pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?:main\s+)?entrance\s+(?:from|on|toward|facing)\s+(?:the\s+)?{d}\b|"
                rf"(?:main\s+)?entrance[:\s]+{d}\b|"
                rf"{d}[\-\s]facing\s+(?:main\s+)?entrance\b|"
                rf"{d}\s+entrance\b",
                re.I,
            )
            if pattern.search(text):
                return d
        return None

    def extract_entrance_room_type(self, text: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Extract preferred room connected to main entrance (e.g. entrance to living)."""
        pattern = re.compile(
            r"(?:entrance|entry)\s+(?:leads?\s+to|opens?\s+into|to|connects?\s+to)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-zA-Z\s]+?)(?:[,\.;]|$)",
            re.I,
        )
        m = pattern.search(text)
        if m:
            target = m.group(1).strip()
            canonical = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(target)
            if canonical:
                return canonical
        return None

    def extract_setbacks(self, text: str) -> dict[str, float]:
        """Extract explicit setbacks."""
        setbacks: dict[str, float] = {}
        sides = ("front", "rear", "back", "left", "right", "side")
        for side in sides:
            pattern = re.compile(
                rf"{side}\s+setback[:\s]*([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(m|meters?|ft|feet|'|\u2019)?|"
                rf"setback\s+of\s+([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(m|meters?|ft|feet|'|\u2019)?\s+(?:on\s+the\s+)?{side}",
                re.I,
            )
            m = pattern.search(text)
            if m:
                raw_val = m.group(1) or m.group(3)
                unit = m.group(2) or m.group(4) or "m"
                val = parse_dimension_m(f"{raw_val} {unit}".strip()) or float(raw_val)
                key = "rear" if side == "back" else ("side" if side == "side" else side)
                setbacks[key] = round(val, 3)
        return setbacks

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Floors Extraction
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def extract_target_floors(self, text: str) -> Optional[int]:
        """Extract explicitly stated target floor count."""
        patterns = [
            # G+1, G+2
            (r"\bG\s*\+\s*(\d+)\b", lambda m: int(m.group(1)) + 1),
            # ground + 1 upper
            (r"\bground\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*(?:upper|floors?)?\b", lambda m: int(m.group(1)) + 1),
            # single/two/three/four/double storey or floor
            (r"\b(single|one|1)[\-\s]*(?:stor(?:ey|y)|floor)\b", lambda _: 1),
            (r"\b(two|2|double)[\-\s]*(?:stor(?:ey|y)|floor)\b", lambda _: 2),
            (r"\b(three|3|triple)[\-\s]*(?:stor(?:ey|y)|floor)\b", lambda _: 3),
            (r"\b(four|4)[\-\s]*(?:stor(?:ey|y)|floor)\b", lambda _: 4),
            # X floors / storeys / levels
            (r"\b(\d+)[\-\s]*(?:floors?|stor(?:ey|y)s?|levels?)\b", lambda m: int(m.group(1))),
            (r"\b(one|two|three|four|five)[\-\s]*(?:floors?|stor(?:ey|y)s?|levels?)\b", lambda m: WORD_NUMBERS[m.group(1).lower()]),
            # Building-type shorthand. Lowest priority: used only when the user gave no explicit count.
            (r"\bbungalow\b", lambda _: 1),
            (r"\bduplex\b", lambda _: 2),
            (r"\btown\s*house\b|\btownhouse\b", lambda _: 3),
        ]
        for pat, fn in patterns:
            m = re.search(pat, text, re.I)
            if m:
                val = fn(m)
                if val > 0:
                    return val
        return None

    def extract_floors(
        self,
        text: str,
        target_floors: Optional[int],
        active_floor: Optional[int] = None,
        project_name: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> list[FloorRequirement]:
        """Extract per-floor room requirements cleanly without cross-floor pollution."""
        floors: dict[int, FloorRequirement] = {}

        # 1. Split text into floor sections
        floor_sections = self._split_floor_sections(text, project_name=project_name)

        bhk_rooms = self._expand_bhk(text)

        if floor_sections:
            for fn, section_text in sorted(floor_sections.items()):
                rooms = self._extract_rooms_from_text(section_text, project_name=project_name)
                # If Floor 1 has BHK mention and no explicit rooms, add BHK rooms
                if fn == 1 and bhk_rooms and not rooms:
                    rooms = bhk_rooms
                    bhk_rooms = []
                staircase_req = self._detect_staircase(section_text, fn, target_floors)
                floors[fn] = FloorRequirement(
                    floor_number=fn,
                    floor_name=self._floor_name(fn),
                    room_requirements=rooms,
                    staircase_required=staircase_req,
                    source="user",
                )
        else:
            # Single or unified description — respect active_floor if provided (e.g. from floor 2 card)
            target_fn = active_floor if (active_floor and active_floor > 1) else 1
            rooms = self._extract_rooms_from_text(text, project_name=project_name)
            if bhk_rooms and not rooms:
                rooms = bhk_rooms
                bhk_rooms = []
            elif bhk_rooms:
                existing_types = {r.room_type for r in rooms}
                for br in bhk_rooms:
                    if br.room_type not in existing_types:
                        rooms.append(br)
            staircase_req = self._detect_staircase(text, target_fn, target_floors)
            floors[target_fn] = FloorRequirement(
                floor_number=target_fn,
                floor_name=self._floor_name(target_fn),
                room_requirements=rooms,
                staircase_required=staircase_req,
                source="user",
            )

        # Multi-floor requirement gating safeguard:
        # If target_floors > detected floors, create empty shell FloorRequirement
        # so the Completeness Gate can detect that floor k is missing rooms.
        # NEVER invent rooms for missing floors!
        effective_floors = target_floors or (max(floors.keys()) if floors else 1)
        for fn in range(1, effective_floors + 1):
            if fn not in floors:
                floors[fn] = FloorRequirement(
                    floor_number=fn,
                    floor_name=self._floor_name(fn),
                    room_requirements=[],  # Empty! No rooms invented!
                    staircase_required=(fn > 1 or effective_floors > 1),
                    source="user",
                )

        # Ensure staircase is required on all floors when multi-floor
        if len(floors) > 1 or (target_floors and target_floors > 1):
            for fn, fr in floors.items():
                if fn > 1 or target_floors and target_floors > 1:
                    fr.staircase_required = True

        return sorted(floors.values(), key=lambda f: f.floor_number)

    def _split_floor_sections(self, text: str, project_name: Optional[str] = None) -> dict[int, str]:
        """Split text into floor-labeled sections.

        Supports:
        'Ground Floor:', 'Floor 1:', '1st Floor:', 'First Floor:',
        'Floor 2:', '2nd Floor:', 'Second Floor:', 'Upper Floor:', 'Upstairs:', etc.
        Fixes regression bugs:
        - Ordinal floors ('1st floor', '2nd floor') do not crash.
        - Text before the first floor header is preserved as Floor 1 ONLY if it contains actual rooms
          and is not just project metadata (e.g. project title, plot dimensions).
        """
        # Header regex matching various floor labels at start of line or sentence
        header_pat = re.compile(
            r"(?:^|[;\n\.\b])\s*"
            r"(?:"
            r"(?:floor\s+(\d+))"  # Floor 1
            r"|(?:(\d+)(?:st|nd|rd|th)\s+floor)"  # 1st floor, 2nd floor
            r"|(?:(ground|first|second|third|fourth|fifth|lower|upper|top)\s+floor)"  # Ground floor
            r"|(?:(ground|upstairs|downstairs))"
            r")"
            r"\s*[:\-\—]?\s*",
            re.I,
        )

        matches = list(header_pat.finditer(text))
        if not matches:
            return {}

        sections: dict[int, str] = {}

        # If text precedes the first match, verify it contains actual room requirements before assigning to Floor 1
        first_match = matches[0]
        if first_match.start() > 0:
            pre_text = text[:first_match.start()].strip()
            if pre_text:
                candidate_rooms = self._extract_rooms_from_text(pre_text, project_name=project_name)
                if candidate_rooms:
                    sections[1] = pre_text

        for i, m in enumerate(matches):
            fn = self._match_floor_number(m)
            if fn is None:
                continue
            start_pos = m.end()
            end_pos = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else len(text)
            body = text[start_pos:end_pos].strip()

            if fn in sections:
                sections[fn] = f"{sections[fn]}\n{body}".strip()
            else:
                sections[fn] = body

        return sections

    def _match_floor_number(self, m: re.Match) -> Optional[int]:
        """Resolve regex groups into integer floor number."""
        for g in m.groups():
            if not g:
                continue
            token = g.strip().lower()
            res = self.normalizer.normalize_floor_number(token)
            if res is not None:
                return res
        return None

    def _detect_staircase(self, text: str, floor_num: int, target_floors: Optional[int]) -> bool:
        """Detect if staircase is explicitly requested or required by floor level."""
        if target_floors and target_floors > 1:
            return True
        if floor_num > 1:
            return True
        if re.search(r"\b(?:staircase|stairs?|internal\s+stairs?)\b", text, re.I):
            return True
        return False

    @staticmethod
    def _floor_name(floor_number: int) -> str:
        names = {1: "Ground Floor", 2: "First Floor", 3: "Second Floor", 4: "Third Floor"}
        return names.get(floor_number, f"Floor {floor_number}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Room Extraction & Area Isolation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _extract_rooms_from_text(
        self,
        text: str,
        project_name: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> list[RoomRequirement]:
        """Extract rooms with isolated area, counts, attachments, and adjacencies.

        Fixes Bug 2: Multiple rooms do NOT inherit the first room's area!
        Each room's area is extracted strictly within its own sentence/line/clause.
        Separates project metadata (e.g. project title) from actual room requirements.
        """
        rooms: dict[str, RoomRequirement] = {}

        # Split text into lines/clauses to prevent area bleeding across lines
        clauses = re.split(r"[\n;]|(?<!\d)\.(?!\d)", text)

        # Build sorted list of synonym phrases (longer first)
        sorted_synonyms = sorted(ROOM_SYNONYMS.keys(), key=len, reverse=True)

        for clause in clauses:
            clause_str = clause.strip()
            if not clause_str:
                continue

            # Task 7: Separate project metadata from actual room requirements
            clean_clause = clause_str.strip().lower()
            if re.match(r"^(?:project(?:\s*name)?\s*:|title\s*:)", clean_clause):
                continue
            if project_name:
                p_lower = project_name.strip().lower()
                if clean_clause == p_lower or clean_clause == f"project: {p_lower}":
                    continue

            # Check for attached bathroom pattern within this clause
            attached_bath = False
            if re.search(r"\battached\s+(?:bath(?:room)?|toilet|washroom|wc)\b", clause_str, re.I):
                attached_bath = True

            occupied_spans: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
            clause_extracted_types: list[str] = []

            for phrase in sorted_synonyms:
                canonical = ROOM_SYNONYMS[phrase]

                # Plural-aware pattern
                if phrase.endswith("y") and len(phrase) > 1 and phrase[-2] not in "aeiou":
                    p_esc = re.escape(phrase[:-1]) + r"(?:y|ies)"
                elif phrase.endswith(("ch", "sh", "s", "x")):
                    p_esc = re.escape(phrase) + r"(?:es|s)?"
                else:
                    p_esc = re.escape(phrase) + r"s?"

                pattern = re.compile(
                    rf"(?:(\d+|{'|'.join(WORD_NUMBERS.keys())})\s+)?"
                    rf"\b{p_esc}\b"
                    rf"(?:\s+(\d+))?",
                    re.I,
                )
                for m in pattern.finditer(clause_str):
                    m_start, m_end = m.span()
                    if any(not (m_end <= o_start or m_start >= o_end) for o_start, o_end in occupied_spans):
                        continue

                    occupied_spans.append((m_start, m_end))
                    count = self.normalizer.normalize_count(m.group(1) or m.group(2))

                    # Extract area and explicit dimensions ONLY within this specific clause/line
                    min_a, pref_a, max_a, user_d = self._extract_room_areas_from_clause(clause_str, m.start(), m.end())

                    clause_extracted_types.append(canonical)

                    if canonical in rooms:
                        # Increment or take max count if mentioned again
                        rooms[canonical].min_count = max(rooms[canonical].min_count, count)
                        if rooms[canonical].max_count is not None:
                            rooms[canonical].max_count = max(rooms[canonical].max_count, count)
                        if pref_a and rooms[canonical].preferred_area_sqm is None:
                            rooms[canonical].preferred_area_sqm = pref_a
                        if min_a and rooms[canonical].min_area_sqm is None:
                            rooms[canonical].min_area_sqm = min_a
                        if max_a and rooms[canonical].max_area_sqm is None:
                            rooms[canonical].max_area_sqm = max_a
                        if user_d and rooms[canonical].user_dimensions is None:
                            rooms[canonical].user_dimensions = user_d
                    else:
                        rr = RoomRequirement(
                            room_type=canonical,
                            min_count=count,
                            max_count=count,
                            min_area_sqm=min_a,
                            preferred_area_sqm=pref_a,
                            max_area_sqm=max_a,
                            user_dimensions=user_d,
                            description=clause_str,
                            source="user",
                        )
                        rooms[canonical] = rr

                    # If this room was a master bedroom and clause had attached bathroom
                    if canonical == "master_bedroom" and attached_bath:
                        rr.adjacency.append("bathroom")

            # Check explicit in-clause parenthesized relationships (e.g. "- 1 Bedroom (adjacent to Bathroom)")
            if clause_extracted_types and "(" in clause_str and ")" in clause_str:
                paren_content = clause_str[clause_str.find("(")+1 : clause_str.rfind(")")]
                for cr_type in clause_extracted_types:
                    rr = rooms[cr_type]
                    # Adjacency
                    for adj_m in re.finditer(r"(?:adjacent\s+to|next\s+to|near)\s+([A-Za-z_\s]+?)(?:[,\.;]|$|\band\b)", paren_content, re.I):
                        target = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(adj_m.group(1).strip().strip("()-_"))
                        if target and target != cr_type and target not in rr.adjacency:
                            rr.adjacency.append(target)
                    # Separation
                    for sep_m in re.finditer(r"(?:separate\s+from|away\s+from|far\s+from)\s+([A-Za-z_\s]+?)(?:[,\.;]|$|\band\b)", paren_content, re.I):
                        target = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(sep_m.group(1).strip().strip("()-_"))
                        if target and target != cr_type and target not in rr.separation:
                            rr.separation.append(target)
                    # Attached to
                    for att_m in re.finditer(r"attached\s+to\s+([A-Za-z_\s]+?)(?:[,\.;]|$|\band\b)", paren_content, re.I):
                        target = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(att_m.group(1).strip().strip("()-_"))
                        if target and target != cr_type:
                            rr.attached_to = target
                            if target in rooms and cr_type not in rooms[target].adjacency:
                                rooms[target].adjacency.append(cr_type)

        # Second pass: If attached bath was mentioned, create or update bathroom with attached_to
        if re.search(r"\battached\s+(?:bath(?:room)?|toilet|washroom)\b", text, re.I):
            # Find parent room (default master_bedroom or bedroom)
            parent = "master_bedroom" if "master_bedroom" in rooms else ("bedroom" if "bedroom" in rooms else None)
            if "bathroom" in rooms:
                rooms["bathroom"].attached_to = parent
                if parent and "bathroom" not in rooms[parent].adjacency:
                    rooms[parent].adjacency.append("bathroom")
            else:
                rooms["bathroom"] = RoomRequirement(
                    room_type="bathroom",
                    min_count=1,
                    max_count=1,
                    attached_to=parent,
                    source="user",
                )
                if parent and "bathroom" not in rooms[parent].adjacency:
                    rooms[parent].adjacency.append("bathroom")

        # Third pass: Adjacency and separation across clauses
        self._apply_relationships(text, rooms)

        return list(rooms.values())

    def _extract_room_areas_from_clause(
        self, clause: str, match_start: int, match_end: int
    ) -> tuple[Optional[float], Optional[float], Optional[float], Optional[tuple[float, float]]]:
        """Extract min, preferred, max areas and explicit dimensions strictly from within the clause."""
        user_dims: Optional[tuple[float, float]] = None

        # Check explicit dimensions: e.g. "4m x 3.5m", "4m by 3.5m", "12ft x 14ft", "12 x 14 ft"
        if not re.search(r"\b(?:plot|site|land|ground|setback)\b", clause, re.I):
            dim_pat = re.compile(
                r"([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(m|meters?|ft|feet|'|\u2019)?\s*(?:x|by|\*)\s*([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(m|meters?|ft|feet|'|\u2019)?",
                re.I,
            )
            dm = dim_pat.search(clause)
            if dm:
                raw_w, u_w, raw_l, u_l = dm.group(1), dm.group(2), dm.group(3), dm.group(4)
                unit_w = u_w or u_l or "m"
                unit_l = u_l or u_w or "m"
                w_val = parse_dimension_m(f"{raw_w} {unit_w}".strip())
                l_val = parse_dimension_m(f"{raw_l} {unit_l}".strip())
                if w_val and l_val and w_val > 0 and l_val > 0:
                    user_dims = (round(w_val, 2), round(l_val, 2))

        # Range check: "100 to 150 sq ft", "between 100 and 150 sq ft"
        range_pat = re.compile(
            r"(?:between\s+)?([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:-|to|and)\s*([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*"
            r"(sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|ft[²2]|sqm|sq\.?\s*m|m[²2])",
            re.I,
        )
        rm = range_pat.search(clause)
        if rm:
            v1_raw = rm.group(1)
            v2_raw = rm.group(2)
            unit = rm.group(3)
            a1 = parse_area_sqm(f"{v1_raw} {unit}")
            a2 = parse_area_sqm(f"{v2_raw} {unit}")
            if a1 and a2:
                min_a = min(a1, a2)
                max_a = max(a1, a2)
                pref_a = round((min_a + max_a) / 2.0, 3)
                return (round(min_a, 3), pref_a, round(max_a, 3), user_dims)

        # Min area check: "min 100 sq ft", "at least 100 sq ft"
        min_pat = re.compile(
            r"(?:min|minimum|at\s+least)\s*[:\s]*([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|ft[²2]|sqm|sq\.?\s*m|m[²2]))",
            re.I,
        )
        min_m = min_pat.search(clause)
        min_val = parse_area_sqm(min_m.group(1)) if min_m else None

        # Max area check: "max 200 sq ft", "up to 200 sq ft"
        max_pat = re.compile(
            r"(?:max|maximum|up\s+to|at\s+most)\s*[:\s]*([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|ft[²2]|sqm|sq\.?\s*m|m[²2]))",
            re.I,
        )
        max_m = max_pat.search(clause)
        max_val = parse_area_sqm(max_m.group(1)) if max_m else None

        # Exact / preferred area: e.g. "150 sq ft", "preferred 150 sq ft"
        single_pat = re.compile(
            r"([\d]+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|ft[²2]|sqm|sq\.?\s*m|m[²2]))",
            re.I,
        )
        single_m = single_pat.search(clause)
        pref_val = parse_area_sqm(single_m.group(1)) if single_m else None

        # If explicit dimensions were provided and no explicit area was given, derive preferred area
        if user_dims is not None and pref_val is None:
            pref_val = round(user_dims[0] * user_dims[1], 2)

        # Clean roundings
        if min_val:
            min_val = round(min_val, 3)
        if max_val:
            max_val = round(max_val, 3)
        if pref_val:
            pref_val = round(pref_val, 3)

        return (min_val, pref_val, max_val, user_dims)

    def _expand_bhk(self, text: str) -> list[RoomRequirement]:
        """Expand BHK shorthand notation (e.g. 3BHK) without inventing non-BHK rooms."""
        m = re.search(r"\b(\d+)\s*[-\s]?BHK\b", text, re.I)
        if not m:
            return []
        count = int(m.group(1))
        desc = f"Expanded from {count}BHK shorthand: {count} bedrooms, 1 living room, 1 kitchen"
        return [
            RoomRequirement(room_type="bedroom", min_count=count, max_count=count, description=desc, source="user"),
            RoomRequirement(room_type="living", min_count=1, max_count=1, description=desc, source="user"),
            RoomRequirement(room_type="kitchen", min_count=1, max_count=1, description=desc, source="user"),
        ]

    def _apply_relationships(self, text: str, rooms: dict[str, RoomRequirement]) -> None:
        """Extract required/preferred adjacency and separation."""
        # Adjacency
        adj_pattern = re.compile(
            r"(\w[\w\s]*?)\s+(?:(?:must\s+be|should\s+be|is|needs\s+to\s+be)\s+)?(?:next\s+to|adjacent\s+to|near|connected?\s+to|beside|alongside|attached\s+to)\s+"
            r"(?:the\s+)?(\w[\w\s]*?)(?:[,\.;\)]|$|\band\b)",
            re.I,
        )
        for m in adj_pattern.finditer(text):
            r1 = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(m.group(1).strip().strip("()-_"))
            r2 = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(m.group(2).strip().strip("()-_"))
            if r1 and r2 and r1 != r2:
                if r1 in rooms and r2 not in rooms[r1].adjacency:
                    rooms[r1].adjacency.append(r2)
                if r2 in rooms and r1 not in rooms[r2].adjacency:
                    rooms[r2].adjacency.append(r1)

        # Separation
        sep_pattern = re.compile(
            r"(\w[\w\s]*?)\s+(?:(?:must\s+be|should\s+be|is|needs\s+to\s+be)\s+)?(?:away\s+from|separate\s+from|not\s+near|far\s+from|separated?\s+from)\s+"
            r"(?:the\s+)?(\w[\w\s]*?)(?:[,\.;\)]|$|\band\b)",
            re.I,
        )
        for m in sep_pattern.finditer(text):
            r1 = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(m.group(1).strip().strip("()-_"))
            r2 = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(m.group(2).strip().strip("()-_"))
            if r1 and r2 and r1 != r2:
                if r1 in rooms and r2 not in rooms[r1].separation:
                    rooms[r1].separation.append(r2)
                if r2 in rooms and r1 not in rooms[r2].separation:
                    rooms[r2].separation.append(r1)

"""Requirement Pipeline — executes the sequential requirement processing flow.

Pipeline:
RAW USER INPUT
      ↓
INPUT PARSING (RequirementParser)
      ↓
STRUCTURED REQUIREMENTS (Requirements, FloorRequirement, RoomRequirement)
      ↓
NORMALIZATION (RequirementNormalizer)
      ↓
COMPLETENESS CHECK & MULTI-FLOOR GATING (CompletenessGate)
      ↓
REQUIREMENT VALIDATION (RequirementValidator)
      ↓
READY FOR PLANNING (Planning-compatible Output)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Optional

from app.models.requirements import Requirements, FloorRequirement, RoomRequirement
from app.agents.requirement_agent.parser import RequirementParser
from app.agents.requirement_agent.normalizer import RequirementNormalizer
from app.agents.requirement_agent.completeness_gate import (
    CompletenessGate,
    CompletenessResult,
    STATUS_COMPLETE,
    STATUS_INCOMPLETE,
    STATUS_AMBIGUOUS,
    STATUS_INVALID,
)
from app.agents.requirement_agent.validator import RequirementValidator, RequirementValidationResult


@dataclass
class PipelineResult:
    """Consolidated result of the requirement pipeline."""
    requirements: Requirements
    completeness: CompletenessResult
    validation: RequirementValidationResult
    can_proceed_to_planning: bool
    status: str  # "READY_FOR_PLANNING", "NEEDS_CLARIFICATION", "INVALID", "VALIDATION_FAILED"

    def summary(self) -> str:
        """Human-readable diagnostic summary for explainability."""
        lines = [f"Status: {self.status}"]
        if self.can_proceed_to_planning:
            lines.append("Requirements are complete and valid. Ready for Planning Agent.")
        else:
            if not self.completeness.is_complete:
                lines.append(f"Missing required items: {', '.join(self.completeness.missing_fields)}")
                if self.completeness.missing_floors:
                    lines.append(f"Missing room specs for floors: {self.completeness.missing_floors}")
            if not self.validation.is_valid:
                lines.append(f"Validation errors ({len(self.validation.errors)}):")
                for err in self.validation.errors:
                    lines.append(f"  - [{err.field}] {err.message}")
        return "\n".join(lines)


class RequirementPipeline:
    """Orchestrates parsing, normalization, completeness gating, and validation."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.parser = RequirementParser()
        self.normalizer = RequirementNormalizer()
        self.completeness_gate = CompletenessGate()
        self.validator = RequirementValidator()

    def process(
        self,
        user_input: str,
        project_name: str = "PlanForge Project",
        allow_suggestions: bool = False,
    ) -> PipelineResult:
        """Run the end-to-end requirement pipeline on user input."""
        # 1. Parsing
        reqs = self.parser.parse(user_input, project_name=project_name)

        # 2. Normalization pass
        self._normalize_requirements(reqs)

        # 3. Completeness check with multi-floor gating
        comp_res = self.completeness_gate.check(reqs, allow_suggestions=allow_suggestions)

        # 4. Semantic validation
        val_res = self.validator.validate(reqs)

        # 5. Overall status
        can_proceed = comp_res.can_proceed and val_res.is_valid

        if not val_res.is_valid:
            status = "VALIDATION_FAILED"
        elif not comp_res.is_complete:
            status = "NEEDS_CLARIFICATION" if comp_res.status == STATUS_INCOMPLETE else comp_res.status
        else:
            status = "READY_FOR_PLANNING"

        return PipelineResult(
            requirements=reqs,
            completeness=comp_res,
            validation=val_res,
            can_proceed_to_planning=can_proceed,
            status=status,
        )

    def update(
        self,
        existing: Requirements,
        additional_input: str,
        allow_suggestions: bool = False,
        active_floor: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> PipelineResult:
        """Incrementally update existing requirements with additional user input (multi-turn).

        Preserves existing valid rooms and floors while incorporating new clarifications.
        """
        new_reqs = self.parser.parse(
            additional_input,
            project_name=existing.project_name,
            active_floor=active_floor,
        )

        # Merge plot
        if new_reqs.plot_shape:
            existing.plot_shape = new_reqs.plot_shape
            existing.plot_dimensions = None
            if new_reqs.plot_area_sqm:
                existing.plot_area_sqm = new_reqs.plot_area_sqm
        elif new_reqs.plot_dimensions:
            existing.plot_dimensions = new_reqs.plot_dimensions
            existing.plot_area_sqm = new_reqs.plot_area_sqm
        elif new_reqs.plot_area_sqm and not existing.plot_area_sqm:
            existing.plot_area_sqm = new_reqs.plot_area_sqm

        if new_reqs.orientation:
            existing.orientation = new_reqs.orientation
        if new_reqs.entrance_facing:
            existing.entrance_facing = new_reqs.entrance_facing
        if new_reqs.setbacks:
            existing.setbacks.update(new_reqs.setbacks)
        if new_reqs.target_floors:
            existing.target_floors = new_reqs.target_floors

        # Merge floors
        for nf in new_reqs.floors:
            if not nf.room_requirements:
                continue
            effective_fn = (
                active_floor
                if (active_floor and active_floor > 1 and len(new_reqs.floors) == 1 and nf.floor_number == 1)
                else nf.floor_number
            )
            existing_f = existing.get_floor(effective_fn)
            if existing_f:
                # Add or update rooms
                existing_types = {r.room_type: r for r in existing_f.room_requirements}
                for nr in nf.room_requirements:
                    if nr.room_type in existing_types:
                        # Update counts/areas
                        er = existing_types[nr.room_type]
                        er.min_count = max(er.min_count, nr.min_count)
                        if nr.preferred_area_sqm:
                            er.preferred_area_sqm = nr.preferred_area_sqm
                        if nr.min_area_sqm:
                            er.min_area_sqm = nr.min_area_sqm
                        if nr.max_area_sqm:
                            er.max_area_sqm = nr.max_area_sqm
                        if nr.user_dimensions:
                            er.user_dimensions = nr.user_dimensions
                        if nr.adjacency:
                            for a in nr.adjacency:
                                if a not in er.adjacency:
                                    er.adjacency.append(a)
                        if nr.separation:
                            for s in nr.separation:
                                if s not in er.separation:
                                    er.separation.append(s)
                        if nr.attached_to:
                            er.attached_to = nr.attached_to
                    else:
                        existing_f.room_requirements.append(nr)
            else:
                nf.floor_number = effective_fn
                nf.floor_name = self.parser._floor_name(effective_fn)
                existing.floors.append(nf)

        # Sort floors
        existing.floors.sort(key=lambda f: f.floor_number)
        existing.raw_input = f"{existing.raw_input}\n{additional_input}".strip()

        # Re-run pipeline checks
        self._normalize_requirements(existing)
        comp_res = self.completeness_gate.check(existing, allow_suggestions=allow_suggestions)
        val_res = self.validator.validate(existing)
        can_proceed = comp_res.can_proceed and val_res.is_valid

        status = "READY_FOR_PLANNING" if can_proceed else ("NEEDS_CLARIFICATION" if not comp_res.is_complete else "VALIDATION_FAILED")

        return PipelineResult(
            requirements=existing,
            completeness=comp_res,
            validation=val_res,
            can_proceed_to_planning=can_proceed,
            status=status,
        )

    def _normalize_requirements(self, reqs: Requirements) -> None:
        """Apply secondary normalization across all fields."""
        if reqs.orientation:
            reqs.orientation = self.normalizer.normalize_direction(reqs.orientation)
        if reqs.entrance_facing:
            reqs.entrance_facing = self.normalizer.normalize_direction(reqs.entrance_facing)

        for f in reqs.floors:
            for r in f.room_requirements:
                canonical = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(r.room_type)
                if canonical:
                    r.room_type = canonical
                # Clean relationships
                r.adjacency = [
                    self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(adj) or adj
                    for adj in r.adjacency
                    if adj != r.room_type
                ]
                r.separation = [
                    self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(sep) or sep
                    for sep in r.separation
                    if sep != r.room_type
                ]
                if r.attached_to:
                    r.attached_to = self.normalizer.canonical_room_type(r.attached_to) or r.attached_to
