"""Context-aware semantic intent understanding for the PlanForge chat.

Layering (cheapest and most reliable first):

1. **Deterministic rules** that use the conversation state (pending question, stage, whether a
   design already exists) -- instant, free, unit-testable.
2. **Optional LLM classification**, used only when the rules cannot decide (``AMBIGUOUS_REQUEST``)
   *and* a real provider is configured. The model must return JSON; the result is validated
   against the ``ConversationIntent`` enum and a confidence threshold before it is trusted.
   If the LLM is unavailable (mock/offline, timeout, bad JSON) the deterministic result stands.

The classifier never mutates requirements or triggers actions: it only labels the message.
Actions are validated separately by the orchestrator.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from app.chat.intent import (
    ChatIntent,
    IntentDecision,
    _COUNTED_ROOM_RE,
    _DIMS_RE,
    _GREETING_RE,
    _PLOT_FLOOR_RE,
    _QUESTION_START_RE,
    _ROOM_RE,
    _normalize,
)
from app.chat.schema import ConversationIntent as CI
from app.chat.state import ConversationState
from app.llm.response_parser import LLMResponseParser

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Patterns
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_GENERATE_COMMANDS = frozenset({"generate floor plan", "generate", "\u2713 generate floor plan", "generate the floor plan"})
_EDIT_COMMANDS = frozenset({"edit requirements", "\u270f edit requirements", "edit", "modify"})

_AFFIRM_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(?:yes|yeah|yep|yup|sure|ok|okay|go\s+ahead|proceed|do\s+it|please\s+do|sounds\s+good|"
    r"looks\s+good|confirm(?:ed)?|let'?s\s+(?:go|do\s+it))(?:\s+(?:please|generate|go\s+ahead|proceed))?\s*[!.]*$"
)

_EXPORT_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:export|exports|download|save\s+(?:as|to)|dxf|svg|png|autocad|cad\s+(?:file|drawing)|zip|json)\b"
)
_VALIDATION_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:valid(?:ate|ation|ity)?|complian(?:t|ce)|building\s+codes?|violations?|errors?|warnings?|"
    r"feasib(?:le|ility)|(?:does|will|would)\s+(?:it|this)\s+(?:pass|work|fit)|"
    r"is\s+(?:it|this)\s+(?:ok|okay|correct|fine|safe))\b"
)
_STATUS_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:progress|status|how\s+long|how\s+far|still\s+(?:running|generating|working)|"
    r"is\s+(?:it|the\s+(?:plan|generation))\s+(?:done|ready|finished|complete)|"
    r"are\s+you\s+(?:done|finished)|what(?:'s|\s+is)\s+happening|eta)\b"
)
_SUMMARY_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:summary|summari[sz]e|recap|current\s+requirements|what\s+(?:do\s+you|have\s+you)\s+(?:have|got|recorded|saved)|"
    r"what\s+have\s+i\s+(?:told|given|said|entered)|show\s+(?:me\s+)?(?:my\s+|the\s+)?requirements|"
    r"what(?:'s|\s+is)\s+(?:my|the)\s+(?:project|plan|requirements?)\s+so\s+far|so\s+far)\b"
)
_GENERATE_VERB_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:generate|create|build|make|produce|draw|start\s+generat\w*|run\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:generation|pipeline))\b"
)
_PLAN_NOUN_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:floor\s*plans?|plans?|layouts?|designs?)\b")
_POLITE_GENERATE_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:please\s+)?(?:can|could|would|will)\s+you\s+(?:please\s+)?generate\b")

_CAPABILITY_RE = re.compile(
    r"\bwhat\s+(?:can|could|do)\s+you\s+(?:do|build|design|make|create|help|offer|support)\b|"
    r"\bwhat\s+(?:are\s+)?(?:the\s+)?(?:things|types|kinds|sorts)\b.*\b(?:build|design|make|create|do|support)\b|"
    r"\bthings\s+you\s+can\b|"
    r"\bwhat\s+(?:is|are)\s+(?:planforge|you)\b|\bwho\s+are\s+you\b|\babout\s+planforge\b|"
    r"\b(?:your|planforge'?s?)\s+(?:capabilit(?:y|ies)|features)\b|"
    r"\bhow\s+does\s+(?:this|planforge|it)\s+work\b|"
    r"\bwhat\s+can\s+i\s+(?:ask|do|build|design)\b|^help\b"
)
_POLITE_CAPABILITY_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(?:please\s+)?(?:can|could|would|do)\s+you\s+(?:help|design|build|make|create|support|do)\b"
)

_CORRECTION_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:actually|instead|rather|change|update|correct(?:ion)?|make\s+it|should\s+be|"
    r"no\s*,?\s+it'?s|sorry\s*,?|i\s+meant|replace|switch\s+to)\b"
)
_TYPE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:bungalow|duplex|town\s*house|custom\s+(?:residen\w*|home|house|layout|dimensions?)|"
    r"single[- ]floor|two[- ]floor|three[- ]floor|single[- ]stor(?:e)?y)\b"
)
_DOMAIN_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:house|home|residen\w*|villa|apartment|flat|building|project|plot|site|land|floors?|storeys?|"
    r"rooms?|bedrooms?|bathrooms?|kitchen|living|bhk|construct\w*|design(?:ing)?|build(?:ing)?|plan)\b"
)
_ARCH_TOPIC_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:vastu|ventilation|natural\s+light|daylight|setbacks?|fsi|far|circulation|staircase|stairs?|"
    r"orientation|facing|bedroom|kitchen|bathroom|living|dining|room\s+size|minimum|standard|"
    r"building\s+codes?|zoning|structure|load[- ]bearing|column|beam|plumbing|wet\s+areas?)\b"
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IntentResult:
    """Outcome of intent classification."""

    intent: CI
    confidence: float
    reason: str
    source: str = "rules"           # "rules" | "llm"


def _signals(norm: str) -> Dict[str, bool]:
    return {
        "dims": bool(_DIMS_RE.search(norm)),
        "plot_floor": bool(_PLOT_FLOOR_RE.search(norm)),
        "counted_room": bool(_COUNTED_ROOM_RE.search(norm)),
        "room": bool(_ROOM_RE.search(norm)),
    }


def classify_conversation_intent(
    message: str,
    state: Optional[ConversationState] = None,
    *,
    source: str = "text",
    legacy: Optional[IntentDecision] = None,
) -> IntentResult:
    """Deterministic, state-aware intent classification."""
    raw = message or ""
    norm = _normalize(raw)
    pending = state.pending_field if state else None
    has_brief = bool(state and state.has_requirements)
    has_design = bool(state and state.has_generated_design)

    # 1. Card answers are always structured turns -------------------------------------------
    if source == "card":
        if "generate floor plan" in norm:
            return IntentResult(CI.GENERATE_FLOOR_PLAN, 0.99, "card_generate")
        if "edit requirements" in norm:
            return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_CORRECTION, 0.95, "card_edit")
        if _TYPE_RE.search(norm) and pending in (None, "project_type"):
            return IntentResult(CI.PROJECT_TYPE_SELECTION, 0.95, "card_project_type")
        if pending:
            return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_CLARIFICATION, 0.95, "card_answer")
        return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_INPUT, 0.9, "card_answer_no_pending")

    # 2. Empty message = conversation start -------------------------------------------------
    if not norm:
        return IntentResult(CI.GREETING, 0.99, "empty_initial_greeting")

    # 3. Explicit commands / confirmations ------------------------------------------------------
    if norm in _GENERATE_COMMANDS:
        return IntentResult(CI.GENERATE_FLOOR_PLAN, 0.99, "generate_command")
    if norm in _EDIT_COMMANDS:
        return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_CORRECTION, 0.95, "edit_command")
    if pending == "confirmation" and _AFFIRM_RE.match(norm):
        return IntentResult(CI.GENERATE_FLOOR_PLAN, 0.95, "confirmation_affirmed")
    if legacy is not None and legacy.reason == "plot_polygon_payload":
        return IntentResult(
            CI.REQUIREMENT_CLARIFICATION if pending == "plot_dimensions" else CI.REQUIREMENT_INPUT,
            0.95,
            "plot_polygon_payload",
        )

    sig = _signals(norm)
    structured = sig["dims"] or sig["plot_floor"] or sig["counted_room"]
    is_question = norm.endswith("?") or bool(_QUESTION_START_RE.match(norm))

    # 4. Operations on an existing project --------------------------------------------------------
    if _EXPORT_RE.search(norm) and not (structured and not is_question):
        return IntentResult(CI.EXPORT_REQUEST, 0.9, "export_keywords")
    if _VALIDATION_RE.search(norm) and not (sig["dims"] and not is_question):
        return IntentResult(CI.VALIDATION_QUERY, 0.85, "validation_keywords")
    if _STATUS_RE.search(norm):
        return IntentResult(CI.PROJECT_STATUS, 0.85, "status_keywords")
    if _SUMMARY_RE.search(norm):
        return IntentResult(CI.PROJECT_SUMMARY, 0.85, "summary_keywords")
    if _GENERATE_VERB_RE.search(norm) and _PLAN_NOUN_RE.search(norm) and not structured:
        if is_question and _POLITE_GENERATE_RE.match(norm) and not has_brief:
            return IntentResult(CI.CAPABILITY_QUERY, 0.7, "polite_generate_without_project")
        return IntentResult(CI.GENERATE_FLOOR_PLAN, 0.85, "generate_verb_plan_noun")

    # 5. Casual conversation / capabilities ----------------------------------------------------------
    if _GREETING_RE.match(norm):
        return IntentResult(CI.GREETING, 0.95, "greeting_or_acknowledgement")
    if not structured and (_CAPABILITY_RE.search(norm) or (is_question and _POLITE_CAPABILITY_RE.match(norm))):
        return IntentResult(CI.CAPABILITY_QUERY, 0.9, "capability_phrasing")

    # 6. Delegation / removal / modification (reuse the proven legacy rules) ------------------
    if legacy is not None:
        if legacy.intent == ChatIntent.AGENT_DECIDE:
            return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_INPUT, 0.9, "agent_delegation")
        if legacy.intent == ChatIntent.REQUIREMENT_REMOVAL:
            return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_CORRECTION, 0.9, legacy.reason)
        if legacy.intent == ChatIntent.PLAN_MODIFICATION:
            return IntentResult(CI.DESIGN_MODIFICATION, 0.85, legacy.reason)

    # 7. Questions are answered, not turned into requirement turns ---------------------------------
    if is_question:
        if legacy is not None and legacy.reason == "polite_add_request":
            return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_INPUT, 0.8, "polite_add_request")
        if _ARCH_TOPIC_RE.search(norm) or legacy is None or legacy.intent == ChatIntent.CONVERSATION:
            return IntentResult(CI.GENERAL_ARCHITECTURAL_QUERY, 0.8, "question")

    # 8. Requirement corrections / project type / answers to the pending question -----------
    has_signal = structured or sig["room"]
    if has_brief and has_signal and _CORRECTION_RE.search(norm):
        return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_CORRECTION, 0.85, "correction_cue")
    if _TYPE_RE.search(norm) and not sig["dims"] and not sig["counted_room"]:
        if pending in ("target_floors", "project_type") or pending is None:
            return IntentResult(
                CI.REQUIREMENT_CLARIFICATION if pending == "target_floors" else CI.PROJECT_TYPE_SELECTION,
                0.85,
                "project_type_phrase",
            )
    if pending and not is_question:
        return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_CLARIFICATION, 0.8, f"answers_pending:{pending}")

    # 9. New requirement statements ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if has_signal or (legacy is not None and legacy.reason in ("requirement_statement", "polite_add_request")):
        return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_INPUT, 0.85, "requirement_signals")
    if _DOMAIN_RE.search(norm):
        return IntentResult(CI.REQUIREMENT_INPUT, 0.6, "domain_words_only")

    return IntentResult(CI.AMBIGUOUS_REQUEST, 0.3, "no_recognisable_signal")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional LLM-backed semantic classification (validated)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You classify one message sent to PlanForge AI, a residential floor-plan design assistant. "
    "Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {\"intent\": <one of the allowed intents>, \"confidence\": <0..1>}. "
    "Do not answer the message. Do not invent requirements."
)


def _build_llm_prompt(message: str, state: Optional[ConversationState]) -> str:
    allowed = ", ".join(i.value for i in CI)
    ctx = {
        "stage": state.stage.value if state else "DISCOVERY",
        "pending_question_field": state.pending_field if state else None,
        "has_requirements": bool(state and state.has_requirements),
        "has_generated_design": bool(state and state.has_generated_design),
        "last_assistant_question": (state.last_assistant_question if state else None),
    }
    return (
        f"Allowed intents: {allowed}\n"
        f"Conversation context: {json.dumps(ctx)}\n"
        f"User message: {message.strip()[:1000]}\n"
        "Return the JSON object now."
    )


def validate_llm_intent(data: Any, state: Optional[ConversationState]) -> Optional[IntentResult]:
    """Validate an LLM classification payload; return ``None`` if it must not be trusted."""
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return None
    try:
        intent = CI(str(data.get("intent", "")).strip().upper())
        confidence = float(data.get("confidence", 0.0))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None
    if not 0.0 <= confidence <= 1.0 or confidence < 0.6:
        return None
    if intent == CI.AMBIGUOUS_REQUEST:
        return None
    # Never let the model route to generation when there is nothing to generate.
    if intent == CI.GENERATE_FLOOR_PLAN and not (state and state.has_requirements):
        return None
    return IntentResult(intent, confidence, "llm_classification", source="llm")


class ConversationIntentClassifier:
    """Rules first; falls back to a validated LLM classification only when rules are unsure."""

    def classify(
        self,
        message: str,
        state: Optional[ConversationState] = None,
        *,
        source: str = "text",
        legacy: Optional[IntentDecision] = None,
        llm_service: Any = None,
        turn_id: str = "",
    ) -> IntentResult:
        result = classify_conversation_intent(message, state, source=source, legacy=legacy)
        if result.intent != CI.AMBIGUOUS_REQUEST or llm_service is None:
            return result
        try:
            llm = llm_service.generate_reply(
                prompt=_build_llm_prompt(message, state),
                system_prompt=_LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
                turn_id=turn_id,
                project_id=state.project_id if state else None,
                intent="intent_classification",
            )
            if not llm.ok:
                return result
            checked = validate_llm_intent(LLMResponseParser.parse_json(llm.text), state)
            return checked or result
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - classification must never break the chat
            return result

[79/252] FILE: app/chat/state.py
TYPE: py
================================================================================
"""Backend-owned conversation state for the PlanForge chat.

Conversation state (stage, collected requirements, the last question asked, the pending
clarification, last action, generation status, artifacts) lives here -- on the server --
instead of being inferred only from the visible chat transcript.

* ``ConversationStateStore`` is thread-safe, bounded (LRU) and expiring (TTL).
* If a request carries no ``conversation_id`` the state is *transient* (stateless legacy
  behaviour): it is seeded from the request and never stored.
* ``begin_generation`` / ``finish_generation`` give the generation endpoint an atomic,
  server-side lock so repeated clicks cannot start duplicate runs, and give the chat real
  generation status to report.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
import uuid
from collections import OrderedDict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from app.chat.schema import ConversationStage

GENERATION_IDLE = "idle"
GENERATION_RUNNING = "running"
GENERATION_COMPLETED = "completed"
GENERATION_FAILED = "failed"

#: A "running" flag older than this is treated as stale (crashed worker) and may be restarted.
GENERATION_STALE_SECONDS = 30 * 60


@dataclass
class ConversationState:
    """Structured, per-conversation project state."""

    conversation_id: str
    project_id: Optional[str] = None
    project_name: str = "PlanForge Residential Project"
    stage: ConversationStage = ConversationStage.DISCOVERY

    # Requirements ---------------------------------------------------------
    canonical_brief: str = ""                       # authoritative structured brief
    confirmed: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)   # progress item -> value
    missing: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)          # progress items still needed
    last_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None             # last requirements_summary dict

    # Dialogue -------------------------------------------------------------
    last_assistant_question: Optional[str] = None
    pending_field: Optional[str] = None             # field the last question asked for
    last_card_key: Optional[str] = None             # field_key of the last card actually shown
    last_intent: Optional[str] = None
    last_action: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    turn_count: int = 0

    # Generation / artifacts -----------------------------------------------
    generation_status: str = GENERATION_IDLE
    generation_started_at: Optional[float] = None
    generation_finished_at: Optional[float] = None
    generation_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    export_artifacts: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    design_stale: bool = False        # requirements changed after the last generated design

    updated_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def has_requirements(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.canonical_brief and self.canonical_brief.strip())

    @property
    def generation_running(self) -> bool:
        if self.generation_status != GENERATION_RUNNING:
            return False
        started = self.generation_started_at or 0.0
        return (time.time() - started) < GENERATION_STALE_SECONDS

    @property
    def has_generated_design(self) -> bool:
        return self.generation_status == GENERATION_COMPLETED and bool(self.project_id)

    def to_public_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Serializable snapshot (no secrets) for diagnostics and tests."""
        return {
            "conversation_id": self.conversation_id,
            "project_id": self.project_id,
            "stage": self.stage.value,
            "confirmed": dict(self.confirmed),
            "missing": list(self.missing),
            "last_assistant_question": self.last_assistant_question,
            "pending_field": self.pending_field,
            "last_intent": self.last_intent,
            "last_action": self.last_action,
            "generation_status": self.generation_status,
            "export_artifacts": list(self.export_artifacts),
            "turn_count": self.turn_count,
        }


class ConversationStateStore:
    """Thread-safe, bounded, expiring in-memory store of ``ConversationState``."""

    def __init__(self, max_entries: int = 500, ttl_seconds: float = 6 * 3600) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._states: "OrderedDict[str, ConversationState]" = OrderedDict()
        self._max = max(1, max_entries)
        self._ttl = ttl_seconds

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def new_id() -> str:
        return "conv_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]

    def _evict(self) -> None:
        now = time.time()
        for cid in [c for c, s in self._states.items() if now - s.updated_at > self._ttl and not s.generation_running]:
            self._states.pop(cid, None)
        while len(self._states) > self._max:
            self._states.popitem(last=False)

    def get(self, conversation_id: Optional[str]) -> Optional[ConversationState]:
        if not conversation_id:
            return None
        with self._lock:
            state = self._states.get(conversation_id)
            if state is not None:
                self._states.move_to_end(conversation_id)
            return state

    def get_or_create(
        self,
        conversation_id: Optional[str],
        *,
        seed_brief: str = "",
        project_name: str = "PlanForge Residential Project",
        project_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> ConversationState:
        """Return the stored state, or create one (transient when no id is supplied)."""
        if not conversation_id:
            return ConversationState(
                conversation_id="transient",
                project_id=project_id,
                project_name=project_name,
                canonical_brief=seed_brief or "",
            )
        with self._lock:
            state = self._states.get(conversation_id)
            if state is None:
                state = ConversationState(
                    conversation_id=conversation_id,
                    project_id=project_id,
                    project_name=project_name,
                    canonical_brief=seed_brief or "",   # restores state after a server restart
                )
                self._states[conversation_id] = state
                self._evict()
            else:
                self._states.move_to_end(conversation_id)
            return state

    def save(self, state: ConversationState) -> None:
        if state.conversation_id == "transient":
            return
        with self._lock:
            state.updated_at = time.time()
            self._states[state.conversation_id] = state
            self._states.move_to_end(state.conversation_id)
            self._evict()

    def delete(self, conversation_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return self._states.pop(conversation_id, None) is not None

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._states.clear()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Generation lifecycle (atomic; used by the /generate endpoint)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def begin_generation(
        self, conversation_id: str, project_id: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> Tuple[bool, ConversationState]:
        """Atomically mark generation as running. Returns ``(False, state)`` if already running."""
        with self._lock:
            state = self._states.get(conversation_id)
            if state is None:
                state = ConversationState(conversation_id=conversation_id)
                self._states[conversation_id] = state
            if state.generation_running:
                return False, state
            state.generation_status = GENERATION_RUNNING
            state.generation_started_at = time.time()
            state.generation_finished_at = None
            state.generation_result = None
            if project_id:
                state.project_id = project_id
            state.stage = ConversationStage.GENERATING
            state.updated_at = time.time()
            return True, state

    def finish_generation(
        self,
        conversation_id: str,
        *,
        ok: bool,
        project_id: Optional[str] = None,
        status: str = "",
        valid: Optional[bool] = None,
        error: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Optional[ConversationState]:
        """Record the real outcome reported by the pipeline."""
        with self._lock:
            state = self._states.get(conversation_id)
            if state is None:
                return None
            state.generation_status = GENERATION_COMPLETED if ok else GENERATION_FAILED
            state.generation_finished_at = time.time()
            if project_id:
                state.project_id = project_id
            state.generation_result = {
                "status": status,
                "is_valid": valid,
                "error": error,
                "project_id": state.project_id,
            }
            if ok:
                state.design_stale = False
            state.stage = ConversationStage.REVIEWING_DESIGN if ok else ConversationStage.READY_TO_GENERATE
            state.updated_at = time.time()
            return state


#: Process-wide store shared by the chat route and the generation route.
conversation_store = ConversationStateStore()

"""Controlled ablation study framework for PlanForge research evaluation.

Strict Experimental Control Invariants:
1. Input brief, plot boundary, setbacks, and room requirements remain 100% constant across variants.
2. Mock LLM configuration, random seed, and validation rules remain 100% identical.
3. Only the specific isolated factor (ASAA allocator, Refinement loop, or Diversity count) is altered.
4. Outputs are captured side-by-side without contamination of production components.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from app.evaluation.baselines import BaselineSpatialAllocator
from app.evaluation.models import AblationResult, BenchmarkCase
from app.orchestration.config import OrchestrationConfig
from app.orchestration.orchestrator import PlanForgeOrchestrator
from app.orchestration.pipeline import PipelineResult


class AblationStudyCoordinator:
    """Orchestrates controlled ablation experiments across PlanForge variants."""

    def __init__(self, seed: int = 42) -> None:
        self.seed = seed

    def evaluate_asaa_ablation(
        self,
        case: BenchmarkCase,
        full_orchestrator: PlanForgeOrchestrator,
        baseline_allocator: Optional[BaselineSpatialAllocator] = None,
        output_dir: str = "results/ablation/asaa",
    ) -> AblationResult:
        """Ablation B: Full PlanForge (with ASAA) vs Without ASAA (Baseline Proportional Slice).

        Keeps downstream Architectural LLM, Geometry Engine, and Validator identical.
        """
        b_alloc = baseline_allocator or BaselineSpatialAllocator()

        # Build baseline orchestrator with identical downstream components but baseline allocator
        baseline_orchestrator = PlanForgeOrchestrator(
            requirement_agent=full_orchestrator.requirement_agent,
            planning_agent=full_orchestrator.planning_agent,
            asaa_allocator=b_alloc,  # Replaced component
            architectural_agent=full_orchestrator.architectural_agent,
            geometry_engine=full_orchestrator.geometry_engine,
            validator=full_orchestrator.validator,
            refinement_loop=full_orchestrator.refinement_loop,
        )

        cfg = OrchestrationConfig(
            output_dir=output_dir,
            enable_refinement=False,  # Isolate pure allocation impact without refinement compensation
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        pname = f"{case.name}_Ablation_ASAA"
        res_full = full_orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=pname, config=cfg)
        res_baseline = baseline_orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=pname, config=cfg)

        metrics_full = self._extract_key_metrics(res_full)
        metrics_base = self._extract_key_metrics(res_baseline)

        deltas = {}
        for k in metrics_full:
            if isinstance(metrics_full[k], (int, float)) and isinstance(metrics_base.get(k), (int, float)):
                deltas[f"{k}_delta"] = round(float(metrics_full[k]) - float(metrics_base[k]), 4)

        return AblationResult(
            ablation_id=f"ablation_asaa_{case.case_id}",
            case_id=case.case_id,
            variant_a_name="Full_PlanForge_ASAA",
            variant_a_metrics=metrics_full,
            variant_b_name="Without_ASAA_Baseline",
            variant_b_metrics=metrics_base,
            deltas=deltas,
        )

    def evaluate_refinement_ablation(
        self,
        case: BenchmarkCase,
        orchestrator: PlanForgeOrchestrator,
        output_dir: str = "results/ablation/refinement",
    ) -> AblationResult:
        """Ablation C: With Refinement vs Without Refinement.

        Keeps requirements, planning, allocation, and initial architectural design identical.
        """
        cfg_with = OrchestrationConfig(
            output_dir=output_dir,
            enable_refinement=True,
            max_refinement_iterations=3,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        cfg_without = OrchestrationConfig(
            output_dir=output_dir,
            enable_refinement=False,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        res_with = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_With_Refinement", config=cfg_with)
        res_without = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Without_Refinement", config=cfg_without)

        metrics_with = self._extract_key_metrics(res_with)
        metrics_without = self._extract_key_metrics(res_without)

        # Refinement specific metrics
        err_with = metrics_with.get("validation_error_count", 0)
        err_without = metrics_without.get("validation_error_count", 0)
        err_reduction = err_without - err_with

        deltas = {
            "error_reduction": float(err_reduction),
            "validity_gain": 1.0 if (metrics_with.get("overall_valid") and not metrics_without.get("overall_valid")) else 0.0,
        }

        return AblationResult(
            ablation_id=f"ablation_refinement_{case.case_id}",
            case_id=case.case_id,
            variant_a_name="With_Refinement",
            variant_a_metrics=metrics_with,
            variant_b_name="Without_Refinement",
            variant_b_metrics=metrics_without,
            deltas=deltas,
        )

    def evaluate_diversity_ablation(
        self,
        case: BenchmarkCase,
        orchestrator: PlanForgeOrchestrator,
        counts: Optional[List[int]] = None,
        output_dir: str = "results/ablation/diversity",
    ) -> AblationResult:
        """Ablation D: Single design (1 alternative) vs Multiple designs (e.g. 3 alternatives)."""
        c_list = counts or [1, 3]

        cfg_single = OrchestrationConfig(
            output_dir=output_dir,
            num_alternatives=c_list[0],
            enable_refinement=True,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        cfg_multi = OrchestrationConfig(
            output_dir=output_dir,
            num_alternatives=c_list[1],
            enable_refinement=True,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        res_single = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Div_Single", config=cfg_single)
        res_multi = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Div_Multi", config=cfg_multi)

        metrics_single = self._extract_key_metrics(res_single)
        metrics_multi = self._extract_key_metrics(res_multi)

        # Multi-alternative details
        alts_multi = res_multi.alternative_set.alternatives if res_multi.alternative_set else []
        alts_single = res_single.alternative_set.alternatives if res_single.alternative_set else []
        metrics_multi["num_alternatives_generated"] = len(alts_multi)
        metrics_multi["valid_alternatives_count"] = sum(1 for a in alts_multi if a.is_valid)

        deltas = {
            "alternatives_count_delta": float(len(alts_multi) - len(alts_single)),
        }

        return AblationResult(
            ablation_id=f"ablation_diversity_{case.case_id}",
            case_id=case.case_id,
            variant_a_name=f"Multi_Alternatives_{c_list[1]}",
            variant_a_metrics=metrics_multi,
            variant_b_name=f"Single_Alternative_{c_list[0]}",
            variant_b_metrics=metrics_single,
            deltas=deltas,
        )

    def evaluate_candidate_budget_ablation(
        self,
        case: BenchmarkCase,
        orchestrator: PlanForgeOrchestrator,
        budgets: Optional[List[int]] = None,
        output_dir: str = "results/ablation/candidate_budget",
    ) -> AblationResult:
        """Ablation A: ASAA Candidate Exploration Budget (e.g. 1 candidate vs 3 candidates)."""
        b_list = budgets or [1, 3]

        cfg_low = OrchestrationConfig(
            output_dir=output_dir,
            candidate_budget=b_list[0],
            enable_refinement=False,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )
        cfg_high = OrchestrationConfig(
            output_dir=output_dir,
            candidate_budget=b_list[1],
            enable_refinement=False,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        res_low = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Budget_{b_list[0]}", config=cfg_low)
        res_high = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Budget_{b_list[1]}", config=cfg_high)

        metrics_low = self._extract_key_metrics(res_low)
        metrics_high = self._extract_key_metrics(res_high)

        deltas = {
            "score_delta": round(float(metrics_high.get("quality_score", 0.0)) - float(metrics_low.get("quality_score", 0.0)), 2),
            "runtime_delta_ms": round(float(metrics_high.get("total_execution_ms", 0.0)) - float(metrics_low.get("total_execution_ms", 0.0)), 1),
        }

        return AblationResult(
            ablation_id=f"ablation_cand_budget_{case.case_id}",
            case_id=case.case_id,
            variant_a_name=f"Budget_{b_list[1]}_Candidates",
            variant_a_metrics=metrics_high,
            variant_b_name=f"Budget_{b_list[0]}_Candidate",
            variant_b_metrics=metrics_low,
            deltas=deltas,
        )

    def evaluate_llm_action_selection_ablation(
        self,
        case: BenchmarkCase,
        orchestrator: PlanForgeOrchestrator,
        output_dir: str = "results/ablation/llm_selection",
    ) -> AblationResult:
        """Ablation B: LLM Action Selection with Deterministic Fallback vs Deterministic Rule-Based Selection."""
        cfg_llm = OrchestrationConfig(

            enable_exports=False,

            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        res_llm = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_LLM_Select", config=cfg_llm)
        res_rule = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Rule_Select", config=cfg_rule)

        metrics_llm = self._extract_key_metrics(res_llm)
        metrics_rule = self._extract_key_metrics(res_rule)

        deltas = {
            "score_delta": round(float(metrics_llm.get("quality_score", 0.0)) - float(metrics_rule.get("quality_score", 0.0)), 2),
            "runtime_delta_ms": round(float(metrics_llm.get("total_execution_ms", 0.0)) - float(metrics_rule.get("total_execution_ms", 0.0)), 1),
        }

        return AblationResult(

            case_id=case.case_id,
            variant_a_name="LLM_Action_Selector",
            variant_a_metrics=metrics_llm,
            variant_b_name="Deterministic_Rule_Selector",
            variant_b_metrics=metrics_rule,
            deltas=deltas,
        )

    def evaluate_multi_agent_coordination_ablation(
        self,
        case: BenchmarkCase,
        orchestrator: PlanForgeOrchestrator,
        output_dir: str = "results/ablation/multi_agent",
    ) -> AblationResult:
        """Ablation C: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Coordination vs Single-Agent Pipeline Baseline."""
        cfg_multi = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="multi_agent",
            output_dir=output_dir,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )
        cfg_pipe = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="pipeline",
            output_dir=output_dir,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        res_multi = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_MultiAgent", config=cfg_multi)
        res_pipe = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Pipeline", config=cfg_pipe)

        metrics_multi = self._extract_key_metrics(res_multi)
        metrics_pipe = self._extract_key_metrics(res_pipe)

        deltas = {
            "score_delta": round(float(metrics_multi.get("quality_score", 0.0)) - float(metrics_pipe.get("quality_score", 0.0)), 2),
            "runtime_delta_ms": round(float(metrics_multi.get("total_execution_ms", 0.0)) - float(metrics_pipe.get("total_execution_ms", 0.0)), 1),
        }

        return AblationResult(

    def evaluate_clarification_ablation(
        self,
        case: BenchmarkCase,
        orchestrator: PlanForgeOrchestrator,
        output_dir: str = "results/ablation/clarification",
    ) -> AblationResult:
        """Ablation E: Interactive Clarification Mode vs Non-Interactive Batch Mode."""
        cfg_interactive = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="multi_agent",
            interactive=True,
            output_dir=output_dir,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )
        cfg_batch = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="multi_agent",
            interactive=False,
            output_dir=output_dir,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
        )

        res_interactive = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Interactive", config=cfg_interactive)
        res_batch = orchestrator.generate(case.brief, project_name=f"{case.name}_Batch", config=cfg_batch)

        metrics_interactive = self._extract_key_metrics(res_interactive)
        metrics_batch = self._extract_key_metrics(res_batch)

        metrics_interactive["status"] = res_interactive.status
        metrics_batch["status"] = res_batch.status

        deltas = {
            "clarification_triggered": 1.0 if res_interactive.status == "waiting_for_clarification" else 0.0,
            "truthful_halt": 1.0 if res_batch.status in ("failed", "incomplete_requirements") else 0.0,
        }

        return AblationResult(
            ablation_id=f"ablation_clarification_{case.case_id}",
            case_id=case.case_id,
            variant_a_name="Interactive_Clarification_Mode",
            variant_a_metrics=metrics_interactive,
            variant_b_name="Batch_NonInteractive_Mode",
            variant_b_metrics=metrics_batch,
            deltas=deltas,
        )

    def _extract_key_metrics(self, res: PipelineResult) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Extract comparable numeric & boolean metrics from a pipeline execution result."""
        vr = res.validation_report
        out: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "is_success": res.is_success,
            "overall_valid": vr.overall_valid if vr else False,
            "quality_score": vr.overall_score if vr else 0.0,
            "validation_error_count": vr.total_errors if vr else 0,
            "validation_warning_count": vr.total_warnings if vr else 0,
            "total_execution_ms": sum(s.duration_ms for s in res.stage_records.values() if s.duration_ms),
        }

        if res.allocation_set:
            total_allocated = sum(a.total_area_sqm for a in res.allocation_set.allocations)
            out["total_allocated_area_sqm"] = round(total_allocated, 2)
            out["num_allocated_regions"] = sum(len(a.allocated_regions) for a in res.allocation_set.allocations)
            out["allocation_score"] = round(
                sum(a.score for a in res.allocation_set.allocations) / max(1, len(res.allocation_set.allocations)), 2
            )

        if res.floor_plan_set:
            out["num_constructed_rooms"] = sum(
                len(fp.geometry.rooms) for fp in res.floor_plan_set.floor_plans if fp.geometry
            )

        from app.evaluation.metrics import MetricCalculator
        calculated = MetricCalculator.calculate_all(res)
        for m_name in [
            "allocation_adjacency_compliance",
            "area_preferred_mae",
            "area_min_compliance",
            "boundary_compliance",
            "connectivity_rate",
            "separation_compliance",
        ]:
            if m_name in calculated and calculated[m_name].is_available:
                out[m_name] = calculated[m_name].value

        return out

"""Statistical aggregation across benchmark cases and evaluation runs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import statistics
from typing import Any, Dict, List
from app.evaluation.models import CaseEvaluationResult


class MetricAggregator:
    """Computes descriptive statistics across benchmark evaluation runs."""

    @classmethod
    def aggregate_cases(cls, results: List[CaseEvaluationResult]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Compute statistical summaries across a list of case evaluation results."""
        if not results:
            return {}

        summary: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "total_cases": len(results),
            "successful_executions": sum(1 for r in results if r.is_success),
            "valid_plans_count": sum(1 for r in results if r.overall_valid is True),
        }

        # Group numeric values by metric name
        metric_values: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}
        for r in results:
            for m_name, m_val in r.metrics.items():
                if m_val.is_available and isinstance(m_val.value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(m_val.value, bool):
                    if m_name not in metric_values:
                        metric_values[m_name] = []
                    metric_values[m_name].append(float(m_val.value))

        stats_by_metric: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for m_name, vals in metric_values.items():
            if not vals:
                continue
            n = len(vals)
            mean_val = sum(vals) / n
            sorted_vals = sorted(vals)
            median_val = statistics.median(vals)
            std_dev = statistics.stdev(vals) if n >= 2 else 0.0
            min_val = min(vals)
            max_val = max(vals)
            ci_95 = round(1.96 * (std_dev / math.sqrt(n)), 2) if n >= 2 else 0.0

            stats_by_metric[m_name] = {
                "n": n,
                "mean": round(mean_val, 2),
                "median": round(median_val, 2),
                "std_dev": round(std_dev, 2),
                "ci_95": ci_95,
                "ci_lower": round(mean_val - ci_95, 2),
                "ci_upper": round(mean_val + ci_95, 2),
                "min": round(min_val, 2),
                "max": round(max_val, 2),
            }

        summary["metrics"] = stats_by_metric

        # Separate feasibility detection from generation success
        infeasible_cases = [r for r in results if any(t in ("INFEASIBLE", "CONTRADICTORY") for t in r.tags)]
        feasible_cases = [r for r in results if not any(t in ("INFEASIBLE", "CONTRADICTORY") for t in r.tags)]

        summary["feasible_cases_count"] = len(feasible_cases)
        summary["infeasible_cases_count"] = len(infeasible_cases)

        if feasible_cases:
            valid_feasible = sum(1 for r in feasible_cases if r.overall_valid is True)
            summary["feasible_valid_design_rate"] = round(valid_feasible / len(feasible_cases), 4)
            summary["feasible_completion_rate"] = round(sum(1 for r in feasible_cases if r.is_success) / len(feasible_cases), 4)

        if infeasible_cases:
            # TP = Infeasible case correctly identified as infeasible, failed, or waiting_for_clarification
            tp = sum(1 for r in infeasible_cases if r.status in ("infeasible", "failed", "waiting_for_clarification", "incomplete_requirements"))
            fn = len(infeasible_cases) - tp
            # FP = Feasible case falsely flagged as infeasible/failed
            fp = sum(1 for r in feasible_cases if r.status in ("infeasible", "failed", "incomplete_requirements"))
            tn = len(feasible_cases) - fp

            precision = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 1.0
            recall = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 1.0
            f1 = 2 * (precision * recall) / (precision + recall) if (precision + recall) > 0 else 0.0

            summary["infeasibility_detection"] = {
                "true_positives": tp,
                "false_negatives": fn,
                "false_positives": fp,
                "true_negatives": tn,
                "precision": round(precision, 4),
                "recall": round(recall, 4),
                "f1_score": round(f1, 4),
            }

        # High-level research summary indicators
        if "req_room_coverage" in stats_by_metric:
            summary["mean_room_coverage_pct"] = stats_by_metric["req_room_coverage"]["mean"]
        if "area_min_compliance" in stats_by_metric:
            summary["mean_area_min_compliance_pct"] = stats_by_metric["area_min_compliance"]["mean"]
        if "area_preferred_mae" in stats_by_metric:
            summary["mean_area_preferred_mae_sqm"] = stats_by_metric["area_preferred_mae"]["mean"]
        if "allocation_adjacency_compliance" in stats_by_metric:
            summary["mean_adjacency_compliance_pct"] = stats_by_metric["allocation_adjacency_compliance"]["mean"]
        if "boundary_compliance" in stats_by_metric:
            summary["mean_boundary_compliance_pct"] = stats_by_metric["boundary_compliance"]["mean"]
        if "connectivity_rate" in stats_by_metric:
            summary["mean_connectivity_pct"] = stats_by_metric["connectivity_rate"]["mean"]
        if "timing_total_ms" in stats_by_metric:
            summary["mean_total_pipeline_ms"] = stats_by_metric["timing_total_ms"]["mean"]

        return summary

    @classmethod
    def compute_paired_differences(
        cls,
        results_a: List[CaseEvaluationResult],
        results_b: List[CaseEvaluationResult],
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Compute paired case-by-case deltas between two experimental variants."""
        map_b = {r.case_id: r for r in results_b}
        paired_deltas: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}
        common_cases: List[str] = []

        for r_a in results_a:
            cid = r_a.case_id
            if cid in map_b:
                common_cases.append(cid)
                r_b = map_b[cid]
                for m_name in r_a.metrics:
                    m_a = r_a.metrics[m_name]
                    m_b = r_b.metrics.get(m_name)
                    if (
                        m_a.is_available
                        and m_b
                        and m_b.is_available
                        and isinstance(m_a.value, (int, float))
                        and isinstance(m_b.value, (int, float))
                    ):
                        if m_name not in paired_deltas:
                            paired_deltas[m_name] = []
                        paired_deltas[m_name].append(float(m_a.value) - float(m_b.value))

        summary_diffs: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "paired_cases_count": len(common_cases),
            "common_cases": common_cases,
            "metrics": {},
        }

        for m_name, deltas in paired_deltas.items():
            if deltas:
                n = len(deltas)
                mean_d = sum(deltas) / n
                std_d = statistics.stdev(deltas) if n >= 2 else 0.0
                summary_diffs["metrics"][m_name] = {
                    "mean_difference": round(mean_d, 3),
                    "median_difference": round(statistics.median(deltas), 3),
                    "std_difference": round(std_d, 3),
                    "min_difference": round(min(deltas), 3),
                    "max_difference": round(max(deltas), 3),
                }

        return summary_diffs

[86/252] FILE: app/evaluation/baselines.py

"""Baseline spatial allocator for PlanForge research evaluation.

Provides a deterministic, priority-blind, proportional spatial partitioning reference
implementation to isolate and evaluate the specific contributions of ASAA.

Architecture & Baseline Design:
1. Derives the identical buildable boundary from PlanningSpec using BuildableBoundaryCalculator.
2. Checks basic feasibility (ensuring total room minimum areas do not exceed buildable area).
3. Allocates space priority-blind in room sequence.
4. Uses straightforward proportional 1D slicing across the buildable boundary bounding box.
5. Does NOT perform multi-candidate generation, does NOT score spatial relationship attraction/repulsion,
   does NOT evaluate entrance proximity or solar orientation, and does NOT perform adaptive boundary refinement.
6. Returns standard AllocationSet and AllocatedRegion instances compatible with downstream pipeline.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, box

from app.asaa.boundary import BuildableBoundary, BuildableBoundaryCalculator
from app.asaa.exceptions import InfeasibleAllocationError
from app.asaa.spatial_regions import (
    are_regions_adjacent,
    calculate_approximate_dimensions,
    calculate_centroid,
)
from app.models.allocation import AllocatedRegion, Allocation, AllocationSet
from app.models.planning import FloorPlanSpec, PlanningSpec, RoomSpec
from app.utils.ids import generate_id


class BaselineSpatialAllocator:
    """Evaluation-only baseline allocator implementing priority-blind proportional slicing."""

    def __init__(self, algorithm_version: str = "Baseline-ProportionalSlice") -> None:
        self.algorithm_version = algorithm_version

    def allocate(
        self,
        planning_spec: PlanningSpec,
        num_candidates: Optional[int] = None,
        seed: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> AllocationSet:
        """Allocate spatial regions using deterministic proportional slicing.

        Args:
            planning_spec: Validated PlanningSpec from the Planning Agent.
            num_candidates: Ignored by baseline (always deterministic single-pass).
            seed: Ignored by baseline (fully deterministic).

        Returns:
            AllocationSet containing complete baseline allocations.

        Raises:
            InfeasibleAllocationError: If requirements exceed buildable boundary.
        """
        buildable = self._derive_buildable_boundary(planning_spec)
        allocation_set = AllocationSet(planning_spec_id=planning_spec.id)

        is_multi_floor = len(planning_spec.floors) >= 2
        staircase_anchor: Optional[Polygon] = None

        for floor_spec in planning_spec.floors:
            has_stair = False
            if floor_spec.staircase_intent and floor_spec.staircase_intent.get("required"):
                has_stair = True
            elif is_multi_floor:
                has_stair = True

            allocation, stair_poly = self._allocate_floor(
                floor_spec=floor_spec,
                buildable=buildable,
                has_staircase=has_stair,
                staircase_anchor=staircase_anchor,
            )

            if has_stair and stair_poly is not None and staircase_anchor is None:
                staircase_anchor = stair_poly

            allocation_set.allocations.append(allocation)

        if is_multi_floor and staircase_anchor is not None:
            allocation_set.staircase_aligned = True

        return allocation_set

    def _allocate_floor(
        self,
        floor_spec: FloorPlanSpec,
        buildable: BuildableBoundary,
        has_staircase: bool,
        staircase_anchor: Optional[Polygon],
    ) -> Tuple[Allocation, Optional[Polygon]]:
        """Proportionally slice the buildable area across required room specs."""
        room_specs = floor_spec.room_specs
        if not room_specs:
            return Allocation(
                floor_number=floor_spec.floor_number,
                floor_name=floor_spec.floor_name or f"Floor {floor_spec.floor_number}",
                total_area_sqm=0.0,
                allocated_regions=[],
                score=50.0,
                algorithm_version=self.algorithm_version,
            ), None

        # 1. Feasibility check
        total_min_area = sum(
            (r.min_area_sqm if r.min_area_sqm is not None else (r.target_area_sqm or 5.0))
            for r in room_specs
        )
        staircase_area = 8.0 if has_staircase else 0.0
        available_area = buildable.area_sqm

        if total_min_area + staircase_area > available_area:
            raise InfeasibleAllocationError(
                f"Floor {floor_spec.floor_number}: Total minimum room area ({total_min_area + staircase_area:.1f} m²) "
                f"exceeds available buildable area ({available_area:.1f} m²)"
            )

        min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = buildable.shapely_polygon.bounds
        total_w = max(1.0, max_x - min_x)
        total_h = max(1.0, max_y - min_y)

        allocated_regions: List[AllocatedRegion] = []
        stair_poly_result: Optional[Polygon] = None

        # 2. Allocate fixed staircase zone if required (corner placement for multi-floor)
        rem_min_x = min_x
        rem_max_x = max_x
        rem_min_y = min_y
        rem_max_y = max_y

        if has_staircase:
            stair_w = min(3.0, total_w * 0.25)
            stair_h = min(total_h, max(2.5, 8.0 / stair_w))
            stair_box = box(min_x, min_y, min_x + stair_w, min_y + stair_h)
            stair_poly_result = stair_box

            stair_coords = [(round(x, 4), round(y, 4)) for x, y in stair_box.exterior.coords[:-1]]
            stair_region = AllocatedRegion(
                id=generate_id("region"),
                room_type="staircase",
                floor_number=floor_spec.floor_number,
                target_area_sqm=round(stair_box.area, 2),
                area_sqm=round(stair_box.area, 2),
                approximate_dimensions=calculate_approximate_dimensions(stair_coords),
                polygon=stair_coords,
                zone_type="staircase",
            )
            allocated_regions.append(stair_region)
            rem_min_x = min_x + stair_w

        # 3. Proportionally slice remaining space along primary axis
        # Calculate target weights priority-blind
        target_areas = [
            (r.target_area_sqm if r.target_area_sqm is not None else (r.min_area_sqm or 10.0))
            for r in room_specs
        ]
        total_target = sum(target_areas) if sum(target_areas) > 0 else float(len(room_specs))

        slice_w = max(0.5, rem_max_x - rem_min_x)
        slice_h = max(0.5, rem_max_y - rem_min_y)

        # Slice along the longer axis
        slice_vertically = slice_w >= slice_h

        curr_offset = rem_min_x if slice_vertically else rem_min_y

        for i, r_spec in enumerate(room_specs):
            fraction = target_areas[i] / total_target
            if i == len(room_specs) - 1:
                # Last slice takes remainder
                if slice_vertically:
                    seg_poly = box(curr_offset, rem_min_y, rem_max_x, rem_max_y)
                else:
                    seg_poly = box(rem_min_x, curr_offset, rem_max_x, rem_max_y)
            else:
                if slice_vertically:
                    seg_len = fraction * slice_w
                    seg_poly = box(curr_offset, rem_min_y, curr_offset + seg_len, rem_max_y)
                    curr_offset += seg_len
                else:
                    seg_len = fraction * slice_h
                    seg_poly = box(rem_min_x, curr_offset, rem_max_x, curr_offset + seg_len)
                    curr_offset += seg_len

            # Intersect with buildable boundary to handle irregular bounds
            clipped = seg_poly.intersection(buildable.shapely_polygon)
            final_poly = clipped if not clipped.is_empty and clipped.area > 0.1 else seg_poly

            if final_poly.geom_type != "Polygon":
                final_poly = final_poly.convex_hull

            coords = [(round(x, 4), round(y, 4)) for x, y in final_poly.exterior.coords[:-1]]
            area_sqm = round(final_poly.area, 2)

            reg = AllocatedRegion(
                id=generate_id("region"),
                room_type=r_spec.room_type,
                room_spec_id=r_spec.id,
                floor_number=floor_spec.floor_number,
                target_area_sqm=r_spec.target_area_sqm or area_sqm,
                area_sqm=area_sqm,
                approximate_dimensions=calculate_approximate_dimensions(coords),
                polygon=coords,
                zone_type=getattr(r_spec, "room_category", "room") or "room",
                priority=r_spec.priority or "normal",
            )
            allocated_regions.append(reg)

        # 4. Shared boundary adjacencies
        for i in range(len(allocated_regions)):
            reg_i = allocated_regions[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, len(allocated_regions)):
                reg_j = allocated_regions[j]
                if are_regions_adjacent(reg_i.polygon, reg_j.polygon, min_contact_m=0.1):
                    reg_i.adjacency_regions.append(reg_j.id)
                    reg_j.adjacency_regions.append(reg_i.id)

        tot_area = sum(r.area_sqm for r in allocated_regions)
        circ_area = sum(r.area_sqm for r in allocated_regions if r.zone_type in {"circulation", "entrance", "staircase"})

        allocation = Allocation(
            floor_number=floor_spec.floor_number,
            floor_name=floor_spec.floor_name or f"Floor {floor_spec.floor_number}",
            total_area_sqm=round(tot_area, 2),
            allocated_regions=allocated_regions,
            circulation_area_sqm=round(circ_area, 2),
            score=50.0,
            algorithm_version=self.algorithm_version,
        )

        return allocation, stair_poly_result

    def _derive_buildable_boundary(self, planning_spec: PlanningSpec) -> BuildableBoundary:
        """Derive buildable boundary matching ASAA calculation."""
        gc = planning_spec.global_constraints
        plot_poly = gc.get("plot_polygon") or gc.get("plot_shape")
        plot_area = gc.get("plot_area_sqm")
        plot_w = gc.get("plot_width_m")
        plot_d = gc.get("plot_depth_m")
        if (plot_w is None or plot_d is None) and gc.get("plot_dimensions"):
            plot_w, plot_d = gc["plot_dimensions"]
        setbacks = gc.get("setbacks")

        return BuildableBoundaryCalculator.calculate(
            plot_polygon=plot_poly,
            plot_area_sqm=plot_area,
            plot_width_m=plot_w,
            plot_depth_m=plot_d,
            setbacks=setbacks,
        )

class BenchmarkRegistry:
    """Registry providing lookup and filtered selection of benchmark cases."""

    _cases: Dict[str, BenchmarkCase] = {c.case_id: c for c in BENCHMARK_CASES}

    @classmethod
    def get_all_cases(cls) -> List[BenchmarkCase]:
        return list(cls._cases.values())

    @classmethod
    def get_case(cls, case_id: str) -> Optional[BenchmarkCase]:
        return cls._cases.get(case_id)

    @classmethod
    def filter_by_tags(cls, tags: List[BenchmarkCategory | str]) -> List[BenchmarkCase]:
        normalized_tags = [t.value if isinstance(t, BenchmarkCategory) else str(t) for t in tags]
        return [c for c in cls._cases.values() if any(c.has_tag(t) for t in normalized_tags)]

    @classmethod
    def filter_by_ids(cls, case_ids: List[str]) -> List[BenchmarkCase]:
        return [cls._cases[cid] for cid in case_ids if cid in cls._cases]

"""Evaluation-specific exception types for PlanForge research evaluation."""

from __future__ import annotations


class EvaluationError(Exception):
    """Base exception for all research evaluation errors."""
    pass


class BenchmarkExecutionError(EvaluationError):
    """Raised when a benchmark case execution fails unexpectedly."""
    pass


class MetricComputationError(EvaluationError):
    """Raised when metric calculation fails due to inconsistent or corrupt artifacts."""
    pass


class BaselineAllocationError(EvaluationError):
    """Raised when the baseline allocator cannot produce a feasible geometric partition."""
    pass


class ReportGenerationError(EvaluationError):
    """Raised when serialization or report formatting fails."""
    pass

"""Deterministic Fault Injection Framework for PlanForge Robustness & Recovery Evaluation.

Provides controlled, testable fault injection mechanisms simulating:
1. LLM failures (timeout, connection failure, rate limits, malformed JSON, schema invalidity,
   repeated failures, missing credentials, budget exhaustion).
2. Tool & geometry failures (ASAA allocation exception, geometry exception, invalid polygon,
   missing artifact, door/connectivity exception, validation exception, export failure).
3. Orchestration failures (agent delegation failure, stale proposal versioning, cycle detection,
   cancellation, interruption at safe checkpoints, state restoration & resume, duplicate clarification).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, Generator, List, Optional
from unittest.mock import patch

from app.models.geometry import Geometry, GeoRoom, GeoWall
from app.models.requirements import Requirements
from app.agentic.budget import Budget
from app.orchestration.errors import OrchestrationError
from app.agentic.state import ProjectState, RunStatus


class FaultType(str, Enum):
    # LLM faults
    LLM_TIMEOUT = "llm_timeout"
    LLM_CONNECTION_ERROR = "llm_connection_error"
    LLM_RATE_LIMIT = "llm_rate_limit"
    LLM_MALFORMED_OUTPUT = "llm_malformed_output"
    LLM_SCHEMA_INVALID = "llm_schema_invalid"
    LLM_REPEATED_INVALID = "llm_repeated_invalid"
    LLM_MISSING_CREDENTIALS = "llm_missing_credentials"
    LLM_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED = "llm_budget_exhausted"

    # Tool & geometry faults
    ASAA_ALLOCATION_EXCEPTION = "asaa_allocation_exception"
    GEOMETRY_CONSTRUCTION_EXCEPTION = "geometry_construction_exception"
    INVALID_POLYGON = "invalid_polygon"
    MISSING_GEOMETRY_ARTIFACT = "missing_geometry_artifact"
    DOOR_CONNECTIVITY_FAILURE = "door_connectivity_failure"
    VALIDATION_EXCEPTION = "validation_exception"
    EXPORT_FAILURE = "export_failure"

    # Orchestration faults
    AGENT_DELEGATION_FAILURE = "agent_delegation_failure"
    STALE_PROPOSAL = "stale_proposal"
    REPEATED_ACTION_CYCLE = "repeated_action_cycle"
    CANCELLATION = "cancellation"
    INTERRUPTION_CHECKPOINT = "interruption_checkpoint"
    STATE_RESTORE_RESUME = "state_restore_resume"
    CONCURRENT_CLARIFICATION = "concurrent_clarification"
    REQUIREMENT_MUTATION_FAILURE = "requirement_mutation_failure"


@dataclass
class FaultRecord:
    """Audit record of an injected fault and its system recovery response."""

    fault_type: FaultType
    target_component: str
    injected_at_step: int
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    exception_raised: Optional[str] = None
    recovered_successfully: bool = False
    fallback_invoked: bool = False
    preserved_best_valid: bool = False
    terminal_status: Optional[str] = None
    audit_notes: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "fault_type": self.fault_type.value,
            "target_component": self.target_component,
            "injected_at_step": self.injected_at_step,
            "payload": self.payload,
            "exception_raised": self.exception_raised,
            "recovered_successfully": self.recovered_successfully,
            "fallback_invoked": self.fallback_invoked,
            "preserved_best_valid": self.preserved_best_valid,
            "terminal_status": self.terminal_status,
            "audit_notes": self.audit_notes,
        }


class FaultInjector:
    """Controller for deterministic, reproducible fault injection during test & benchmark execution."""

    @staticmethod
    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def inject_llm_failure(
        fault_type: FaultType,
        client: Any,
        trigger_count: int = 1,
    ) -> Generator[Dict[str, Any], None, None]:
        """Inject specific LLM error into a LLM client instance."""
        calls = {"count": 0, "intercepted": False}
        original_generate = getattr(client, "generate", None)

        def faulty_generate(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
            calls["count"] += 1
            if calls["count"] <= trigger_count:
                calls["intercepted"] = True
                if fault_type == FaultType.LLM_TIMEOUT:
                    raise TimeoutError("Simulated LLM provider timeout after 30.0s")
                elif fault_type == FaultType.LLM_CONNECTION_ERROR:
                    raise ConnectionError("Simulated LLM provider endpoint unreachable (503 Service Unavailable)")
                elif fault_type == FaultType.LLM_RATE_LIMIT:
                    raise RuntimeError("Simulated HTTP 429 Too Many Requests: Rate limit exceeded")
                elif fault_type == FaultType.LLM_MALFORMED_OUTPUT:
                    return "```json\n{ invalid_json: true, unterminated string"
                elif fault_type == FaultType.LLM_SCHEMA_INVALID:
                    return '{"invalid_key": 123, "rooms": "not_a_list"}'
                elif fault_type == FaultType.LLM_MISSING_CREDENTIALS:
                    raise PermissionError("Simulated HTTP 401 Unauthorized: Invalid API Key")
                elif fault_type == FaultType.LLM_REPEATED_INVALID:
                    return "Sorry, I cannot generate floor plans as an AI model."
            if original_generate:
                return original_generate(*args, **kwargs)
            return "{}"

        with patch.object(client, "generate", side_effect=faulty_generate):
            yield calls

    @staticmethod
    def create_exhausted_budget(max_steps: int = 1, max_tools: int = 1) -> Budget:
        """Create an immediately exhaustible budget for testing bounded execution limits."""
        return Budget(
            max_steps=max_steps,
            max_llm_calls=1,
            max_tool_calls=max_tools,
            max_wall_seconds=1.0,
            steps_used=max_steps,
            tool_calls_used=max_tools,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def simulate_stale_proposal(proposal: Any, delta_version: int = -1) -> Any:
        """Modify proposal's state_version to simulate concurrent stale proposals."""
        proposal.state_version = max(1, getattr(proposal, "state_version", 1) + delta_version)
        return proposal

    @staticmethod
    def create_degenerate_geometry(floor_number: int = 1) -> Geometry:
        """Create a mathematically degenerate Geometry (self-intersecting room polygon) for failure testing."""
        room = GeoRoom(
            id="georoom_degenerate_01",
            room_type="living",
            usable_polygon=[(0.0, 0.0), (10.0, 10.0), (0.0, 10.0), (10.0, 0.0)],  # Self-intersecting bowtie
            built_polygon=[(0.0, 0.0), (10.0, 10.0), (0.0, 10.0), (10.0, 0.0)],
            area_sqm=50.0,
            floor_number=floor_number,
        )
        return Geometry(
            id="geo_degenerate_01",
            floor_number=floor_number,
            rooms=[room],
            walls=[],
            doors=[],
            windows=[],
            plot_polygon=[(0.0, 0.0), (20.0, 0.0), (20.0, 20.0), (0.0, 20.0)],
            buildable_polygon=[(2.0, 2.0), (18.0, 2.0), (18.0, 18.0), (2.0, 18.0)],
        )

"""Generalization & Stress Test Fixtures for PlanForge Phase 9 Evaluation.

Provides:
1. Held-Out Plot Geometries (strictly not tuned against, evaluating out-of-distribution performance):
   - Rectangular plots with extreme proportions (narrow and elongated)
   - L-shaped non-convex plots with asymmetric wings
   - T-shaped non-convex plots with junction bottlenecks
   - Irregular polygonal boundaries (pentagonal)
   - Tight setback envelopes near feasibility limits
   - Multi-wing bifurcation plots
   - Irregular multi-floor configurations
2. Complexity & Constraint Stress Fixtures (varying one stress factor at a time):
   - High room count (12 rooms)
   - Dense room area packing (tight envelope)
   - Mathematically infeasible room-area demand
   - Directly conflicting functional adjacencies
   - Extreme room aspect ratios
   - Multi-floor programs with vertical circulation stress
   - Ambiguous / incomplete requirements
   - Explicitly unsupported curved plot boundary
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


class FixtureCategory(str, Enum):
    HELDOUT_GEOMETRY = "heldout_geometry"
    COMPLEXITY_STRESS = "complexity_stress"
    FEASIBILITY_LIMIT = "feasibility_limit"
    CONFLICTING_CONSTRAINTS = "conflicting_constraints"
    UNSUPPORTED_INPUT = "unsupported_input"


class FeasibilityExpectation(str, Enum):
    FEASIBLE = "feasible"
    FEASIBLE_BUT_DIFFICULT = "feasible_but_difficult"
    INFEASIBLE = "infeasible"
    INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION = "insufficient_information"
    UNSUPPORTED_INPUT = "unsupported_input"


@dataclass
class RobustnessFixture:
    """A benchmark fixture specifically designed for generalization or stress testing."""

    fixture_id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    category: FixtureCategory
    expected_feasibility: FeasibilityExpectation
    brief: str
    geometric_properties: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    limitations: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    seed: int = 42

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "fixture_id": self.fixture_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "description": self.description,
            "category": self.category.value,
            "expected_feasibility": self.expected_feasibility.value,
            "brief": self.brief,
            "geometric_properties": self.geometric_properties,
            "limitations": self.limitations,
            "seed": self.seed,
        }

class RobustnessRegistry:
    """Registry providing filtered access to generalization and stress test fixtures."""

    @classmethod
    def get_heldout_fixtures(cls) -> List[RobustnessFixture]:
        return list(HELDOUT_GEOMETRY_FIXTURES)

    @classmethod
    def get_stress_fixtures(cls) -> List[RobustnessFixture]:
        return list(COMPLEXITY_STRESS_FIXTURES)

    @classmethod
    def get_all_robustness_fixtures(cls) -> List[RobustnessFixture]:
        return list(HELDOUT_GEOMETRY_FIXTURES) + list(COMPLEXITY_STRESS_FIXTURES)

    @classmethod
    def get_fixture(cls, fixture_id: str) -> Optional[RobustnessFixture]:
        for f in cls.get_all_robustness_fixtures():
            if f.fixture_id == fixture_id:
                return f
        return None
