"""Window Validator for independent verification of exterior window openings.

Independently checks:
- Window references a valid GeoWall
- Window is placed strictly on an exterior wall (error if placed on interior partition)
- Window position lies on the wall segment
- Window dimensions and sill height are positive and fit the wall
- Compass orientation matching
"""

from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Dict, List, Optional
from shapely.geometry import LineString, Point, Polygon

from app.geometry.geometry_utils import (
    get_wall_orientation,
    segment_length,
    to_shapely_polygon,
)
from app.models.architectural_design import ArchitecturalDesign
from app.models.geometry import Geometry, GeoWall, GeoWindow
from app.models.validation import ValidationIssue
from app.models.windows import WindowIntent


class WindowValidator:
    """Independently verifies physical GeoWindow openings on exterior walls."""

    def __init__(self, wall_distance_tolerance: float = 0.15):
        """Initialize WindowValidator.

        Args:
            wall_distance_tolerance: Maximum allowed perpendicular distance from window point to wall line.
        """
        self.wall_distance_tolerance = wall_distance_tolerance

    def validate(
        self,
        geometry: Geometry,
        floor_design: Optional[ArchitecturalDesign] = None,
    ) -> List[ValidationIssue]:
        """Validate all windows on a single floor.

        Args:
            geometry: Floor Geometry containing walls and windows.
            floor_design: Upstream architectural design containing WindowIntents.

        Returns:
            List of ValidationIssue instances for any window violations.
        """
        issues: List[ValidationIssue] = []
        floor_num = geometry.floor_number

        wall_map = {w.id: w for w in geometry.walls}
        room_map = {r.id: r for r in geometry.rooms}

        # Map intent_id -> WindowIntent if floor_design provided
        intent_map: Dict[str, WindowIntent] = {}
        if floor_design:
            for w_intent in floor_design.all_window_intents():
                intent_map[w_intent.id] = w_intent

        for window in geometry.windows:
            # 1. Dimension Sanity
            if window.width <= 0.1 or window.height <= 0.1:
                issues.append(
                    ValidationIssue(
                        severity="error",
                        category="window",
                        check="window_dimensions",
                        message=f"Window (id={window.id}) has non-positive dimensions ({window.width}x{window.height})",
                        target_id=window.id,
                        floor_number=floor_num,
                    )
                )

            if window.sill_height < 0:
                issues.append(
                    ValidationIssue(
                        severity="error",
                        category="window",
                        check="negative_sill_height",
                        message=f"Window (id={window.id}) has negative sill height ({window.sill_height}m)",
                        target_id=window.id,
                        floor_number=floor_num,
                    )
                )

            # 2. Wall Attachment Check (No Floating Windows)
            if not window.wall_id or window.wall_id not in wall_map:
                issues.append(
                    ValidationIssue(
                        severity="error",
                        category="window",
                        check="floating_window",
                        message=f"Window (id={window.id}) is not attached to any valid wall (wall_id='{window.wall_id}')",
                        target_id=window.id,
                        floor_number=floor_num,
                    )
                )
                continue

            wall = wall_map[window.wall_id]

            # 3. Position on Wall Check
            win_pt = Point(window.position)
            wall_line = LineString([wall.start, wall.end])
            dist = wall_line.distance(win_pt)

            if dist > self.wall_distance_tolerance:
                issues.append(
                    ValidationIssue(
                        severity="error",
                        category="window",
                        check="window_off_wall",
                        message=(
                            f"Window (id={window.id}) position {window.position} does not lie on its "
                            f"assigned wall (distance={dist:.2f}m > {self.wall_distance_tolerance}m)"
                        ),
                        details={"distance_to_wall": round(dist, 3)},
                        target_id=window.id,
                        floor_number=floor_num,
                    )
                )

            # 4. Strict Exterior Wall Check (No Windows on Interior Partitions)
            if wall.type != "exterior":
                issues.append(
                    ValidationIssue(
                        severity="error",
                        category="window",
                        check="window_on_interior_wall",
                        message=(
                            f"Window (id={window.id}) is placed on an interior partition wall "
                            f"(id={wall.id}, type='{wall.type}')"
                        ),
                        details={"wall_id": wall.id, "wall_type": wall.type},
                        target_id=window.id,
                        floor_number=floor_num,
                    )
                )

            # 5. Wall Width vs Window Width
            w_len = segment_length((wall.start, wall.end))
            if w_len < window.width - 0.05:
                issues.append(
                    ValidationIssue(
                        severity="error",
                        category="window",
                        check="wall_too_narrow_for_window",
                        message=(
                            f"Wall (id={wall.id}, length={w_len:.2f}m) is too narrow for window "
                            f"width {window.width:.2f}m"
                        ),
                        details={"wall_length": round(w_len, 2), "window_width": window.width},
                        target_id=window.id,
                        floor_number=floor_num,
                    )
                )

            # 6. Orientation Preference Check
            if window.intent_id and window.intent_id in intent_map:
                w_intent = intent_map[window.intent_id]
                if w_intent.wall_orientation:
                    expected_orient = w_intent.wall_orientation.lower().strip()
                    actual_orient = get_wall_orientation((wall.start, wall.end))
                    if actual_orient != expected_orient:
                        issues.append(
                            ValidationIssue(
                                severity="warning",
                                category="window",
                                check="window_orientation_mismatch",
                                message=(
                                    f"Window (id={window.id}) faces '{actual_orient}' instead of "
                                    f"requested '{expected_orient}'"
                                ),
                                details={"expected_orientation": expected_orient, "actual_orientation": actual_orient},
                                target_id=window.id,
                                floor_number=floor_num,
                            )
                        )

        return issues

/**
 * Centralized HTTP Client for PlanForge API.
 */

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || '';

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number;
  data: any;

  constructor(message: string, status: number, data?: any) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiError';
    this.status = status;
    this.data = data;
  }
}

export async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  const url = `${BASE_URL}${path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`}`;
  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...(options.headers || {}),
  };

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, { ...options, headers });
    if (!response.ok) {
      let errorData: any;
      try {
        errorData = await response.json();
      } catch {
        errorData = await response.text();
      }
      const message = errorData?.detail || errorData?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
      throw new ApiError(message, response.status, errorData);
    }
    return await response.json();
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof ApiError) {
      throw err;
    }
    throw new ApiError(err?.message || 'Network connection to backend failed', 0, err);
  }
}

export function getExportFileUrl(projectId: string, relativePath: string): string {
  return `${BASE_URL}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/export?file=${encodeURIComponent(relativePath)}`;
}

export function getExportDxfUrl(projectId: string, floor?: number): string {
  const query = floor !== undefined ? `?floor=${encodeURIComponent(floor)}` : '';
  return `${BASE_URL}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/export/dxf${query}`;
}

export function getExportSvgUrl(projectId: string, floor: number = 1): string {
  return `${BASE_URL}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/export/svg?floor=${encodeURIComponent(floor)}`;
}

export function getExportZipUrl(projectId: string): string {
  return `${BASE_URL}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/export/zip`;
}

/**
 * API service endpoints for PlanForge projects and generation.
 */

import { request } from './client';
import type {
  HealthResponse,
  ProjectDetailResponse,
  ProjectData,
  GenerationRequest,
  GenerationResponse,
  AlternativeSummarySchema,
  ExportResponse,
  DecisionTrace,
  ChatTurnRequest,
  ChatTurnResponse,
} from './types';

export async function getHealth(): Promise<HealthResponse> {
  return request<HealthResponse>('/health');
}

export async function listProjects(): Promise<ProjectDetailResponse[]> {
  return request<ProjectDetailResponse[]>('/projects');
}

export async function getProject(projectId: string): Promise<ProjectDetailResponse> {
  return request<ProjectDetailResponse>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}`);
}

export async function deleteProject(projectId: string): Promise<{ status: string; project_id: string }> {
  return request<{ status: string; project_id: string }>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
  });
}

export async function clearProjects(): Promise<{ status: string; cleared_count: number }> {
  return request<{ status: string; cleared_count: number }>('/projects', {
    method: 'DELETE',
  });
}


export async function getProjectData(projectId: string): Promise<ProjectData> {
  return request<ProjectData>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/data`);
}

export async function getProjectTrace(projectId: string): Promise<DecisionTrace> {
  return request<DecisionTrace>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/trace`);
}

export async function getProjectAlternatives(projectId: string): Promise<AlternativeSummarySchema[]> {
  return request<AlternativeSummarySchema[]>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/alternatives`);
}

export async function getExportInventory(projectId: string): Promise<ExportResponse> {
  return request<ExportResponse>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/export`);
}

export async function generateFloorPlan(payload: GenerationRequest): Promise<GenerationResponse> {
  return request<GenerationResponse>('/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

export async function sendChatTurn(payload: ChatTurnRequest): Promise<ChatTurnResponse> {
  return request<ChatTurnResponse>('/api/v1/chat', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

export async function getClarifications(projectId: string): Promise<import('./types').ClarificationListResponse> {
  return request<import('./types').ClarificationListResponse>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/clarifications`);
}

export async function submitClarificationResponse(
  projectId: string,
  requestId: string,
  payload: import('./types').ClarificationResponsePayload
): Promise<import('./types').ClarificationSubmitResponse> {
  return request<import('./types').ClarificationSubmitResponse>(
    `/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/clarifications/${encodeURIComponent(requestId)}/response`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    }
  );
}

export async function resumeProject(projectId: string): Promise<GenerationResponse> {
  return request<GenerationResponse>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/resume`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ reason: 'User resumed workflow' }),
  });
}

export async function cancelProject(projectId: string, reason?: string): Promise<GenerationResponse> {
  return request<GenerationResponse>(`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/cancel`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ reason: reason || 'User cancelled' }),
  });
}

    border-left-color: var(--border);
  }
  &::after {
    right: 0;
    border-right-color: var(--border);
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Header } from './components/layout/Header';
import { TabNav, type ActiveTab } from './components/layout/TabNav';
import { FloorPlanCanvas } from './components/floorplan/FloorPlanCanvas';
import { RoomInspector } from './components/floorplan/RoomInspector';

import { HomeView } from './components/views/HomeView';
import { ProjectsView } from './components/views/ProjectsView';
import { BenchmarksView } from './components/views/BenchmarksView';
import { NewProjectView } from './components/views/NewProjectView';
import { PlotView } from './components/views/PlotView';
import { AlternativesView } from './components/views/AlternativesView';
import { ValidationView } from './components/views/ValidationView';
import { ExplainabilityView } from './components/views/ExplainabilityView';
import { RefinementView } from './components/views/RefinementView';
import { ExportView } from './components/views/ExportView';

import {
  getProjectData,
  generateFloorPlan,
  submitClarificationResponse,
  resumeProject,
  cancelProject,
} from './api/projects';
import type {
  ProjectData,
  GenerationRequest,
  GenerationResponse,
  GeoRoom,
  FloorPlan,
  FloorPlanSet,
} from './api/types';

import { ConversationalStudio } from './components/chat/ConversationalStudio';

import './styles/index.css';
import './styles/components.css';
import { getValidationDisplayStatus } from './utils/validationStatus';

export function App() {
  const [currentView, setCurrentView] = useState<'home' | 'assistant' | 'projects' | 'benchmarks' | 'new_project' | 'project_detail'>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const v = params.get('view');
      if (v === 'assistant' || v === 'projects' || v === 'benchmarks' || v === 'new_project' || v === 'project_detail') {
        return v;
      }
      if (params.get('project')) return 'project_detail';
    }
    return 'home';
  });
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ActiveTab>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const t = params.get('tab') as ActiveTab;
      if (t && ['overview', 'plot', 'alternatives', 'validation', 'refinement', 'explainability', 'export'].includes(t)) {
        return t;
      }
    }
    return 'overview';
  });

  const [activeProjectId, setActiveProjectId] = useState<string | null>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      return params.get('project') || null;
    }
    return null;
  });
  const [projectData, setProjectData] = useState<ProjectData | null>(null);
  const [generationResponse, setGenerationResponse] = useState<GenerationResponse | null>(null);

  const [activeFloor, setActiveFloor] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const f = parseInt(params.get('floor') || '1', 10);
      return isNaN(f) ? 1 : f;
    }
    return 1;
  });
  const [selectedAlternativeIndex, setSelectedAlternativeIndex] = useState<number>(1);
  const [selectedRoom, setSelectedRoom] = useState<GeoRoom | null>(null);

  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isLoadingProject, setIsLoadingProject] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Preset briefs for NewProjectView
  const [initialBrief, setInitialBrief] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const [initialName, setInitialName] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);

  // Theme state: default to 'light' (clean white/black paper mode) with user toggle
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<'light' | 'dark'>(() => {
    return (localStorage.getItem('planforge_theme') as 'light' | 'dark') || 'light';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    localStorage.setItem('planforge_theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const handleToggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme((t) => (t === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  };

  // Load project data when activeProjectId changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeProjectId) return;
    let mounted = true;
    setIsLoadingProject(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    getProjectData(activeProjectId)
      .then((data) => {
        if (mounted) {
          setProjectData(data);
          setActiveFloor(1);
          setSelectedRoom(null);
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (mounted) {
          console.error('Failed to load project data', err);
          setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to load project data');
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (mounted) setIsLoadingProject(false);
      });

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, [activeProjectId]);

  const handleOpenNewProject = (presetBrief?: string, presetName?: string) => {
    setInitialBrief(presetBrief);
    setInitialName(presetName);
    setCurrentView('new_project');
    setErrorMessage(null);
  };

  const handleSelectProject = (projectId: string) => {
    setActiveProjectId(projectId);
    setCurrentView('project_detail');
    setActiveTab('overview');
  };

  const handleGenerateSubmit = async (req: GenerationRequest) => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      const resp = await generateFloorPlan(req);
      setGenerationResponse(resp);

      if (resp.status === 'waiting_for_clarification' || resp.pending_clarification) {
        // Paused workflow waiting for user response
        setActiveProjectId(resp.project_id);
        setIsGenerating(false);
        return;
      }

      if (resp.status === 'incomplete_requirements') {
        setErrorMessage(
          `Incomplete Requirements: ${resp.missing_fields?.join(', ') || 'Clarification required'}. Questions: ${resp.clarification_questions?.join(' ')}`
        );
        setIsGenerating(false);
        return;
      }

      if (!resp.is_success) {
        if (resp.status === 'failed' || (resp.error_message && resp.error_message.toLowerCase().includes('infeasible'))) {
          setErrorMessage(`Requirements are infeasible: ${resp.error_message || 'Room requirements exceed buildable plot boundaries'}`);
        } else {
          setErrorMessage(`Plan could not be validated: ${resp.error_message || `${resp.validation_summary?.total_errors || 'Hard'} building code violations found.`}`);
        }
      }

      // Navigate to project detail
      setActiveProjectId(resp.project_id);
      setCurrentView('project_detail');
      setActiveTab('overview');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Generation failed', err);
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Floor plan generation failed');
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClarificationSubmit = async (
    selectedOptionId?: string,
    responseText?: string,
    numericOverrides?: Record<string, number>
  ) => {
    if (!generationResponse?.project_id || !generationResponse.pending_clarification) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      await submitClarificationResponse(
        generationResponse.project_id,
        generationResponse.pending_clarification.request_id,
        {
          selected_option_id: selectedOptionId,
          user_response_text: responseText,
          numeric_overrides: numericOverrides,
          expected_state_version: generationResponse.pending_clarification.state_version,
        }
      );
      // Auto-resume workflow following accepted response
      const resumed = await resumeProject(generationResponse.project_id);
      setGenerationResponse(resumed);
      if (resumed.is_success) {
        const data = await getProjectData(resumed.project_id);
        setProjectData(data);
        setActiveProjectId(resumed.project_id);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to submit clarification response');
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClarificationResume = async () => {
    if (!generationResponse?.project_id) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      const resumed = await resumeProject(generationResponse.project_id);
      setGenerationResponse(resumed);
      if (resumed.is_success) {
        const data = await getProjectData(resumed.project_id);
        setProjectData(data);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to resume generation');
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClarificationCancel = async () => {
    if (!generationResponse?.project_id) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);
    try {
      const cancelled = await cancelProject(generationResponse.project_id);
      setGenerationResponse(cancelled);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to cancel project');
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  // Determine active floor plan set (selected alternative or base project)
  const activeFloorPlanSet: FloorPlanSet | undefined = (() => {
    if (!projectData) return undefined;
    if (projectData.alternatives && projectData.alternatives.length > 0) {
      const alt = projectData.alternatives.find((a) => a.index === selectedAlternativeIndex);
      if (alt && alt.floor_plan_set) return alt.floor_plan_set;
    }
    return projectData.floor_plan_set;
  })();

  const activeFloorPlan: FloorPlan | null = (() => {
    if (!activeFloorPlanSet || !activeFloorPlanSet.floor_plans) return null;
    return (
      activeFloorPlanSet.floor_plans.find((fp) => fp.floor_number === activeFloor) ||
      activeFloorPlanSet.floor_plans[0] ||
      null
    );
  })();

  const validationReport = projectData?.validation_report || activeFloorPlanSet?.validation_report;
  const projectName = projectData?.project_metadata?.project_name || generationResponse?.project_name || activeProjectId || 'My House';

  const totalErrors = validationReport?.total_errors || (validationReport?.results?.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.issues?.filter((i) => i.severity === 'error').length || 0), 0) ?? 0);
  const totalWarnings = validationReport?.total_warnings || (validationReport?.results?.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.issues?.filter((i) => i.severity === 'warning').length || 0), 0) ?? 0);
  const isOverallValid = validationReport?.overall_valid ?? (totalErrors === 0);

  const availableFloors = activeFloorPlanSet?.floor_plans || [];
  const alternativesList = projectData?.alternatives || [];

  const validationStatus = getValidationDisplayStatus(
    validationReport,
    projectData?.refinement_result,
    projectData?.status || generationResponse?.status
  );

  return (
    <div className="app-container">
      <Header
        onNewProject={() => handleOpenNewProject()}
        onAssistant={() => {
          setCurrentView('assistant');
          setErrorMessage(null);
        }}
        onDashboard={() => setCurrentView('home')}
        onProjects={() => setCurrentView('projects')}
        onBenchmarks={() => setCurrentView('benchmarks')}
        currentView={currentView}
        theme={theme}
        onToggleTheme={handleToggleTheme}
      />

      {currentView === 'project_detail' && activeProjectId && (
        <TabNav
          projectName={projectName}
          projectId={activeProjectId}
          isValid={isOverallValid}
          statusLabel={validationStatus.label}
          statusBadgeClass={validationStatus.badgeClass}
          activeTab={activeTab}
          onTabChange={setActiveTab}
          hasTrace={projectData?.decision_trace !== undefined}
          alternativesCount={alternativesList.length || 1}
        />
      )}

      <main className={`main-content ${currentView === 'assistant' ? 'assistant-mode' : ''}`} style={currentView === 'assistant' ? { padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' } : undefined}>
        {errorMessage && (
          <div
            style={{
              padding: '0.75rem 1.25rem',
              borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
              background: 'var(--status-danger-bg)',
              border: '1px solid var(--status-danger-border)',
              color: '#f87171',
              fontSize: '0.875rem',
              marginBottom: currentView === 'assistant' ? 0 : '1rem',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <div>
              <strong>Alert:</strong> {errorMessage}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setErrorMessage(null)}
              style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: '#f87171', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '1rem' }}
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* View 0: Conversational AI Assistant (Two-Panel Studio) */}
        {currentView === 'assistant' && (
          <ConversationalStudio
            initialBrief={initialBrief}
            initialProjectName={initialName}
            isGenerating={isGenerating}
            projectData={projectData}
            generationResponse={generationResponse}
            onGenerateSubmit={handleGenerateSubmit}
            activeFloor={activeFloor}
            onSelectFloor={setActiveFloor}
            selectedAlternativeIndex={selectedAlternativeIndex}
            onSelectAlternative={setSelectedAlternativeIndex}
            selectedRoom={selectedRoom}
            onSelectRoom={setSelectedRoom}
            theme={theme}
            onViewTrace={() => {
              setCurrentView('project_detail');
              setActiveTab('explainability');
            }}
            onViewExports={() => {
              setCurrentView('project_detail');
              setActiveTab('export');
            }}
            onClarificationSubmit={handleClarificationSubmit}
            onClarificationResume={handleClarificationResume}
            onClarificationCancel={handleClarificationCancel}
          />
        )}

        {/* View 1: Home Page (Section 3) */}
        {currentView === 'home' && (
          <HomeView
            onSelectProject={handleSelectProject}
            onNewProject={() => handleOpenNewProject()}
            onStartAssistant={() => {
              setCurrentView('assistant');
              setErrorMessage(null);
            }}
            onViewProjects={() => setCurrentView('projects')}
            onViewBenchmarks={() => setCurrentView('benchmarks')}
          />
        )}

        {/* View 2: Projects Table (Section 19) */}
        {currentView === 'projects' && (
          <ProjectsView
            onSelectProject={handleSelectProject}
            onNewProject={() => handleOpenNewProject()}
          />
        )}

        {/* View 3: Benchmarks Presets (Section 22) */}
        {currentView === 'benchmarks' && (
          <BenchmarksView
            onLoadBenchmark={(brief, name) => handleOpenNewProject(brief, name)}
            onBack={() => setCurrentView('home')}
          />
        )}

        {/* View 4: New Project 5-Step Wizard (Section 4-9) */}
        {currentView === 'new_project' && (
          <NewProjectView
            initialBrief={initialBrief}
            initialName={initialName}
            onSubmit={handleGenerateSubmit}
            isLoading={isGenerating}
            onCancel={() => setCurrentView('home')}
          />
        )}

        {/* View 5: Results Page (Section 10-18) */}
        {currentView === 'project_detail' && (
          <div style={{ width: '100%', margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1rem' }}>
            {isLoadingProject ? (
              <div className="card" style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '3rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                Loading floor plan geometry and verification records...
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* DEFAULT & PRIMARY RESULTS VIEW: FLOOR PLAN (Section 10) */}
                {(activeTab === 'overview' || activeTab === 'floorplan') && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1rem' }}>
                    {/* Top Switcher Bar: Alternatives & Floors (Sections 11 & 12) */}
                    <div
                      className="card"
                      style={{
                        padding: '0.65rem 1rem',
                        display: 'flex',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        flexWrap: 'wrap',
                        gap: '0.75rem',
                      }}
                    >
                      {/* Left: Floor Selector (Section 12) */}
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>FLOOR:</span>
                        {availableFloors.length > 1 ? (
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                            {availableFloors.map((fp) => (
                              <button
                                key={fp.floor_number}
                                className={`btn ${activeFloor === fp.floor_number ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setActiveFloor(fp.floor_number);
                                  setSelectedRoom(null);
                                }}
                                style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.65rem', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                              >
                                Floor {fp.floor_number}
                              </button>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>Floor 1</span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Right: Alternative Switcher (Section 11) */}
                      {alternativesList.length > 1 && (
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>ALTERNATIVE:</span>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                            {alternativesList.map((alt) => (
                              <button
                                key={alt.index}
                                className={`btn ${selectedAlternativeIndex === alt.index ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setSelectedAlternativeIndex(alt.index);
                                  setSelectedRoom(null);
                                }}
                                style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.65rem', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                              >
                                Alternative {alt.index}
                              </button>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Dominant Element: Floor Plan Canvas (Section 10 & 13) */}
                    <div style={{ minHeight: '620px', width: '100%' }}>
                      <FloorPlanCanvas
                        floorPlan={activeFloorPlan}
                        plotBoundary={activeFloorPlanSet?.plot_boundary || []}
                        buildableBoundary={activeFloorPlanSet?.buildable_boundary || []}
                        selectedRoom={selectedRoom}
                        onSelectRoom={setSelectedRoom}
                        projectId={activeProjectId || ''}
                        alternativeIndex={selectedAlternativeIndex}
                        theme={theme}
                        orientation={projectData?.requirements?.orientation || 'north'}
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* Bottom Split Panels: Room Information & Validation (Section 10) */}
                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'start' }}>
                      {/* Left: Room Information (Section 14) */}
                      {selectedRoom ? (
                        <RoomInspector
                          room={selectedRoom}
                          geometry={activeFloorPlan?.geometry || null}
                          validationResult={activeFloorPlan?.validation}
                          onClose={() => setSelectedRoom(null)}
                          onViewTrace={() => setActiveTab('explainability')}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="card" style={{ padding: '1.25rem', height: '100%', minHeight: '140px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                          <h3 style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: '0 0 0.4rem 0' }}>Room Information</h3>
                          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.85rem', margin: 0 }}>
                            Click a room on the floor plan to inspect its details.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Right: Validation Summary (Section 10 & 15) */}
                      <div className="card" style={{ padding: '1.25rem', height: '100%' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '0.65rem' }}>
                          <h3 style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: 0 }}>Validation Summary</h3>
                          <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.825rem', letterSpacing: '0.03em', color: validationStatus.type === 'valid' || validationStatus.type === 'refined' ? 'var(--status-success)' : '#f87171' }}>
                            {validationStatus.label}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1.25rem', fontSize: '0.825rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>
                          <span><strong style={{ color: totalErrors > 0 ? '#f87171' : 'inherit' }}>{totalErrors}</strong> hard errors</span>
                          <span><strong style={{ color: totalWarnings > 0 ? '#fbbf24' : 'inherit' }}>{totalWarnings}</strong> warnings/advisories</span>
                        </div>

                        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '0.4rem', fontSize: '0.825rem' }}>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--status-success)' }}>✓</span>
                            <span>Boundary</span>
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--status-success)' }}>✓</span>
                            <span>Dimensions</span>
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--status-success)' }}>✓</span>
                            <span>Adjacency</span>
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--status-success)' }}>✓</span>
                            <span>Connectivity</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <button
                          className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
                          style={{ marginTop: '0.85rem', fontSize: '0.775rem', width: '100%' }}
                          onClick={() => setActiveTab('validation')}
                        >
                          View Full Validation Report →
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Sub-Tabs for Detailed Inspection */}
                {activeTab === 'validation' && (
                  <ValidationView validationReport={validationReport} />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'alternatives' && (
                  <AlternativesView
                    alternatives={alternativesList}
                    projectId={activeProjectId || ''}
                    selectedAlternativeIndex={selectedAlternativeIndex}
                    onSelectAlternative={setSelectedAlternativeIndex}
                    onViewFloorPlan={() => setActiveTab('overview')}
                  />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'explainability' && (
                  <ExplainabilityView
                    decisionTrace={projectData?.decision_trace}
                    floorPlanSet={activeFloorPlanSet}
                  />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'refinement' && (
                  <RefinementView refinementResult={projectData?.refinement_result} />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'export' && (
                  <ExportView
                    projectId={activeProjectId || ''}
                    floorPlanSet={activeFloorPlanSet}
                  />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'plot' && projectData && (
                  <PlotView
                    projectData={projectData}
                    onAdjustPlot={() => {
                      handleOpenNewProject(
                        projectData.requirements?.raw_input,
                        `${projectData.project_metadata?.project_name || 'Project'} (Revised Plot)`
                      );
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';

interface ChatInputProps {
  onSendMessage: (message: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
}

export const ChatInput: React.FC<ChatInputProps> = ({
  onSendMessage,
  disabled = false,
  placeholder = 'Describe your building, or answer using cards above...',
}) => {
  const [text, setText] = useState<string>('');
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  // Auto-focus input on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!disabled && textareaRef.current) {
      textareaRef.current.focus();
    }
  }, [disabled]);

  const handleSubmit = (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const clean = text.trim();
    if (!clean || disabled) return;
    onSendMessage(clean);
    setText('');
    if (textareaRef.current) {
      textareaRef.current.style.height = 'auto';
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSubmit();
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    setText(e.target.value);
    if (textareaRef.current) {
      textareaRef.current.style.height = 'auto';
      textareaRef.current.style.height = `${Math.min(textareaRef.current.scrollHeight, 120)}px`;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="chat-input-bar">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="chat-input-form" data-testid="chat-input-form">
        <textarea
          ref={textareaRef}
          className="chat-textarea"
          rows={1}
          value={text}
          onChange={handleChange}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label="Chat input message"
          data-testid="chat-input-textarea"
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          className="chat-send-btn"
          disabled={disabled || !text.trim()}
          title="Send message"
          data-testid="chat-send-btn"
          aria-label="Send message"
        >
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13" />
            <polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { MessageBubble, type ChatMessage } from './MessageBubble';
import { RequirementProgress } from './RequirementProgress';
import { ChatInput } from './ChatInput';
import { TypingIndicator } from './TypingIndicator';
import type { RequirementProgressItem } from '../../api/types';

interface ChatPanelProps {
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  progress: RequirementProgressItem[];
  remainingCount: number;
  isReadyForGeneration: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  onSendMessage: (msg: string) => void;
  onExecuteAction?: (action: import('../../api/types').ChatActionData) => void;
  onResetConversation: () => void;
  projectName?: string;
  onOpenCustomPlot?: () => void;
}

export const ChatPanel: React.FC<ChatPanelProps> = ({
  messages,
  progress,
  remainingCount,
  isReadyForGeneration,
  isLoading,
  onSendMessage,
  onExecuteAction,
  onResetConversation,
  projectName = 'PlanForge AI',
  onOpenCustomPlot,
}) => {
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Auto-scroll to newest message
  useEffect(() => {
    if (scrollRef.current) {
      scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [messages, isLoading]);

  // Find index of latest assistant message
  let latestAssistantIndex = -1;
  for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (messages[i].role === 'assistant') {
      latestAssistantIndex = i;
      break;
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="chat-panel-container" data-testid="chat-panel">
      {/* 1. Header */}
      <header className="chat-header">
        <div className="chat-header-title">
          <div className="chat-header-avatar">P</div>
          <div className="chat-header-text">
            <h2>{projectName}</h2>
            <div className="chat-header-status">
              <span className="chat-status-dot" />
              <span>Conversational Architect</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="chat-header-actions">
          <button
            className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
            onClick={onResetConversation}
            title="Start fresh conversation"
            style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '0.25rem 0.55rem' }}
          >
            ↻ Reset
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* 2. Requirement Progress Section */}
      <RequirementProgress
        progress={progress}
        remainingCount={remainingCount}
        isReadyForGeneration={isReadyForGeneration}
      />

      {/* 3. Messages History */}
      <div className="chat-messages-container" ref={scrollRef}>
        {messages.map((msg, idx) => (
          <MessageBubble
            key={msg.id || idx}
            message={msg}
            isLatestAssistant={idx === latestAssistantIndex}
            onAnswerCard={onSendMessage}
            onExecuteAction={onExecuteAction}
            disabled={isLoading}
            onOpenCustomPlot={onOpenCustomPlot}
          />
        ))}


        {isLoading && (
          <div className="chat-message-row assistant">
            <div className="chat-message-avatar">P</div>
            <div className="chat-message-content-wrapper">
              <TypingIndicator />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 4. Chat Input */}
      <ChatInput
        onSendMessage={onSendMessage}
        disabled={isLoading}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import type { ClarificationOption, ClarificationRequest, FeasibilityType } from '../../api/types';

interface ClarificationPanelProps {
  projectId: string;
  clarification: ClarificationRequest;
  onSubmitResponse: (
    selectedOptionId?: string,
    responseText?: string,
    numericOverrides?: Record<string, number>
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onResume?: () => Promise<void>;
  onCancel?: () => Promise<void>;
  isSubmitting?: boolean;
  statusMessage?: string | null;
  stateVersion?: number;
}

export const ClarificationPanel: React.FC<ClarificationPanelProps> = ({
  projectId,
  clarification,
  onSubmitResponse,
  onResume,
  onCancel,
  isSubmitting = false,
  statusMessage = null,
  stateVersion,
}) => {
  const [selectedOptionId, setSelectedOptionId] = useState<string>(
    clarification.options.length > 0 ? clarification.options[0].option_id : ''
  );
  const [customText, setCustomText] = useState<string>('');
  const [numericInputs, setNumericInputs] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [localError, setLocalError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleOptionSelect = (option: ClarificationOption) => {
    setSelectedOptionId(option.option_id);
    if (option.numeric_changes) {
      setNumericInputs({ ...option.numeric_changes });
    }
  };

  const handleNumericChange = (key: string, value: string) => {
    const parsed = parseFloat(value);
    setNumericInputs((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed,
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setLocalError(null);
    if (!selectedOptionId && !customText.trim() && Object.keys(numericInputs).length === 0) {
      setLocalError('Please select an option or provide input to resolve this clarification.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await onSubmitResponse(
        selectedOptionId || undefined,
        customText.trim() || undefined,
        Object.keys(numericInputs).length > 0 ? numericInputs : undefined
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLocalError(err.message || 'Failed to submit response');
    }
  };

  const getFeasibilityBadge = (type: FeasibilityType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'verified_feasible':
        return (
          <span
            className="feasibility-badge verified"
            style={{
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              fontWeight: 700,
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              backgroundColor: '#e6f4ea',
              color: '#137333',
              border: '1px solid #ceead6',
            }}
          >
            ✓ Verified Feasible
          </span>
        );
      case 'suggested_alternative':
        return (
          <span
            className="feasibility-badge suggested"
            style={{
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              fontWeight: 700,
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              backgroundColor: '#e8f0fe',
              color: '#1a73e8',
              border: '1px solid #d2e3fc',
            }}
          >
            💡 Suggested Alternative (Pending Authorization)
          </span>
        );
      case 'unverified_hypothetical':
      default:
        return (
          <span
            className="feasibility-badge hypothetical"
            style={{
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              fontWeight: 700,
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              backgroundColor: '#fef7e0',
              color: '#b06000',
              border: '1px solid #feefc3',
            }}
          >
            ⚡ Unverified Hypothetical
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="clarification-panel-container"
      data-testid="clarification-panel"
      style={{
        padding: '1.5rem',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-card, #ffffff)',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        border: '1px solid var(--border-default, #e0e0e0)',
        boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)',
        maxWidth: '720px',
        margin: '1.5rem auto',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
        <div>
          <span
            style={{
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              fontWeight: 700,
              textTransform: 'uppercase',
              color: '#d93025',
              letterSpacing: '0.5px',
            }}
          >
            Agentic Clarification Required
          </span>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: '0.25rem 0 0 0' }}>
            {clarification.category.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#666', background: '#f1f3f4', padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
            Version: {stateVersion ?? clarification.state_version}
          </span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#666', background: '#f1f3f4', padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
            ID: {clarification.request_id.slice(0, 10)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Question Prompt */}
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '1rem',
          backgroundColor: '#fff8e1',
          borderRadius: '6px',
          borderLeft: '4px solid #f9ab00',
          marginBottom: '1rem',
        }}
      >
        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 500, fontSize: '0.95rem', color: '#3c4043' }}>
          {clarification.question}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Measured Deficit & Evidence */}
      {(clarification.measured_deficit_sqm != null || clarification.evidence) && (
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '0.85rem 1rem',
            backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            border: '1px solid #e8eaed',
            marginBottom: '1.25rem',
          }}
        >
          {clarification.measured_deficit_sqm != null && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1.5rem', marginBottom: '0.5rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#5f6368', display: 'block' }}>Required Area</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>{clarification.required_sqm} m²</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#5f6368', display: 'block' }}>Available Area</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>{clarification.available_sqm} m²</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#d93025', display: 'block' }}>Measured Deficit</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#d93025' }}>
                  -{clarification.measured_deficit_sqm} m²
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {clarification.evidence && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#5f6368', lineHeight: '1.4' }}>
              <strong>Evidence:</strong> {clarification.evidence}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Selectable Alternatives */}
      {clarification.options.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: '1.25rem' }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600, display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>
            Choose an Authorized Resolution Strategy:
          </label>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.65rem' }}>
            {clarification.options.map((option) => {
              const isSelected = selectedOptionId === option.option_id;
              return (
                <div
                  key={option.option_id}
                  onClick={() => handleOptionSelect(option)}
                  data-testid={`clarification-option-${option.option_id}`}
                  style={{
                    padding: '0.85rem 1rem',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    border: isSelected ? '2px solid #1a73e8' : '1px solid #dadce0',
                    backgroundColor: isSelected ? '#f8fbff' : '#ffffff',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: '0.35rem' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                      <input
                        type="radio"
                        name="clarification_opt"
                        checked={isSelected}
                        onChange={() => handleOptionSelect(option)}
                        style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
                      />
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>{option.title}</span>
                    </div>
                    {getFeasibilityBadge(option.feasibility_type)}
                  </div>
                  <p style={{ margin: '0 0 0.35rem 1.6rem', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#5f6368', lineHeight: '1.4' }}>
                    {option.description}
                  </p>
                  {option.affected_rooms && option.affected_rooms.length > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ marginLeft: '1.6rem', display: 'flex', gap: '0.35rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      {option.affected_rooms.map((rm) => (
                        <span
                          key={rm}
                          style={{
                            fontSize: '0.7rem',
                            backgroundColor: '#e8eaed',
                            color: '#3c4043',
                            padding: '1px 6px',
                            borderRadius: '4px',
                          }}
                        >
                          {rm}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Free-text response if permitted */}
      {clarification.allow_free_text && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: '1.25rem' }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600, display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.35rem' }}>
            Additional Instructions or Freeform Preference (Optional):
          </label>
          <textarea
            data-testid="clarification-free-text"
            value={customText}
            onChange={(e) => setCustomText(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Type specific room adjustments, boundaries, or requirements here..."
            rows={2}
            style={{
              width: '100%',
              padding: '0.65rem',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              border: '1px solid #dadce0',
              fontSize: '0.85rem',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              resize: 'vertical',
            }}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Status or validation message */}
      {statusMessage && (
        <div
          data-testid="clarification-status-msg"
          style={{
            padding: '0.65rem 1rem',
            backgroundColor: '#e6f4ea',
            color: '#137333',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            fontSize: '0.85rem',
            marginBottom: '1rem',
          }}
        >
          {statusMessage}
        </div>
      )}
      {localError && (
        <div
          data-testid="clarification-error-msg"
          style={{
            padding: '0.65rem 1rem',
            backgroundColor: '#fce8e6',
            color: '#c5221f',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            fontSize: '0.85rem',
            marginBottom: '1rem',
          }}
        >
          {localError}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Action Buttons */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: '0.75rem', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
        {onCancel && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn btn-outline"
            data-testid="clarification-cancel-btn"
            onClick={onCancel}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            style={{
              padding: '0.5rem 1rem',
              fontSize: '0.85rem',

          >

        <button
          type="button"

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { ChatPanel } from './ChatPanel';
import { FloorPlanWorkspace } from './FloorPlanWorkspace';
import { type ChatMessage } from './MessageBubble';
import { CustomPlotModal } from './CustomPlotModal';
import { type PlotData } from '../plot-editor/PlotEditor';
import { sendChatTurn } from '../../api/projects';
import type {
  RequirementProgressItem,
  ProjectData,
  GenerationResponse,
  GeoRoom,
  GenerationRequest,
} from '../../api/types';

interface ConversationalStudioProps {
  initialBrief?: string;
  initialProjectName?: string;
  isGenerating: boolean;
  projectData: ProjectData | null;
  generationResponse: GenerationResponse | null;
  onGenerateSubmit: (req: GenerationRequest) => Promise<void>;
  activeFloor: number;
  onSelectFloor: (floor: number) => void;
  selectedAlternativeIndex: number;
  onSelectAlternative: (index: number) => void;
  selectedRoom: GeoRoom | null;
  onSelectRoom: (room: GeoRoom | null) => void;
  theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
  onViewTrace?: () => void;
  onViewExports?: () => void;
  onClarificationSubmit?: (
    selectedOptionId?: string,
    responseText?: string,
    numericOverrides?: Record<string, number>
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onClarificationResume?: () => Promise<void>;
  onClarificationCancel?: () => Promise<void>;
}

export const ConversationalStudio: React.FC<ConversationalStudioProps> = ({
  initialBrief,
  initialProjectName,
  isGenerating,
  projectData,
  generationResponse,
  onGenerateSubmit,
  activeFloor,
  onSelectFloor,
  selectedAlternativeIndex,
  onSelectAlternative,
  selectedRoom,
  onSelectRoom,
  theme = 'light',
  onViewTrace,
  onViewExports,
  onClarificationSubmit,
  onClarificationResume,
  onClarificationCancel,
}) => {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<RequirementProgressItem[]>([]);
  const [remainingCount, setRemainingCount] = useState<number>(5);
  const [isReadyForGeneration, setIsReadyForGeneration] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [canonicalBrief, setCanonicalBrief] = useState<string>(initialBrief || '');
  const [projectName, setProjectName] = useState<string>(initialProjectName || 'PlanForge Residential Project');
  const [isLoadingChat, setIsLoadingChat] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isCustomPlotModalOpen, setIsCustomPlotModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [savedPlotData, setSavedPlotData] = useState<PlotData | undefined>(undefined);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);

  // Initialize conversation
  const initConversation = useCallback(async (starterBrief?: string) => {
    setIsLoadingChat(true);
    try {
      if (starterBrief && starterBrief.trim()) {
        // Pre-loaded prompt (e.g. from benchmarks)
        const resp = await sendChatTurn({
          message: starterBrief,
          project_name: projectName,
        });

        if (resp.conversation_id) {
          setConversationId(resp.conversation_id);
        }

        const initialMsgs: ChatMessage[] = [
          {
            id: 'init-user',
            role: 'user',
            text: starterBrief,
            time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
          },
          {
            id: 'init-ai',
            role: 'assistant',
            text: resp.message,
            time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
            question_card: resp.question_card,
            response_type: resp.response_type,
            intent: resp.intent,
            conversation_stage: resp.conversation_stage,
            quick_replies: resp.quick_replies,
            missing_requirements: resp.missing_requirements,
            requirements_updated: resp.requirements_updated,
            action: resp.action,
            is_ready_for_generation: resp.is_ready_for_generation,
          },
        ];

        setMessages(initialMsgs);
        setProgress(resp.progress || []);
        setRemainingCount(resp.remaining_count || 0);
        setIsReadyForGeneration(resp.is_ready_for_generation);
        setCanonicalBrief(resp.requirements_text || starterBrief);
      } else {
        // Standard initial greeting
        const resp = await sendChatTurn({
          message: '',
          project_name: projectName,
        });

        if (resp.conversation_id) {
          setConversationId(resp.conversation_id);
        }

        const initialAiMsg: ChatMessage = {
          id: 'welcome-ai',
          role: 'assistant',
          text: resp.message,
          time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
          question_card: resp.question_card,
          response_type: resp.response_type,
          intent: resp.intent,
          conversation_stage: resp.conversation_stage,
          quick_replies: resp.quick_replies,
          missing_requirements: resp.missing_requirements,
          requirements_updated: resp.requirements_updated,
          action: resp.action,
          is_ready_for_generation: resp.is_ready_for_generation,
        };

        setMessages([initialAiMsg]);
        setProgress(resp.progress || []);
        setRemainingCount(resp.remaining_count || 5);
        setIsReadyForGeneration(false);
        setCanonicalBrief('');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to initialize conversation', err);
      setMessages([
        {
          id: 'err-ai',
          role: 'assistant',
          text: 'Hello! I am PlanForge AI. You can describe your building requirements to get started.',
          time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
          response_type: 'text',
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingChat(false);
    }
  }, [projectName]);

  useEffect(() => {
    initConversation(initialBrief);
  }, [initConversation, initialBrief]);

  // Handle user sending text or answering a question card
  const handleOpenCustomPlot = () => {
    setIsCustomPlotModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCustomPlotSubmit = async (plot: PlotData) => {
    setIsCustomPlotModalOpen(false);
    setSavedPlotData(plot);

    // Format coordinates in meters
    const coordsStr = plot.vertices.map(([x, y]) => `(${Number(x).toFixed(1)}, ${Number(y).toFixed(1)})`).join(', ');
    const plotBriefSnippet = `Plot polygon: ${coordsStr} facing ${plot.orientation} with front setback: ${plot.frontSetback}m, rear setback: ${plot.rearSetback}m, side setback: ${plot.sideSetback}m.`;

    // Compact user message in chat: "Custom irregular plot defined."
    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
      role: 'user',
      text: 'Custom irregular plot defined.',
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setIsLoadingChat(true);

    try {
      const resp = await sendChatTurn({
        message: plotBriefSnippet,
        existing_brief: canonicalBrief,
        project_name: projectName,
        conversation_id: conversationId,
      });

      if (resp.conversation_id) {
        setConversationId(resp.conversation_id);
      }

      const aiReply: ChatMessage = {
        id: `ai-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        text: resp.message,
        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
        question_card: resp.question_card,
        response_type: resp.response_type,
        intent: resp.intent,
        conversation_stage: resp.conversation_stage,
        quick_replies: resp.quick_replies,
        missing_requirements: resp.missing_requirements,
        requirements_updated: resp.requirements_updated,
        action: resp.action,
        is_ready_for_generation: resp.is_ready_for_generation,
      };

      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, aiReply]);
      setProgress(resp.progress || []);
      setRemainingCount(resp.remaining_count || 0);
      setIsReadyForGeneration(resp.is_ready_for_generation);
      if (resp.requirements_text) {
        setCanonicalBrief(resp.requirements_text);
      }
      if (resp.project_name) {
        setProjectName(resp.project_name);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Chat turn failed for custom plot', err);
      const errReply: ChatMessage = {
        id: `err-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        text: `Sorry, I encountered an issue saving your custom plot: ${err.message || 'Unknown error'}. Please try again.`,
        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
        response_type: 'text',
      };
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, errReply]);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingChat(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendMessage = async (userText: string) => {
    const cleanText = userText.trim();
    if (!cleanText || isLoadingChat || isGenerating) return;

    // Check if user requested custom irregular plot via chat message
    const isCustomPlotRequest =
      cleanText.toLowerCase().includes('custom irregular plot') ||
      cleanText.toLowerCase() === 'custom irregular plot' ||
      cleanText.toLowerCase() === 'irregular plot';

    if (isCustomPlotRequest) {
      setIsCustomPlotModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }

    // 1. If user clicks "Generate Floor Plan" confirmation
    if (
      cleanText.toLowerCase().includes('generate floor plan') ||
      cleanText.toLowerCase() === 'generate' ||
      cleanText === '✓ Generate Floor Plan'
    ) {
      // Add user message
      const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
        id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'user',
        text: 'Generate Floor Plan',
        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
      };

      const aiMsg: ChatMessage = {
        id: `ai-${Date.now() + 1}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        text: 'Starting generation pipeline! Executing spatial allocation (ASAA), architectural intent synthesis, CAD geometry construction, and independent code validation...',
        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
        response_type: 'generation_progress',
      };

      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg, aiMsg]);

      // Trigger authoritative generation through existing pipeline
      await onGenerateSubmit({
        brief: canonicalBrief,
        project_name: projectName,
        num_alternatives: 3,
        enable_refinement: true,
        max_refinement_iterations: 5,
        enable_rendering: true,
        enable_exports: true,
        create_zip: false,
        plot_shape: savedPlotData?.vertices,
        conversation_id: conversationId,
      });

      return;
    }

    // 2. Normal conversational turn (text or card choice)
    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
      role: 'user',
      text: cleanText,
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setIsLoadingChat(true);

    // Determine target floor from text or activeFloor state
    const floorMatch = cleanText.match(/\bfloor\s*(\d+)\b/i);
    let targetFloor = floorMatch ? parseInt(floorMatch[1], 10) : activeFloor;

    const chatHistory = messages
      .filter((m) => m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'assistant')
      .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, text: m.text }))
      .slice(-20);

    try {
      const resp = await sendChatTurn({
        message: cleanText,
        existing_brief: canonicalBrief,
        project_name: projectName,
        conversation_id: conversationId,
        history: chatHistory,
        active_floor: targetFloor,
      });

      if (resp.conversation_id) {
        setConversationId(resp.conversation_id);
      }

      const aiReply: ChatMessage = {
        id: `ai-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        text: resp.message,
        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
        question_card: resp.question_card,
        response_type: resp.response_type,
        intent: resp.intent,
        conversation_stage: resp.conversation_stage,
        quick_replies: resp.quick_replies,
        missing_requirements: resp.missing_requirements,
        requirements_updated: resp.requirements_updated,
        action: resp.action,
        is_ready_for_generation: resp.is_ready_for_generation,
      };

      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, aiReply]);
      setProgress(resp.progress || []);
      setRemainingCount(resp.remaining_count || 0);
      setIsReadyForGeneration(resp.is_ready_for_generation);
      let updatedBrief = canonicalBrief;
      if (resp.requirements_text) {
        updatedBrief = resp.requirements_text;
        setCanonicalBrief(resp.requirements_text);
      }
      if (resp.project_name) {
        setProjectName(resp.project_name);
      }

      // Check if backend instructed auto-execution of generation (Section 9)
      if (resp.action && resp.action.type === 'generate_floor_plan' && resp.action.auto_execute) {
        await onGenerateSubmit({
          brief: updatedBrief,
          project_name: resp.project_name || projectName,
          num_alternatives: 3,
          enable_refinement: true,
          max_refinement_iterations: 5,
          enable_rendering: true,
          enable_exports: true,
          create_zip: false,
          plot_shape: savedPlotData?.vertices,
          conversation_id: resp.conversation_id || conversationId,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Chat turn failed', err);
      const errReply: ChatMessage = {
        id: `err-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        text: `Sorry, I encountered an issue: ${err.message || 'Unknown error'}. Please try again.`,
        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
        response_type: 'text',
      };
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, errReply]);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingChat(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExecuteAction = async (action: import('../../api/types').ChatActionData) => {
    if (action.type === 'generate_floor_plan') {
      await handleSendMessage('Generate Floor Plan');
    } else if (action.type === 'export' && onViewExports) {
      onViewExports();
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setConversationId(undefined);
    initConversation(undefined);
  };

  return (
    <div className="conversational-studio" data-testid="conversational-studio">
      {/* LEFT PANEL: Conversational PlanForge AI Assistant */}
      <ChatPanel
        messages={messages}
        progress={progress}
        remainingCount={remainingCount}
        isReadyForGeneration={isReadyForGeneration}
        isLoading={isLoadingChat}
        onSendMessage={handleSendMessage}
        onExecuteAction={handleExecuteAction}
        onResetConversation={handleReset}
        projectName={projectName}
        onOpenCustomPlot={handleOpenCustomPlot}
      />


      {/* RIGHT PANEL: Floor-plan Visualization / Canvas Workspace */}
      <FloorPlanWorkspace
        isGenerating={isGenerating}
        projectData={projectData}
        generationResponse={generationResponse}
        activeFloor={activeFloor}
        onSelectFloor={onSelectFloor}
        selectedAlternativeIndex={selectedAlternativeIndex}
        onSelectAlternative={onSelectAlternative}
        selectedRoom={selectedRoom}
        onSelectRoom={onSelectRoom}
        theme={theme}
        onViewTrace={onViewTrace}
        onViewExports={onViewExports}
        onClarificationSubmit={onClarificationSubmit}
        onClarificationResume={onClarificationResume}
        onClarificationCancel={onClarificationCancel}
      />

      {/* MODAL: Custom Irregular Plot Editor Popup */}
      <CustomPlotModal
        isOpen={isCustomPlotModalOpen}
        initialPlotData={savedPlotData}
        onSave={handleCustomPlotSubmit}
        onCancel={() => setIsCustomPlotModalOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
