import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { PlotEditor, type PlotData } from '../plot-editor/PlotEditor';

interface CustomPlotModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  initialPlotData?: PlotData;
  onSave: (plotData: PlotData) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

const DEFAULT_IRREGULAR_PLOT: PlotData = {
  mode: 'irregular',
  vertices: [
    [0, 0],
    [12, 0],
    [12, 8],
    [7, 10],
    [0, 8],
  ],
  width: 12,
  length: 10,
  unit: 'm',
  frontSetback: 2,
  rearSetback: 2,
  sideSetback: 2,
  orientation: 'north',
  isClosed: true,
};

export const CustomPlotModal: React.FC<CustomPlotModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  initialPlotData,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}) => {
  const [plotData, setPlotData] = useState<PlotData>(() => {
    if (initialPlotData && initialPlotData.vertices) {
      return {
        ...initialPlotData,
        mode: 'irregular',
      };
    }
    return DEFAULT_IRREGULAR_PLOT;
  });

  const [isValid, setIsValid] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const [hasAttemptedSubmit, setHasAttemptedSubmit] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      if (initialPlotData && initialPlotData.vertices) {
        setPlotData({
          ...initialPlotData,
          mode: 'irregular',
        });
        const tooFew = initialPlotData.vertices.length < 3;
        setIsValid(!tooFew);
        if (tooFew) {
          setErrorMessage('An irregular plot requires at least 3 vertices.');
        }
      }
      setHasAttemptedSubmit(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, initialPlotData]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleValidationChange = (valid: boolean, message?: string) => {
    setIsValid(valid);
    setErrorMessage(message);
  };

  const handleContinue = () => {
    setHasAttemptedSubmit(true);
    if (!isValid || plotData.vertices.length < 3 || !plotData.isClosed) {
      if (plotData.vertices.length < 3) {
        setErrorMessage('An irregular plot requires at least 3 vertices.');
      } else if (!plotData.isClosed) {
        setErrorMessage('Polygon boundary must be closed.');
      }
      setIsValid(false);
      return;
    }
    onSave(plotData);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="custom-plot-modal-overlay"
      data-testid="custom-plot-modal"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 1000,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: '1.5rem',
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="card custom-plot-modal-card"
        style={{
          width: '95%',
          maxWidth: '1060px',
          maxHeight: '90vh',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-card)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border-strong)',
          borderRadius: 'var(--radius-lg)',
          boxShadow: '0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)',
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '1.15rem 1.5rem',
            borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-default)',
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface)',
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.65rem' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem' }}>📐</span>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.15rem', fontWeight: 700, margin: 0 }}>
                Custom Plot Dimensions
              </h2>
            </div>
            <p
              style={{
                fontSize: '0.825rem',
                color: 'var(--text-secondary)',
                margin: '0.2rem 0 0 1.9rem',
              }}
            >
              Define your plot boundary &bull; Shape: <strong>Irregular Polygon</strong>
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
            onClick={onCancel}
            title="Close dialog without saving"
            data-testid="custom-plot-close-btn"
            style={{ fontSize: '0.9rem', padding: '0.25rem 0.6rem' }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body: Authoritative PlotEditor */}
        <div
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            overflowY: 'auto',
            padding: '1.25rem',
            backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-primary)',
          }}
        >
          <PlotEditor
            plotData={plotData}
            onChange={(newData) => {
              setPlotData({
                ...newData,
                mode: 'irregular',
              });
            }}
            onValidationChange={handleValidationChange}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '1rem 1.5rem',
            borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-default)',
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface)',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: '1rem' }}>
            {(!isValid || hasAttemptedSubmit) && errorMessage && (
              <div
                style={{
                  color: '#f87171',
                  fontSize: '0.825rem',
                  fontWeight: 500,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: '0.4rem',
                }}
                data-testid="plot-validation-error"
              >
                <span>⚠️</span>
                <span>{errorMessage || 'Please define a valid closed plot boundary.'}</span>
              </div>
            )}
            {isValid && (
              <div
                style={{
                  color: 'var(--status-success)',
                  fontSize: '0.825rem',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: '0.4rem',
                }}
              >
                <span>✓</span>
                <span>
                  Valid {plotData.vertices.length}-vertex irregular polygon ready to commit.
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn btn-outline"
              onClick={onCancel}
              data-testid="custom-plot-cancel-btn"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn btn-primary"
              onClick={handleContinue}
              disabled={!isValid && hasAttemptedSubmit}
              data-testid="custom-plot-continue-btn"
            >
              Continue →
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { ClarificationPanel } from './ClarificationPanel';
import { FloorPlanCanvas } from '../floorplan/FloorPlanCanvas';
import { RoomInspector } from '../floorplan/RoomInspector';
import { getValidationDisplayStatus } from '../../utils/validationStatus';
import type {
  FloorPlan,
  FloorPlanSet,
  GeoRoom,
  ProjectData,
  GenerationResponse,
} from '../../api/types';

interface FloorPlanWorkspaceProps {
  isGenerating: boolean;
  projectData: ProjectData | null;
  generationResponse: GenerationResponse | null;
  activeFloor: number;
  onSelectFloor: (floor: number) => void;
  selectedAlternativeIndex: number;
  onSelectAlternative: (index: number) => void;
  selectedRoom: GeoRoom | null;
  onSelectRoom: (room: GeoRoom | null) => void;
  theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
  onViewTrace?: () => void;
  onViewExports?: () => void;
  onClarificationSubmit?: (
    selectedOptionId?: string,
    responseText?: string,
    numericOverrides?: Record<string, number>
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onClarificationResume?: () => Promise<void>;
  onClarificationCancel?: () => Promise<void>;
}

export const FloorPlanWorkspace: React.FC<FloorPlanWorkspaceProps> = ({
  isGenerating,
  projectData,
  generationResponse,
  activeFloor,
  onSelectFloor,
  selectedAlternativeIndex,
  onSelectAlternative,
  selectedRoom,
  onSelectRoom,
  theme = 'light',
  onViewTrace,
  onViewExports,
  onClarificationSubmit,
  onClarificationResume,
  onClarificationCancel,
}) => {
  // Determine active floor plan set (selected alternative or base project)
  const activeFloorPlanSet: FloorPlanSet | undefined = (() => {
    if (!projectData) return undefined;
    if (projectData.alternatives && projectData.alternatives.length > 0) {
      const alt = projectData.alternatives.find((a) => a.index === selectedAlternativeIndex);
      if (alt && alt.floor_plan_set) return alt.floor_plan_set;
    }
    return projectData.floor_plan_set;
  })();

  const activeFloorPlan: FloorPlan | null = (() => {
    if (!activeFloorPlanSet || !activeFloorPlanSet.floor_plans) return null;
    return (
      activeFloorPlanSet.floor_plans.find((fp) => fp.floor_number === activeFloor) ||
      activeFloorPlanSet.floor_plans[0] ||
      null
    );
  })();

  const validationReport = projectData?.validation_report || activeFloorPlanSet?.validation_report;

  const validationStatus = getValidationDisplayStatus(
    validationReport,
    projectData?.refinement_result,
    projectData?.status || generationResponse?.status
  );

  const availableFloors = activeFloorPlanSet?.floor_plans || [];
  const alternativesList = projectData?.alternatives || [];
  const projectId = projectData?.project_metadata?.project_id || generationResponse?.project_id || '';
  const projectName = projectData?.project_metadata?.project_name || generationResponse?.project_name || 'PlanForge Residence';

  const hasFloorPlan = !!activeFloorPlan;

  return (
    <div className="canvas-workspace-container" data-testid="floor-plan-workspace">
      {/* 1. STATE: GENERATING IN PROGRESS */}
      {isGenerating && (
        <div className="workspace-generating-state" data-testid="generating-state">
          <div className="generating-spinner-box" />
          <h3 className="generating-title">Generating your floor plan...</h3>
          <p className="generating-desc">
            Executing deterministic multi-stage pipeline across spatial allocation, physical geometry drafting, and independent building code validation.
          </p>
          <div className="stage-pills-row">
            <span className="stage-pill active">Requirement Agent</span>
            <span className="stage-pill active">Planning Strategy</span>
            <span className="stage-pill active">ASAA Allocator</span>
            <span className="stage-pill active">Architectural LLM</span>
            <span className="stage-pill active">Geometry Engine</span>
            <span className="stage-pill active">Independent Validator</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. STATE: INTERACTIVE CLARIFICATION REQUIRED */}
      {!isGenerating && generationResponse?.pending_clarification && (
        <div style={{ overflowY: 'auto', height: '100%', padding: '1.5rem', width: '100%' }}>
          <ClarificationPanel
            projectId={projectId}
            clarification={generationResponse.pending_clarification}
            onSubmitResponse={onClarificationSubmit || (async () => {})}
            onResume={onClarificationResume}
            onCancel={onClarificationCancel}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3. STATE: PRE-GENERATION EMPTY BLUEPRINT */}
      {!isGenerating && !hasFloorPlan && !generationResponse?.pending_clarification && (
        <div className="workspace-empty-state" data-testid="workspace-empty-state">
          <div className="blueprint-grid-bg" />
          <div className="empty-state-icon-box">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="36" height="36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" />
              <path d="M3 9h18" />
              <path d="M9 21V9" />
              <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="1" fill="currentColor" />
              <circle cx="15" cy="15" r="1" fill="currentColor" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h3 className="empty-state-title">Your floor plan will appear here</h3>
          <p className="empty-state-desc">
            Chat with PlanForge AI on the left or use the interactive cards to define your plot, number of floors, and room requirements.
            Once you confirm, the layout will be generated here in real time.
          </p>
          <div className="empty-state-pills">
            <span className="empty-state-pill">📐 True Meter Scale</span>
            <span className="empty-state-pill">🛡 18 Building Code Check Groups</span>
            <span className="empty-state-pill">🚪 Dynamic Door Swing Arcs</span>
            <span className="empty-state-pill">🪜 Aligned Multi-Floor Stairs</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. STATE: GENERATED ACTIVE FLOOR PLAN */}
      {!isGenerating && hasFloorPlan && !generationResponse?.pending_clarification && (
        <>
          {/* Top Bar Switchers */}
          <div className="workspace-top-bar">
            {/* Left: Project Title & Floor Selector */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.65rem' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)', maxWidth: '160px', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                {projectName}
              </span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                Floor:
              </span>
              {availableFloors.length > 1 ? (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                  {availableFloors.map((fp) => (
                    <button
                      key={fp.floor_number}
                      className={`btn ${activeFloor === fp.floor_number ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
                      onClick={() => {
                        onSelectFloor(fp.floor_number);
                        onSelectRoom(null);
                      }}
                      style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.65rem', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                    >
                      Floor {fp.floor_number}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>Floor 1</span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Middle: Alternative Switcher */}
            {alternativesList.length > 1 && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                  Alternative:
                </span>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                  {alternativesList.map((alt) => (
                    <button
                      key={alt.index}
                      className={`btn ${selectedAlternativeIndex === alt.index ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
                      onClick={() => {
                        onSelectAlternative(alt.index);
                        onSelectRoom(null);
                      }}
                      style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.65rem', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                    >
                      Alt {alt.index}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Right: Validation & Export Link */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.65rem' }}>
              <span
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  padding: '0.2rem 0.6rem',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--radius-full)',
                  backgroundColor: validationStatus.type === 'valid' || validationStatus.type === 'refined' ? 'var(--status-success-bg)' : 'var(--status-danger-bg)',
                  color: validationStatus.type === 'valid' || validationStatus.type === 'refined' ? 'var(--status-success)' : 'var(--status-danger)',
                  border: `1px solid ${validationStatus.type === 'valid' || validationStatus.type === 'refined' ? 'var(--status-success-border)' : 'var(--status-danger-border)'}`,
                }}
              >
                {validationStatus.label}
              </span>

              {projectId && (
                onViewExports ? (
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '0.25rem 0.55rem' }}
                    onClick={() => onViewExports()}
                  >
                    Downloads / Files ↗
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <a
                    href={`/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/export`}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noreferrer"
                    className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '0.25rem 0.55rem', textDecoration: 'none' }}
                  >
                    Downloads / Files ↗
                  </a>
                )
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Interactive Vector Canvas */}
          <div className="workspace-canvas-body">
            <FloorPlanCanvas
              floorPlan={activeFloorPlan}
              plotBoundary={activeFloorPlanSet?.plot_boundary || []}
              buildableBoundary={activeFloorPlanSet?.buildable_boundary || []}
              selectedRoom={selectedRoom}
              onSelectRoom={onSelectRoom}
              projectId={projectId}
              alternativeIndex={selectedAlternativeIndex}
              theme={theme}
              orientation={projectData?.requirements?.orientation || 'north'}
            />

            {/* Slide-out Room Inspector Drawer */}
            {selectedRoom && (
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  right: '1rem',
                  top: '1rem',
                  width: '320px',
                  maxWidth: '90%',
                  zIndex: 20,
                  boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-lg)',
                }}
              >
                <RoomInspector
                  room={selectedRoom}
                  geometry={activeFloorPlan?.geometry || null}
                  validationResult={activeFloorPlan?.validation}
                  onClose={() => onSelectRoom(null)}
                  onViewTrace={onViewTrace}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

[202/252] FILE: frontend/src/components/chat/MessageBubble.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { QuestionCard } from './QuestionCard';
import type { QuestionCardData, QuickReplyItem, ChatActionData } from '../../api/types';

export interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  text: string;
  time?: string;
  question_card?: QuestionCardData;
  response_type?: 'text' | 'quick_replies' | 'clarification' | 'requirement_summary' | 'generation_progress' | 'generation_result' | 'action_result' | string;
  intent?: string;
  conversation_stage?: string;
  quick_replies?: QuickReplyItem[];
  missing_requirements?: string[];
  requirements_updated?: string[];
  action?: ChatActionData;
  is_ready_for_generation?: boolean;
}

interface MessageBubbleProps {
  message: ChatMessage;
  isLatestAssistant?: boolean;
  onAnswerCard?: (answer: string) => void;
  onExecuteAction?: (action: ChatActionData) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onOpenCustomPlot?: () => void;
}

export const MessageBubble: React.FC<MessageBubbleProps> = ({
  message,
  isLatestAssistant = false,
  onAnswerCard,
  onExecuteAction,
  disabled = false,
  onOpenCustomPlot,
}) => {
  const isUser = message.role === 'user';
  const responseType = message.response_type || (message.question_card ? 'clarification' : 'text');

  // Format simple markdown into HTML safely
  const renderFormattedText = (raw: string) => {
    // Split into paragraphs
    const paragraphs = raw.split('\n\n');
    return paragraphs.map((p, idx) => {
      // Check for bullet lists
      if (p.includes('\n• ') || p.startsWith('• ') || p.includes('\n- ') || p.startsWith('- ')) {
        const items = p.split(/\n[•\-]\s*/).filter(Boolean);
        return (
          <ul key={idx} style={{ margin: '0.35rem 0', paddingLeft: '1.25rem' }}>
            {items.map((it, iIdx) => (
              <li key={iIdx} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: formatInline(it) }} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        );
      }

      // Check for headings
      if (p.startsWith('### ')) {
        return (
          <h3 key={idx} style={{ margin: '0.4rem 0', fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 700 }}>
            {p.replace('### ', '')}
          </h3>
        );
      }

      return (
        <p key={idx} style={{ margin: '0 0 0.4rem 0' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: formatInline(p) }} />
      );
    });
  };

  const formatInline = (text: string) => {
    return text
      .replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
      .replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
      .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
  };

  // Render quick replies chips
  const renderQuickReplies = () => {
    const replies = message.quick_replies || [];
    if (replies.length === 0) {
      if (message.question_card && onAnswerCard) {
        return (
          <QuestionCard
            card={message.question_card}
            onAnswer={onAnswerCard}
            disabled={disabled || !isLatestAssistant}
            onOpenCustomPlot={onOpenCustomPlot}
          />
        );
      }
      return null;
    }

    return (
      <div className="quick-replies-container" data-testid="quick-replies">
        {replies.map((reply, idx) => (
          <button
            key={idx}
            className="quick-reply-btn"
            onClick={() => onAnswerCard?.(reply.value)}
            disabled={disabled || !isLatestAssistant}
            type="button"
          >
            {reply.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  };

  // Render Action Result Card (Exports, Validations)
  const renderActionResult = () => {
    const action = message.action;
    if (!action) return null;

    if (action.type === 'export') {
      const items = (action.payload?.items || []) as Array<{
        format: string;
        label: string;
        url: string | null;
        available: boolean;
        note: string;
      }>;

      const readyItems = items.filter((it) => it.available && it.url);

      return (
        <div className="chat-response-card" data-testid="export-action-card">
          <div className="chat-response-card-header">
            <span>📦 Export Artifacts</span>
            <span>{readyItems.length > 0 ? `${readyItems.length} Available` : 'Notice'}</span>
          </div>
          {readyItems.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="export-links-grid">
              {readyItems.map((item, idx) => (
                <a
                  key={idx}
                  href={item.url!}
                  download
                  className="export-download-btn"
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  data-testid={`export-btn-${item.format}`}
                >
                  <span>⬇</span>
                  <span>{item.format.toUpperCase()}</span>
                </a>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="chat-response-card-body" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
              Export files become available once a floor plan design is generated.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (action.type === 'validation') {
      const val = action.payload?.validation;
      return (
        <div className="chat-response-card" data-testid="validation-action-card">
          <div className="chat-response-card-header">
            <span>🛡️ Validation Report</span>
            <span style={{ color: val?.overall_valid ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              {val?.overall_valid ? 'VALID' : 'NEEDS REVISION'}
            </span>
          </div>
          {val && (
            <div className="chat-response-card-body">
              <div><strong>Score:</strong> {val.overall_score}/100</div>
              <div><strong>Errors:</strong> {val.total_errors} • <strong>Warnings:</strong> {val.total_warnings}</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

    return null;
  };

  // Render Generation Progress Card
  const renderGenerationProgress = () => {
    return (
      <div className="chat-response-card" data-testid="generation-progress-card">
        <div className="chat-response-card-header">
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.4rem' }}>
            <span className="progress-pulse-dot" />
            <span>Generation In Progress</span>
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#3b82f6' }}>Running</span>
        </div>
        <div className="chat-response-card-body" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
          Executing spatial allocation (ASAA), constraint solving, and CAD geometry synthesis...
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  // Render Generation Result Card
  const renderGenerationResult = () => {
    const val = message.action?.payload?.validation;
    return (
      <div className="chat-response-card" data-testid="generation-result-card">
        <div className="chat-response-card-header">
          <span>✨ Design Generated</span>
          {val && (
            <span style={{ color: val.overall_valid ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              Score: {val.overall_score}/100
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="chat-response-card-body">
          Floor plan generated and verified. Inspect the drawing on the workspace canvas.
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  // Render Requirement Summary Card
  const renderRequirementSummary = () => {
    // If confirmation card exists, let QuestionCard render the buttons
    if (message.question_card && onAnswerCard) {
      return (
        <QuestionCard
          card={message.question_card}
          onAnswer={onAnswerCard}
          disabled={disabled || !isLatestAssistant}
          onOpenCustomPlot={onOpenCustomPlot}
        />
      );
    }

    if (message.is_ready_for_generation && onAnswerCard && isLatestAssistant) {
      return (
        <div className="chat-response-card" data-testid="requirement-summary-card">
          <div className="chat-response-card-header">
            <span>📋 Requirements Complete</span>
            <span style={{ color: '#10b981', fontWeight: 600 }}>Ready</span>
          </div>
          <div className="chat-response-card-actions">
            <button
              className="btn btn-primary btn-sm"
              onClick={() => onAnswerCard('Generate Floor Plan')}
              disabled={disabled}
              type="button"
            >
              ✓ Generate Floor Plan
            </button>
            <button
              className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
              onClick={() => onAnswerCard('Edit Requirements')}
              disabled={disabled}
              type="button"
            >
              Edit Requirements
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return null;
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`chat-message-row ${message.role}`}
      data-testid={`chat-message-${message.role}`}
      data-response-type={responseType}
    >
      <div className="chat-message-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
        {isUser ? (
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2" />
            <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4" />
          </svg>
        ) : (
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" />
            <path d="M3 9h18" />
            <path d="M9 21V9" />
          </svg>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="chat-message-content-wrapper">
        <div className="chat-bubble">
          {renderFormattedText(message.text)}
        </div>

        {/* Conditional Component Rendering Based on Explicit Response Type (Section 2 & 7) */}
        {!isUser && (
          <>
            {responseType === 'quick_replies' && renderQuickReplies()}

            {responseType === 'clarification' && message.question_card && onAnswerCard && (
              <QuestionCard
                card={message.question_card}
                onAnswer={onAnswerCard}
                disabled={disabled || !isLatestAssistant}
                onOpenCustomPlot={onOpenCustomPlot}
              />
            )}

            {responseType === 'requirement_summary' && renderRequirementSummary()}

            {responseType === 'generation_progress' && renderGenerationProgress()}

            {responseType === 'generation_result' && renderGenerationResult()}

            {responseType === 'action_result' && renderActionResult()}

            {/* Fallback for legacy question cards when response_type not explicitly matched */}
            {!['text', 'quick_replies', 'clarification', 'requirement_summary', 'generation_progress', 'generation_result', 'action_result'].includes(responseType) &&
              message.question_card &&
              onAnswerCard && (
                <QuestionCard
                  card={message.question_card}
                  onAnswer={onAnswerCard}
                  disabled={disabled || !isLatestAssistant}
                  onOpenCustomPlot={onOpenCustomPlot}
                />
              )}
          </>
        )}

        {message.time && (
          <span className="chat-message-time">{message.time}</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import type { QuestionCardData } from '../../api/types';

interface QuestionCardProps {
  card: QuestionCardData;
  onAnswer: (answer: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onOpenCustomPlot?: () => void;
}

export const QuestionCard: React.FC<QuestionCardProps> = ({
  card,
  onAnswer,
  disabled = false,
  onOpenCustomPlot,
}) => {
  const [selectedMulti, setSelectedMulti] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedSingle, setSelectedSingle] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [customInput, setCustomInput] = useState<string>('');

  const isCustomPlotOption = (opt: string) => {
    const l = opt.toLowerCase();
    return l.includes('custom irregular') || l.includes('irregular plot');
  };

  const handleSingleClick = (option: string) => {
    if (disabled) return;
    if (isCustomPlotOption(option) && onOpenCustomPlot) {
      onOpenCustomPlot();
      return;
    }
    setSelectedSingle(option);
    onAnswer(option);
  };

  const handleToggleMulti = (option: string) => {
    if (disabled) return;
    setSelectedMulti((prev) =>
      prev.includes(option) ? prev.filter((o) => o !== option) : [...prev, option]
    );
  };

  const handleMultiSubmit = () => {
    if (disabled || selectedMulti.length === 0) return;
    const baseAnswer = selectedMulti.join(', ');
    const floorMatch = card.field_key?.match(/^floor_(\d+)_rooms$/);
    const answer =
      floorMatch && Number(floorMatch[1]) > 1
        ? `Floor ${floorMatch[1]}: ${baseAnswer}`
        : baseAnswer;
    onAnswer(answer);
  };

  const handleCustomSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (disabled || !customInput.trim()) return;
    onAnswer(customInput.trim());
    setCustomInput('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="question-card" data-testid="question-card" data-input-type={card.input_type}>
      <div className="question-card-title">
        <span>⚡</span>
        <span>{card.question}</span>
      </div>

      {/* 1. SINGLE CHOICE */}
      {card.input_type === 'single_choice' && (
        <div className="question-options-grid">
          {card.options.map((opt, idx) => (
            <button
              key={idx}
              className={`question-option-pill ${selectedSingle === opt ? 'selected' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => handleSingleClick(opt)}
              disabled={disabled}
              type="button"
            >
              {opt}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. MULTI CHOICE */}
      {card.input_type === 'multi_choice' && (
        <div>
          <div className="question-options-grid" style={{ marginBottom: '0.65rem' }}>
            {card.options.map((opt, idx) => {
              const isSelected = selectedMulti.includes(opt);
              return (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  className={`question-option-pill ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => handleToggleMulti(opt)}
                  disabled={disabled}
                  type="button"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: isSelected ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--bg-surface)',
                    color: isSelected ? 'var(--text-inverse)' : 'var(--text-primary)',
                  }}
                >
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{isSelected ? '✓' : '+'}</span>{' '}
                  <span>{opt}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="multi-choice-footer">
            <span className="selected-counter">
              {selectedMulti.length} room{selectedMulti.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected
            </span>
            <button
              className="btn btn-primary btn-sm"
              onClick={handleMultiSubmit}
              disabled={disabled || selectedMulti.length === 0}
              type="button"
              style={{ padding: '0.35rem 0.85rem' }}
            >
              Continue →
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3. DIRECTION (COMPASS) */}
      {card.input_type === 'direction' && (
        <div className="direction-grid">
          {card.options.map((dir, idx) => {
            const arrow =
              dir.toLowerCase().includes('north') ? '↑' :
              dir.toLowerCase().includes('south') ? '↓' :
              dir.toLowerCase().includes('east') ? '→' :
              dir.toLowerCase().includes('west') ? '←' : '•';
            return (
              <button
                key={idx}
                className={`direction-btn ${selectedSingle === dir ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => handleSingleClick(`Entrance facing ${dir}`)}
                disabled={disabled}
                type="button"
              >
                <span style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem' }}>{arrow}</span>{' '}
                <span>{dir}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. NUMBER / CUSTOM DIMENSION */}
      {card.input_type === 'number' && (
        <div>
          {card.options && card.options.length > 0 && (
            <div className="question-options-grid" style={{ marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>
              {card.options.map((opt, idx) => (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  className="question-option-pill"
                  onClick={() => handleSingleClick(opt)}
                  disabled={disabled}
                  type="button"
                >
                  {opt}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <form onSubmit={handleCustomSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.4rem' }}>
            <input
              type="text"
              className="form-control"
              placeholder="e.g. 40ft x 60ft or 250 sqm"
              value={customInput}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomInput(e.target.value)}
              disabled={disabled}
              style={{ fontSize: '0.825rem', padding: '0.35rem 0.6rem' }}
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm"
              disabled={disabled || !customInput.trim()}
            >
              Submit
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 5. CONFIRMATION */}
      {card.input_type === 'confirmation' && (
        <div className="confirmation-card-actions">
          <button
            className="btn-generate-confirm"
            onClick={() => handleSingleClick('Generate Floor Plan')}
            disabled={disabled}
            type="button"
            data-testid="confirm-generate-btn"
          >
            <span>✓</span>
            <span>Generate Floor Plan</span>
          </button>
          <button
            className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
            onClick={() => handleSingleClick('Edit Requirements')}
            disabled={disabled}
            type="button"
            style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
          >
            ✏ Edit Requirements
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 6. FREEFORM TEXT GUIDANCE */}
      {card.input_type === 'text' && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
          Please type your response in the message bar below.
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import type { RequirementProgressItem } from '../../api/types';

interface RequirementProgressProps {
  progress: RequirementProgressItem[];
  remainingCount: number;
  isReadyForGeneration?: boolean;
}

export const RequirementProgress: React.FC<RequirementProgressProps> = ({
  progress,
  remainingCount,
  isReadyForGeneration = false,
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState<boolean>(true);

  if (!progress || progress.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <section className="req-progress-section" aria-label="Building requirements progress" data-testid="requirement-progress">
      <div
        className="req-progress-header"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        role="button"
        tabIndex={0}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            setIsOpen((prev) => !prev);
          }
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '0.04em', fontSize: '0.75rem', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
            Building Requirements
          </span>
          <span className={`req-progress-badge ${isReadyForGeneration ? 'all-ready' : ''}`}>
            {isReadyForGeneration
              ? '✓ Ready to Generate'
              : `${remainingCount} requirement${remainingCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} remaining`}
          </span>
        </div>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          {isOpen ? '▲' : '▼'}
        </span>
      </div>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="req-progress-body">
          {progress.map((item, idx) => {
            const isDone = item.status === 'completed';
            const isCurr = item.status === 'current';
            return (
              <div key={idx} className={`req-progress-item ${item.status}`}>
                <div className="req-item-left">
                  {isDone ? (
                    <span className="req-icon-check">✓</span>
                  ) : isCurr ? (
                    <span className="req-icon-current">▶</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="req-icon-pending">○</span>
                  )}
                  <span>{item.name}</span>
                </div>
                {item.value && <span className="req-item-value">{item.value}</span>}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { FloorPlan, GeoRoom, Point2D } from '../../api/types';
import { getExportFileUrl } from '../../api/client';
import {
  getPolygonBoundingBox,
  findInteriorLabelPoint,
  getAdaptiveLabelConfig,
  polyToSvgPoints,
} from '../../utils/geometry';

interface FloorPlanCanvasProps {
  floorPlan: FloorPlan | null;
  plotBoundary?: Point2D[];
  buildableBoundary?: Point2D[];
  selectedRoom: GeoRoom | null;
  onSelectRoom: (room: GeoRoom | null) => void;
  projectId: string;
  alternativeIndex?: number;
  theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
  orientation?: string;
}

// Map room types to curated architectural theme colors (monochrome drafting)
function getRoomColor(roomType: string, isCorridor: boolean, isLight: boolean = false): { fill: string; stroke: string } {
  const t = roomType.toLowerCase();
  if (isLight) {
    if (isCorridor || t.includes('corridor') || t.includes('hallway') || t.includes('passage') || t.includes('circulation')) {
      return { fill: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.015)', stroke: '#ced4da' };
    }
    if (t.includes('bed') || t.includes('bath') || t.includes('toilet') || t.includes('powder') || t.includes('ensuite')) {
      return { fill: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)', stroke: '#495057' };
    }
    if (t.includes('kitchen') || t.includes('pantry') || t.includes('utility') || t.includes('laundry') || t.includes('store')) {
      return { fill: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)', stroke: '#6c757d' };
    }
    if (t.includes('balcony') || t.includes('terrace') || t.includes('deck') || t.includes('patio')) {
      return { fill: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)', stroke: '#495057' };
    }
    return { fill: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.035)', stroke: '#212529' };
  }

  // Dark mode
  if (isCorridor || t.includes('corridor') || t.includes('hallway') || t.includes('passage') || t.includes('circulation')) {
    return { fill: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015)', stroke: '#555555' };
  }
  if (t.includes('bed') || t.includes('bath') || t.includes('toilet') || t.includes('powder') || t.includes('ensuite')) {
    return { fill: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07)', stroke: '#999999' };
  }
  if (t.includes('kitchen') || t.includes('pantry') || t.includes('utility') || t.includes('laundry') || t.includes('store')) {
    return { fill: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035)', stroke: '#777777' };
  }
  if (t.includes('balcony') || t.includes('terrace') || t.includes('deck') || t.includes('patio')) {
    return { fill: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', stroke: '#888888' };
  }
  return { fill: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', stroke: '#aaaaaa' };
}

export const FloorPlanCanvas: React.FC<FloorPlanCanvasProps> = ({
  floorPlan,
  plotBoundary = [],
  buildableBoundary = [],
  selectedRoom,
  onSelectRoom,
  projectId,
  alternativeIndex = 1,
  theme = 'light',
  orientation = 'north',
}) => {
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState<number>(1);
  const [pan, setPan] = useState<{ x: number; y: number }>({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [dragStart, setDragStart] = useState<{ x: number; y: number }>({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'svg' | 'png'>('svg');
  const [showPlot, setShowPlot] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showBuildable, setShowBuildable] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showDebug, setShowDebug] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);

  const currentFloorNumber = floorPlan?.floor_number || 1;
  const geometry = floorPlan?.geometry;

  // Filter current floor geometry to prevent multi-floor overlapping
  const rooms = useMemo(() => {
    if (!geometry?.rooms) return [];
    return geometry.rooms.filter((r) => !r.floor_number || r.floor_number === currentFloorNumber);
  }, [geometry?.rooms, currentFloorNumber]);

  const walls = useMemo(() => {
    if (!geometry?.walls) return [];
    return geometry.walls.filter((w) => !w.floor_number || w.floor_number === currentFloorNumber);
  }, [geometry?.walls, currentFloorNumber]);

  const doors = useMemo(() => {
    if (!geometry?.doors) return [];
    return geometry.doors.filter((d) => !d.floor_number || d.floor_number === currentFloorNumber);
  }, [geometry?.doors, currentFloorNumber]);

  const windows = useMemo(() => {
    if (!geometry?.windows) return [];
    return geometry.windows.filter((w) => !w.floor_number || w.floor_number === currentFloorNumber);
  }, [geometry?.windows, currentFloorNumber]);

  const staircases = useMemo(() => {
    if (!geometry?.staircases) return [];
    return geometry.staircases.filter(
      (s) => !s.floor_number || s.floor_number === currentFloorNumber || s.from_floor === currentFloorNumber
    );
  }, [geometry?.staircases, currentFloorNumber]);

  // Wall map for fast lookup
  const wallMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, (typeof walls)[0]>();
    walls.forEach((w) => map.set(w.id, w));
    return map;
  }, [walls]);

  // Calculate global bounding box encompassing plot and all floor elements
  const bbox = useMemo(() => {
    const allPoints: Point2D[] = [
      ...plotBoundary,
      ...buildableBoundary,
    ];

    rooms.forEach((r) => {
      allPoints.push(...(r.built_polygon || r.usable_polygon || []));
    });

    walls.forEach((w) => {
      if (w.polygon && w.polygon.length >= 2) {
        allPoints.push(...w.polygon);
      } else if (w.start && w.end) {
        allPoints.push(w.start, w.end);
      }
    });

    staircases.forEach((s) => {
      if (s.polygon && s.polygon.length >= 2) {
        allPoints.push(...s.polygon);
      }
    });

    if (allPoints.length === 0) {
      return { minX: 0, minY: 0, width: 20, height: 20, centerX: 10, centerY: 10 };
    }

    let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (const [x, y] of allPoints) {
      if (x < minX) minX = x;
      if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
      if (y < minY) minY = y;
      if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
    }

    const spanX = Math.max(maxX - minX, 5);
    const spanY = Math.max(maxY - minY, 5);
    // Tight professional architectural margin: ~2.5% of span (min 0.4m, max 0.8m)
    const pad = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(0.8, Math.max(spanX, spanY) * 0.025));

    minX -= pad;
    maxX += pad;
    minY -= pad;
    maxY += pad;

    const width = maxX - minX;
    const height = maxY - minY;

    return {
      minX,
      minY,
      width,
      height,
      centerX: minX + width / 2,
      centerY: minY + height / 2,
    };
  }, [plotBoundary, buildableBoundary, rooms, walls, staircases]);

  // Reset to Fit to Plot
  const handleFitToPlot = useCallback(() => {
    setZoom(1);
    setPan({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  }, []);

  // When floor changes, reset view
  useEffect(() => {
    handleFitToPlot();
  }, [currentFloorNumber, handleFitToPlot]);

  // Pan & Drag Handlers
  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e.button === 0) {
      setIsDragging(true);
      setDragStart({ x: e.clientX - pan.x, y: e.clientY - pan.y });
    }
  };

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (isDragging) {
      setPan({ x: e.clientX - dragStart.x, y: e.clientY - dragStart.y });
    }
  };

  const handleMouseUp = () => setIsDragging(false);

  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const factor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 0.89;
    setZoom((prev) => Math.max(0.4, Math.min(6, prev * factor)));
  };

  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom((z) => Math.min(6, z * 1.25));
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom((z) => Math.max(0.4, z * 0.8));

  const pngUrl = getExportFileUrl(
    projectId,
    `alternatives/alternative_${alternativeIndex}/floor_${currentFloorNumber}.png`
  );

  return (
    <div className="floorplan-viewer-wrapper" ref={containerRef} data-testid="floorplan-canvas">
      {/* Top Toolbar Overlay */}
      <div className="canvas-toolbar">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.25rem' }}>
            <button
              className={`btn btn-sm ${viewMode === 'svg' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'}`}
              onClick={() => setViewMode('svg')}
            >
              Interactive Vector
            </button>
            <button
              className={`btn btn-sm ${viewMode === 'png' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'}`}
              onClick={() => setViewMode('png')}
            >
              300 DPI Drawing
            </button>
          </div>

          {viewMode === 'svg' && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.65rem', fontSize: '0.8rem', marginLeft: '0.25rem' }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.3rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={showPlot}
                  onChange={(e) => setShowPlot(e.target.checked)}
                />
                Plot Boundary
              </label>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.3rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={showBuildable}
                  onChange={(e) => setShowBuildable(e.target.checked)}
                />
                Buildable Setback
              </label>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.3rem', cursor: 'pointer', color: showDebug ? 'var(--accent-sky)' : 'inherit' }}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={showDebug}
                  onChange={(e) => setShowDebug(e.target.checked)}
                />
                Debug Overlay
              </label>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {viewMode === 'svg' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
            <button className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onClick={handleZoomIn} title="Zoom In">
              +
            </button>
            <button className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onClick={handleZoomOut} title="Zoom Out">
              −
            </button>
            <button className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onClick={handleFitToPlot} title="Fit to Plot">
              Fit to Plot
            </button>
            <button className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onClick={handleFitToPlot} title="Reset Center">
              Reset
            </button>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginLeft: '0.4rem', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
              {(zoom * 100).toFixed(0)}%
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Main Viewport */}
      {viewMode === 'png' ? (
        <div
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            padding: '1.5rem',
            overflow: 'auto',
            background: theme === 'light' ? '#ffffff' : '#000000',
          }}
        >
          <img
            src={pngUrl}
            alt={`Floor ${currentFloorNumber} Architectural Drawing`}
            style={{
              maxHeight: '100%',
              maxWidth: '100%',
              objectFit: 'contain',
              borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
              boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border-default)',
            }}
            onError={(e) => {
              (e.target as HTMLElement).style.display = 'none';
            }}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          className="canvas-viewport"
          style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}
          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
          onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
          onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
          onMouseLeave={handleMouseUp}
          onWheel={handleWheel}
        >
          <svg
            ref={svgRef}
            className="canvas-svg"
            viewBox={`${bbox.minX} ${bbox.minY} ${bbox.width} ${bbox.height}`}
            preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
            style={{
              transform: `translate(${pan.x}px, ${pan.y}px) scale(${zoom})`,
              transformOrigin: 'center center',
              transition: isDragging ? 'none' : 'transform 0.08s ease-out',
            }}
          >
            {/* 1. Subtle Architectural 1m Grid */}
            <defs>
              <pattern id="arch-grid" width="1" height="1" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                <path
                  d="M 1 0 L 0 0 0 1"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke={theme === 'light' ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025)'}
                  strokeWidth="0.03"
                />
              </pattern>
            </defs>
            <rect
              x={bbox.minX}
              y={bbox.minY}
              width={bbox.width}
              height={bbox.height}
              fill="url(#arch-grid)"
            />

            {/* 2. Plot Boundary (True irregular or rectangular polygon) */}
            {showPlot && plotBoundary.length >= 3 && (
              <polygon
                points={polyToSvgPoints(plotBoundary)}
                className="svg-plot-boundary"
              />
            )}

            {/* 3. Buildable / Setback Boundary */}
            {showBuildable && buildableBoundary.length >= 3 && (
              <polygon
                points={polyToSvgPoints(buildableBoundary)}
                className="svg-buildable-boundary"
              />
            )}

            {/* 4. Room Polygons (Fills & Boundaries) */}
            {rooms.map((room) => {
              const poly = room.usable_polygon || room.built_polygon || [];
              if (poly.length < 3) return null;
              const isSelected = selectedRoom?.id === room.id;
              const colors = getRoomColor(room.room_type, room.is_corridor || false, theme === 'light');

              return (
                <polygon
                  key={`poly-${room.id}`}
                  points={polyToSvgPoints(poly)}
                  className={`svg-room-poly ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                  fill={colors.fill}
                  stroke={colors.stroke}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    onSelectRoom(isSelected ? null : room);
                  }}
                />
              );
            })}

            {/* 5. Staircases (Geometry Treads & Direction Arrow) */}
            {staircases.map((stair) => {
              if (!stair.polygon || stair.polygon.length < 3) return null;
              const sBbox = getPolygonBoundingBox(stair.polygon);
              const rc = Math.max(6, Math.min(stair.riser_count || 16, 24));
              const isVertical = sBbox.height >= sBbox.width;

              // Generate tread lines
              const treads: React.ReactNode[] = [];
              if (isVertical) {
                const step = sBbox.height / rc;
                for (let i = 1; i < rc; i++) {
                  const yVal = sBbox.minY + i * step;
                  treads.push(
                    <line
                      key={`tread-${i}`}
                      x1={sBbox.minX}
                      y1={yVal}
                      x2={sBbox.maxX}
                      y2={yVal}
                      className="svg-staircase-tread"
                    />
                  );
                }
              } else {
                const step = sBbox.width / rc;
                for (let i = 1; i < rc; i++) {
                  const xVal = sBbox.minX + i * step;
                  treads.push(
                    <line
                      key={`tread-${i}`}
                      x1={xVal}
                      y1={sBbox.minY}
                      x2={xVal}
                      y2={sBbox.maxY}
                      className="svg-staircase-tread"
                    />
                  );
                }
              }

              // Flight arrow & label
              const [scx, scy] = [sBbox.minX + sBbox.width / 2, sBbox.minY + sBbox.height / 2];
              const isCompact = sBbox.width < 1.8 || sBbox.height < 1.8;

              return (
                <g key={`stair-${stair.id}`}>
                  <polygon points={polyToSvgPoints(stair.polygon)} className="svg-staircase" />
                  {treads}

                  {/* Direction Flight Arrow */}
                  {isVertical ? (
                    <g opacity={0.65}>
                      <line
                        x1={scx}
                        y1={sBbox.minY + 0.3}
                        x2={scx}
                        y2={sBbox.maxY - 0.5}
                        stroke={theme === 'light' ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'}
                        strokeWidth="0.05"
                      />
                      <path
                        d={`M ${scx - 0.15} ${sBbox.maxY - 0.7} L ${scx} ${sBbox.maxY - 0.4} L ${scx + 0.15} ${sBbox.maxY - 0.7}`}
                        fill="none"
                        stroke={theme === 'light' ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'}
                        strokeWidth="0.05"
                      />
                      <circle cx={scx} cy={sBbox.minY + 0.3} r={0.06} fill={theme === 'light' ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'} />
                    </g>
                  ) : (
                    <g opacity={0.65}>
                      <line
                        x1={sBbox.minX + 0.3}
                        y1={scy}
                        x2={sBbox.maxX - 0.5}
                        y2={scy}
                        stroke={theme === 'light' ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'}
                        strokeWidth="0.05"
                      />
                      <path
                        d={`M ${sBbox.maxX - 0.7} ${scy - 0.15} L ${sBbox.maxX - 0.4} ${scy} L ${sBbox.maxX - 0.7} ${scy + 0.15}`}
                        fill="none"
                        stroke={theme === 'light' ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'}
                        strokeWidth="0.05"
                      />
                      <circle cx={sBbox.minX + 0.3} cy={scy} r={0.06} fill={theme === 'light' ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'} />
                    </g>
                  )}

                  {/* Centered Staircase Annotation Chip */}
                  <g transform={`translate(${scx}, ${scy})`}>
                    <rect
                      x={-0.6}
                      y={-0.28}
                      width={1.2}
                      height={0.56}
                      rx={0.08}
                      fill={theme === 'light' ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)'}
                    />
                    <text
                      x={0}
                      y={-0.06}
                      className="svg-room-label"
                      style={{ fontSize: isCompact ? '0.18px' : '0.22px' }}
                    >
                      STAIR
                    </text>
                    <text
                      x={0}
                      y={0.14}
                      className="svg-room-sublabel"
                      style={{ fontSize: isCompact ? '0.14px' : '0.16px' }}
                    >
                      {stair.riser_count}R
                    </text>
                  </g>
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* 6. Physical Walls (Footprint Polygons or Clean Lines) */}
            {walls.map((wall) => {
              if (wall.polygon && wall.polygon.length >= 3) {
                return (
                  <polygon
                    key={`wall-${wall.id}`}
                    points={polyToSvgPoints(wall.polygon)}
                    className={wall.type === 'exterior' ? 'svg-wall-exterior' : 'svg-wall'}
                  />
                );
              }

              if (wall.start && wall.end) {
                return (
                  <line
                    key={`wall-${wall.id}`}
                    x1={wall.start[0]}
                    y1={wall.start[1]}
                    x2={wall.end[0]}
                    y2={wall.end[1]}
                    className={wall.type === 'exterior' ? 'svg-wall-exterior' : 'svg-wall'}
                  />
                );
              }
              return null;
            })}

            {/* 7. Windows (Architectural Flush Segments on Wall) */}
            {windows.map((win) => {
              const [wx, wy] = win.position;
              const wHalf = (win.width || 1.2) / 2.0;
              const hostWall = win.wall_id ? wallMap.get(win.wall_id) : undefined;

              let dx = wHalf;
              let dy = 0;

              if (hostWall && hostWall.start && hostWall.end) {
                const len = Math.hypot(hostWall.end[0] - hostWall.start[0], hostWall.end[1] - hostWall.start[1]);
                if (len > 0.01) {
                  dx = ((hostWall.end[0] - hostWall.start[0]) / len) * wHalf;
                  dy = ((hostWall.end[1] - hostWall.start[1]) / len) * wHalf;
                }
              }

              const p1: Point2D = [wx - dx, wy - dy];
              const p2: Point2D = [wx + dx, wy + dy];

              return (
                <g key={`win-${win.id}`}>
                  {/* Visual Architectural Window Frame */}
                  <line
                    x1={p1[0]}
                    y1={p1[1]}
                    x2={p2[0]}
                    y2={p2[1]}
                    className="svg-window"
                  />
                  {/* Invisible Hit Area for Click/Inspect */}
                  <line
                    x1={p1[0]}
                    y1={p1[1]}
                    x2={p2[0]}
                    y2={p2[1]}
                    stroke="transparent"
                    strokeWidth="0.4"
                    style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
                  />
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* 8. Doors (Leaf Line + Clean 90-Degree Swing Arc) */}
            {doors.map((door) => {
              const hasArc = door.swing_arc && door.swing_arc.length >= 2;
              const hinge = hasArc ? door.swing_arc![0] : door.position;
              const leafTip = hasArc ? door.swing_arc![door.swing_arc!.length - 1] : door.position;

              return (
                <g key={`door-${door.id}`}>
                  {/* Swing Arc Path */}
                  {hasArc && (
                    <polyline
                      points={polyToSvgPoints(door.swing_arc!)}
                      className="svg-door-arc"
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* Door Leaf (from hinge to open edge) */}
                  {hasArc && (
                    <line
                      x1={hinge[0]}
                      y1={hinge[1]}
                      x2={leafTip[0]}
                      y2={leafTip[1]}
                      className="svg-door-line"
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* Delicate Hinge Pivot Marker (40mm radius) */}
                  <circle
                    cx={hinge[0]}
                    cy={hinge[1]}
                    r={0.04}
                    fill={theme === 'light' ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'}
                  />
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* 9. Room Labels (Interior Representative Point & Adaptive Grouping) */}
            {rooms.map((room) => {
              const poly = room.usable_polygon || room.built_polygon || [];
              if (poly.length < 3) return null;

              // Guaranteed interior label anchor
              const [lx, ly] = findInteriorLabelPoint(poly);
              const config = getAdaptiveLabelConfig(room.room_type, room.area_sqm, poly);

              const isSelected = selectedRoom?.id === room.id;

              // Vertical alignment offset so the text group is centered at (lx, ly)
              const totalLines = config.nameLines.length + (config.areaText ? 1 : 0);
              const startY = -(totalLines - 1) * (config.lineSpacing / 2);

              return (
                <g
                  key={`label-${room.id}`}
                  transform={`translate(${lx}, ${ly})`}
                  style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}
                >
                  {/* Subtle Contrast Chip Backdrop */}
                  <rect
                    x={-config.boxWidth / 2}
                    y={-config.boxHeight / 2}
                    width={config.boxWidth}
                    height={config.boxHeight}
                    rx={0.15}
                    ry={0.15}
                    fill={
                      isSelected
                        ? theme === 'light'
                          ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.90)'
                          : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)'
                        : theme === 'light'
                        ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.90)'
                        : 'rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.88)'
                    }
                    stroke={
                      isSelected
                        ? 'var(--accent-sky)'
                        : theme === 'light'
                        ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)'
                        : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)'
                    }
                    strokeWidth={0.03}
                  />

                  {/* Room Name Line(s) */}
                  {config.nameLines.map((line, idx) => (
                    <text
                      key={`name-${idx}`}
                      x={0}
                      y={startY + idx * config.lineSpacing}
                      className="svg-room-label"
                      fontSize={config.nameFontSize}
                      style={{
                        fontSize: `${config.nameFontSize}px`,
                        fill: isSelected
                          ? theme === 'light'
                            ? '#ffffff'
                            : '#000000'
                          : undefined,
                      }}
                    >
                      {line}
                    </text>
                  ))}

                  {/* Room Area Line */}
                  {config.areaText && (
                    <text
                      key="area"
                      x={0}
                      y={startY + config.nameLines.length * config.lineSpacing}
                      className="svg-room-sublabel"
                      fontSize={config.areaFontSize}
                      style={{
                        fontSize: `${config.areaFontSize}px`,
                        fill: isSelected
                          ? theme === 'light'
                            ? '#cccccc'
                            : '#333333'
                          : undefined,
                      }}
                    >
                      {config.areaText}
                    </text>
                  )}
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* 10. Development Debug Overlay */}
            {showDebug && (
              <g id="debug-overlay" opacity={0.75}>
                {rooms.map((room) => {
                  const poly = room.usable_polygon || room.built_polygon || [];
                  if (poly.length < 3) return null;
                  const [lx, ly] = findInteriorLabelPoint(poly);
                  const rBbox = getPolygonBoundingBox(poly);

                  return (
                    <g key={`debug-${room.id}`}>
                      {/* Bounding Box Outline */}
                      <rect
                        x={rBbox.minX}
                        y={rBbox.minY}
                        width={rBbox.width}
                        height={rBbox.height}
                        fill="none"
                        stroke="#f59e0b"
                        strokeWidth="0.04"
                        strokeDasharray="0.2 0.2"
                      />
                      {/* Anchor crosshair */}
                      <line x1={lx - 0.2} y1={ly} x2={lx + 0.2} y2={ly} stroke="#ef4444" strokeWidth="0.04" />
                      <line x1={lx} y1={ly - 0.2} x2={lx} y2={ly + 0.2} stroke="#ef4444" strokeWidth="0.04" />
                      <circle cx={lx} cy={ly} r={0.06} fill="#ef4444" />
                      <text
                        x={rBbox.minX + 0.15}
                        y={rBbox.minY + 0.3}
                        fill="#f59e0b"
                        fontSize="0.16px"
                        fontFamily="monospace"
                      >
                        {room.id.slice(0, 8)}
                      </text>
                    </g>
                  );
                })}
              </g>
            )}
          </svg>

          {/* Screen-Space North Arrow Overlay (Fixed in Corner Outside Plot) */}
          <div
            className="north-arrow-overlay"
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              top: '14px',
              right: '16px',

import React from 'react';
import type { GeoRoom, Geometry, ValidationResult } from '../../api/types';
import { getPolygonBoundingBox } from '../../utils/geometry';

interface RoomInspectorProps {
  room: GeoRoom | null;
  geometry: Geometry | null;
  validationResult?: ValidationResult;
  onClose: () => void;
  onViewTrace?: (entityId: string) => void;
}

export const RoomInspector: React.FC<RoomInspectorProps> = ({
  room,
  geometry,
  validationResult,
  onClose,
  onViewTrace,
}) => {
  if (!room) return null;

  // Compute dimensions from bounding box
  const poly = room.usable_polygon || room.built_polygon || [];
  const bbox = getPolygonBoundingBox(poly);
  const dimensionsText = poly.length >= 3 ? `${bbox.width.toFixed(2)}m × ${bbox.height.toFixed(2)}m` : 'N/A';

  // Find connected rooms via door objects
  const connectedRoomNames: string[] = [];
  if (geometry && geometry.doors) {
    for (const d of geometry.doors) {
      if (d.connects_from === room.id || d.connects_from === room.room_type) {
        connectedRoomNames.push(d.connects_to);
      } else if (d.connects_to === room.id || d.connects_to === room.room_type) {
        connectedRoomNames.push(d.connects_from);
      }
    }
  }

  // Find any validation issues associated with this room
  const roomIssues = validationResult?.issues.filter(
    (i) => i.entity_id === room.id || i.description.toLowerCase().includes(room.room_type.toLowerCase())
  ) || [];

  const isValid = roomIssues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'error').length === 0;

  return (
    <div
      className="card"
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        padding: '1.25rem',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: '0.85rem',
        background: 'var(--bg-card)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border-default)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
        fontSize: '0.85rem',
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', paddingBottom: '0.5rem' }}>
        <div>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>
            {room.room_type.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
          </h3>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Room Information</span>
        </div>
        <button
          className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
          style={{ padding: '0.15rem 0.45rem', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}
          onClick={onClose}
          title="Close"
        >
          ✕
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '0.65rem' }}>
        <div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block' }}>Area</span>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.95rem' }}>
            {room.area_sqm.toFixed(2)} m² <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>({(room.area_sqm * 10.7639).toFixed(1)} sq ft)</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block' }}>Floor</span>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Floor {room.floor_number}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block' }}>Dimensions</span>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>{dimensionsText}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block' }}>Validation</span>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: isValid ? 'var(--status-success)' : '#f87171' }}>
            {isValid ? '✓ Valid' : '✗ Issues Found'}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block' }}>Room ID</span>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{room.id.slice(0, 16)}</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block' }}>Allocation ID</span>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
            {room.architectural_room_id ? room.architectural_room_id.slice(0, 16) : room.id.slice(0, 12)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {roomIssues.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
          {roomIssues.map((issue, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} style={{ color: issue.severity === 'error' ? '#f87171' : '#fbbf24' }}>
              • {issue.description}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {connectedRoomNames.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.2rem' }}>
            Connected To
          </span>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '0.25rem' }}>
            {connectedRoomNames.map((c, idx) => (
              <span key={idx} className="badge badge-neutral" style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>
                {c.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {onViewTrace && (
        <button
          className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
          style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}
          onClick={() => onViewTrace(room.id)}
        >
          Explore Room Traceability →
        </button>
      )}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { getHealth } from '../../api/projects';
import type { HealthResponse } from '../../api/types';

interface HeaderProps {
  onNewProject: () => void;
  onDashboard: () => void;
  onAssistant?: () => void;
  onProjects?: () => void;
  onBenchmarks?: () => void;
  currentView: string;
  theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
  onToggleTheme?: () => void;
}

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  onNewProject,
  onDashboard,
  onAssistant,
  onProjects,
  onBenchmarks,
  currentView,
  theme = 'light',
  onToggleTheme,
}) => {
  const [health, setHealth] = useState<HealthResponse | null>(null);
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState<boolean>(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    const checkHealth = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await getHealth();
        if (mounted) {
          setHealth(res);
          setIsOnline(true);
        }
      } catch {
        if (mounted) {
          setIsOnline(false);
        }
      }
    };

    checkHealth();
    const interval = setInterval(checkHealth, 15000);
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className="app-header">
      <div className="brand-container" onClick={onDashboard} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
        <div className="brand-logo">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" />
            <path d="M3 9h18" />
            <path d="M9 21V9" />
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div className="brand-title">
          PlanForge <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>AI</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="header-actions">
        {onAssistant && (
          <button
            className={`btn ${currentView === 'assistant' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
            onClick={onAssistant}
            data-testid="header-assistant-btn"
            style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
          >
            ✨ AI Assistant
          </button>
        )}

        <button
          className={`btn ${currentView === 'dashboard' || currentView === 'home' ? 'btn-secondary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
          onClick={onDashboard}
        >
          Home
        </button>

        <button
          className={`btn ${currentView === 'projects' ? 'btn-secondary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
          onClick={onProjects || onDashboard}
        >
          Projects
        </button>

        <button
          className={`btn ${currentView === 'new_project' ? 'btn-secondary' : 'btn-primary'} btn-sm`}
          onClick={onNewProject}
        >
          + New Project
        </button>

        {onBenchmarks && (
          <button
            className={`btn ${currentView === 'benchmarks' ? 'btn-secondary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
            onClick={onBenchmarks}
            style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
          >
            Benchmarks
          </button>
        )}

        {onToggleTheme && (
          <button
            className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
            onClick={onToggleTheme}
            title={`Switch to ${theme === 'dark' ? 'Light' : 'Dark'} Mode`}
            style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}
          >
            {theme === 'dark' ? '☀' : '☾'}
          </button>
        )}

        <div
          className="health-badge"
          title={health ? `${health.service} (${health.llm_provider || 'Local'})` : 'Backend status'}
          style={{ padding: '0.3rem 0.6rem' }}
