import React from 'react';
import type { ProjectData, GenerationResponse } from '../../api/types';
import type { ActiveTab } from '../layout/TabNav';
import { getValidationDisplayStatus } from '../../utils/validationStatus';

interface ProjectOverviewViewProps {
  projectData: ProjectData | null;
  generationResponse?: GenerationResponse | null;
  onNavigateTab: (tab: ActiveTab) => void;
}

const STAGES_LIST = [
  { key: 'REQUIREMENTS', label: '1. Requirement Parsing & Gating' },
  { key: 'PLANNING', label: '2. Strategic Planning Program' },
  { key: 'ASAA', label: '3. ASAA Spatial Allocation' },
  { key: 'ARCHITECTURAL_DESIGN', label: '4. Architectural Intent Design' },
  { key: 'GEOMETRY', label: '5. Physical Geometry Engine' },
  { key: 'VALIDATION', label: '6. Independent Validator' },
  { key: 'REFINEMENT', label: '7. Closed-Loop Refinement' },
  { key: 'DIVERSITY', label: '8. Structural Diversity Generator' },
  { key: 'EXPLAINABILITY', label: '9. Explainability & Decision Trace' },
  { key: 'EXPORT', label: '10. Export & 300 DPI Rendering' },
];

export const ProjectOverviewView: React.FC<ProjectOverviewViewProps> = ({
  projectData,
  generationResponse,
  onNavigateTab,
}) => {
  if (!projectData && !generationResponse) {
    return <div className="card">Loading project overview...</div>;
  }

  const valSummary = projectData?.validation_report || generationResponse?.validation_summary;
  const fullReport = projectData?.validation_report;

  const validationStatus = getValidationDisplayStatus(
    valSummary,
    projectData?.refinement_result,
    projectData?.status || generationResponse?.status
  );

  const overallScore: number = (() => {
    if (typeof valSummary?.overall_score === 'number' && !isNaN(valSummary.overall_score)) {
      return valSummary.overall_score;
    }
    if (fullReport?.results && fullReport.results.length > 0) {
      const sum = fullReport.results.reduce((acc: number, r) => acc + (typeof r.score === 'number' ? r.score : 100), 0);
      return sum / fullReport.results.length;
    }
    return 100.0;
  })();

  const totalErrors: number = (() => {
    if (typeof valSummary?.total_errors === 'number') {
      return valSummary.total_errors;
    }
    if (fullReport?.results) {
      return fullReport.results.reduce(
        (acc: number, r) => acc + (r.issues?.filter((i) => i.severity === 'error').length || 0),
        0
      );
    }
    return 0;
  })();

  const totalWarnings: number = (() => {
    if (typeof valSummary?.total_warnings === 'number') {
      return valSummary.total_warnings;
    }
    if (fullReport?.results) {
      return fullReport.results.reduce(
        (acc: number, r) => acc + (r.issues?.filter((i) => i.severity === 'warning').length || 0),
        0
      );
    }
    return 0;
  })();

  const stageStatuses = generationResponse?.stage_statuses || {};

  const floorPlanSet = projectData?.floor_plan_set;
  const totalFloors = floorPlanSet?.floor_plans.length || 1;
  const totalRooms = floorPlanSet?.floor_plans.reduce(
    (acc, fp) => acc + (fp.geometry?.rooms.length || 0),
    0
  ) || 0;
  const totalUsableArea = floorPlanSet?.floor_plans.reduce(
    (acc, fp) => acc + (fp.geometry?.rooms.reduce((s, r) => s + r.area_sqm, 0) || 0),
    0
  ) || 0;

  const altsCount = projectData?.alternatives?.length || generationResponse?.alternatives.length || 1;

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.75rem' }}>
      {/* Top Status Banner */}
      <div
        className="card"
        style={{
          borderLeft: `5px solid ${validationStatus.type === 'valid' || validationStatus.type === 'refined' ? 'var(--status-success)' : 'var(--status-danger)'}`,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: '1rem',
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem', marginBottom: '0.35rem' }}>
            <span className={`badge ${validationStatus.badgeClass}`}>
              {validationStatus.label}
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              Project ID: {projectData?.project_id || generationResponse?.project_id}
            </span>
          </div>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.4rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
            {projectData?.project_metadata?.project_name || generationResponse?.project_name || 'Generated Residence'}
          </h2>
          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '0.2rem' }}>
            Generated via PlanForge 10-stage autonomous architectural pipeline with zero room fabrication.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={() => onNavigateTab('floorplan')}>
            View Floor Plan Canvas →
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Metrics Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="card">
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', textTransform: 'uppercase', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Program Floors
          </span>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '1.75rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-primary)', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
            {totalFloors}
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            Discrete floor geometries
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="card">
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', textTransform: 'uppercase', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Constructed Rooms
          </span>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '1.75rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--accent-sky)', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
            {totalRooms}
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            100% requirement coverage
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="card">
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', textTransform: 'uppercase', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Total Usable Area
          </span>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '1.75rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#34d399', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
            {totalUsableArea.toFixed(1)} <span style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 500 }}>m²</span>
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            {(totalUsableArea * 10.7639).toFixed(0)} sq ft living space
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="card">
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', textTransform: 'uppercase', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            Design Alternatives
          </span>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '1.75rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#c084fc', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
            {altsCount}
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            Structural diversity explored
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Two-Column Layout */}
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '2fr 1fr', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
        {/* Pipeline Stage Execution Timeline */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-header">
            <h3 className="card-title">Generative Pipeline Execution Timeline</h3>
            <span className="badge badge-info">10 Stages Monitored</span>
          </div>

          <div className="stages-tracker">
            {STAGES_LIST.map((stage) => {
              const statusRaw = stageStatuses[stage.key] || 'completed';
              const status = statusRaw.toLowerCase();
              return (
                <div key={stage.key} className={`stage-step ${status}`}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.65rem' }}>
                    <span
                      style={{
                        width: '20px',
                        height: '20px',
                        borderRadius: '50%',
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'center',
                        fontSize: '0.75rem',
                        fontWeight: 'bold',
                        background:
                          status === 'completed'
                            ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)'
                            : status === 'running'
                            ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)'
                            : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                        color:
                          status === 'completed'
                            ? '#34d399'
                            : status === 'running'
                            ? 'var(--accent-sky)'
                            : 'var(--text-muted)',
                      }}
                    >
                      {status === 'completed' ? '✓' : status === 'running' ? '●' : '○'}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 500 }}>{stage.label}</span>
                  </div>

                  <span
                    className={`badge ${
                      status === 'completed'
                        ? 'badge-success'
                        : status === 'running'
                        ? 'badge-info'
                        : status === 'failed'
                        ? 'badge-danger'
                        : 'badge-neutral'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {status}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quick Navigation & Diagnostics */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
          <div className="card">
            <h3 className="card-title" style={{ marginBottom: '0.85rem' }}>
              Validation Overview
            </h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.6rem' }}>
              <div className="property-row">
                <span className="property-label">Hard Errors</span>
                <span className="property-value" style={{ color: totalErrors > 0 ? 'var(--status-danger)' : 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {totalErrors}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="property-row">
                <span className="property-label">Advisory Warnings</span>
                <span className="property-value" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                  {totalWarnings}
                </span>

                <span className="property-label">Diagnostic Quality Score</span>
                <span className="property-value">
                  {overallScore.toFixed(1)} / 100
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm"
              style={{ width: '100%', marginTop: '1rem' }}
              onClick={() => onNavigateTab('validation')}
            >
              Inspect 18 Validation Checks →
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="card">
            <h3 className="card-title" style={{ marginBottom: '0.85rem' }}>
              Research Diagnostics
            </h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.5rem' }}>

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { listProjects, deleteProject, clearProjects } from '../../api/projects';
import type { ProjectDetailResponse } from '../../api/types';

interface ProjectsViewProps {
  onSelectProject: (projectId: string) => void;
  onNewProject: () => void;
}

export const ProjectsView: React.FC<ProjectsViewProps> = ({
  onSelectProject,
  onNewProject,
}) => {
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<ProjectDetailResponse[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [clearing, setClearing] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    const fetchProjects = async () => {
      try {
        const list = await listProjects();
        if (mounted) setProjects(list);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load projects list', err);
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchProjects();
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = async (e: React.MouseEvent, projectId: string, projectName: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to remove project "${projectName}"? This will delete all generated floor plans and outputs.`
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      setDeletingId(projectId);
      await deleteProject(projectId);
      setProjects((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.project_id !== projectId));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to delete project', err);
      alert('Failed to remove project. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleClearAll = async () => {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      'Are you sure you want to clear all project history? This will delete all generated floor plans and outputs.'
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      setClearing(true);
      await clearProjects();
      setProjects([]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to clear project history', err);
      alert('Failed to clear project history. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setClearing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100%', margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 700, margin: 0 }}>Projects</h1>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.875rem', margin: '0.25rem 0 0' }}>
            All residential floor plan projects in your workspace
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          {projects.length > 0 && (
            <button
              className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm"
              onClick={handleClearAll}
              disabled={clearing}
              style={{ color: '#ef4444', borderColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)' }}
            >
              {clearing ? 'Clearing...' : 'Clear All History'}
            </button>
          )}
          <button className="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onClick={onNewProject}>
            + New Project
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>


      {/* Projects Table */}
      <div className="card" style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>
        {loading ? (
          <div style={{ padding: '3rem', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            Loading projects...
          </div>
        ) : projects.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: '3rem', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            <p>No projects found.</p>
            <button className="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onClick={onNewProject} style={{ marginTop: '0.75rem' }}>
              Create Your First Project
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="table-container" style={{ border: 'none' }}>
            <table className="data-table" style={{ width: '100%', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style={{ textAlign: 'left', padding: '0.65rem 1rem' }}>Project</th>
                  <th style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '0.65rem 1rem', width: '100px' }}>Floors</th>
                  <th style={{ textAlign: 'left', padding: '0.65rem 1rem', width: '160px' }}>Status</th>
                  <th style={{ textAlign: 'left', padding: '0.65rem 1rem', width: '160px' }}>Validation</th>
                  <th style={{ textAlign: 'right', padding: '0.65rem 1rem', width: '150px' }}>Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {projects.map((proj) => {
                  const statusLabel = proj.is_valid
                    ? '✓ Completed'
                    : proj.status === 'completed'
                    ? 'Completed'
                    : 'Draft';
                  const validationLabel = proj.validation_summary
                    ? `${proj.validation_summary.total_errors} err, ${proj.validation_summary.total_warnings} warn`
                    : 'Unchecked';
                  const isDeleting = deletingId === proj.project_id;

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={proj.project_id}
                      style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
                      onClick={() => onSelectProject(proj.project_id)}
                    >
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 1rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        <div>{proj.project_name}</div>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.725rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
                          {proj.project_id.slice(0, 16)}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 1rem', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                        {(proj as any).target_floors || 1}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 1rem' }}>
                        <span className={`badge ${proj.is_valid ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-neutral'}`}>
                          {statusLabel}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 1rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                        {validationLabel}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 1rem', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: '0.4rem', justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                          <button
                            className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
                            style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '0.25rem 0.65rem' }}
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              onSelectProject(proj.project_id);
                            }}
                          >
                            Open
                          </button>
                          <button
                            className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
                            style={{
                              fontSize: '0.75rem',
                              padding: '0.25rem 0.65rem',
                              color: '#ef4444',
                              borderColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)',
                            }}
                            disabled={isDeleting}
                            onClick={(e) => handleDelete(e, proj.project_id, proj.project_name)}
                            title="Remove project"
                          >
                            {isDeleting ? 'Removing...' : 'Remove'}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import type { RefinementResult } from '../../api/types';

interface RefinementViewProps {
  refinementResult?: RefinementResult | null;
}

export const RefinementView: React.FC<RefinementViewProps> = ({ refinementResult }) => {
  if (!refinementResult || !refinementResult.iterations || refinementResult.iterations.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="card" style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '3.5rem' }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '2rem', marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>✓</div>
        <h3 style={{ fontSize: '1.2rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)', marginBottom: '0.4rem' }}>
          No Refinement Was Required
        </h3>
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', maxWidth: '500px', margin: '0 auto', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
          Initial physical geometry generated by the Architectural LLM and Geometry Engine passed all authoritative
          validator checks on the first pass without triggering the closed-loop correction agent.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const iterations = refinementResult.iterations;
  const initErrors = iterations[0]?.error_count || 0;
  const finalErrors = iterations[iterations.length - 1]?.error_count || 0;
  const errorDelta = Math.max(0, initErrors - finalErrors);

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '2rem' }}>
      {/* Summary Card */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-header">
          <div>
            <h2 className="card-title">Closed-Loop Validation-Driven Refinement</h2>
            <p className="card-subtitle">
              Iterative correction loop driven by independent validator feedback while preserving immutable upstream ASAA allocations.
            </p>
          </div>
          <span className={`badge ${refinementResult.is_valid ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-warning'}`}>
            {refinementResult.status.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4" style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          <div className="property-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <span className="property-label">Iterations Attempted</span>
            <span className="property-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem' }}>
              {iterations.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="property-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <span className="property-label">Initial Hard Errors</span>
            <span className="property-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              {initErrors}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="property-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <span className="property-label">Final Hard Errors</span>
            <span className="property-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              {finalErrors}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="property-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <span className="property-label">Hard Errors Resolved</span>
            <span className="property-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              +{errorDelta}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Iteration Timeline Cards */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.25rem' }}>
        {iterations.map((it, idx) => (
          <div key={idx} className="card" style={{ borderLeft: '4px solid var(--border-strong)' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                <span className="badge badge-neutral" style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                  Iteration {it.iteration}
                </span>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: '1rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {idx === 0 ? 'Initial Architectural Proposal' : `Refinement Pass ${it.iteration}`}
                </strong>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                  <strong>{it.error_count}</strong> Errors
                </span>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                  <strong>{it.warning_count}</strong> Warnings
                </span>
                <span className={`badge ${it.overall_valid ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-danger'}`}>
                  {it.overall_valid ? 'Valid' : 'Invalid'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Changes list in this iteration */}
            {it.changes && it.changes.length > 0 ? (
              <div style={{ marginTop: '0.75rem' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-muted)', textTransform: 'uppercase', display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.4rem' }}>
                  Architectural Adjustments Applied ({it.changes.length})
                </span>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                  {it.changes.map((ch, ci) => (
                    <div
                      key={ch.id || ci}
                      style={{
                        padding: '0.55rem 0.75rem',
                        background: 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                        borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                        fontSize: '0.8rem',
                        display: 'flex',
                        flexDirection: 'column',
                        gap: '0.2rem',
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', color: 'var(--accent-sky)' }}>
                        <strong>{ch.room_id || 'Room'} • {ch.field_changed}</strong>
                        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Floor {ch.floor_number}</span>
                      </div>
                      <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{ch.reason}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: '0.4rem' }}>
                {idx === 0 ? 'Baseline geometric construction from ASAA allocated bounding regions.' : 'No discrete changes applied in this step.'}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import type { ProjectData } from '../../api/types';

interface RequirementsViewProps {
  projectData: ProjectData | null;
}

export const RequirementsView: React.FC<RequirementsViewProps> = ({ projectData }) => {
  if (!projectData) {
    return <div className="card">Loading requirements...</div>;
  }

  const reqs = projectData.requirements;
  const floors = reqs?.floors || [];

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.75rem' }}>
      {/* Plot Specifications Card */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="card-header">
          <div>
            <h2 className="card-title">Site & Plot Parameters</h2>
            <p className="card-subtitle">Boundary constraints and setback offsets parsed from natural language.</p>
          </div>
          <span className="badge badge-info">Completeness Certified</span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <div className="property-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <span className="property-label">Plot Dimensions</span>
            <span className="property-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.05rem' }}>
              {reqs?.plot_width || '40'} × {reqs?.plot_length || '50'} {reqs?.plot_unit || 'feet'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="property-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <span className="property-label">Compass Orientation</span>
            <span className="property-value" style={{ textTransform: 'capitalize', fontSize: '1.05rem' }}>
              {reqs?.orientation || 'Unspecified (Standard)'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="property-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <span className="property-label">Front Setback Offset</span>
            <span className="property-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.05rem' }}>
              {reqs?.front_setback !== undefined ? `${reqs.front_setback} m` : '2.0 m'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="property-row" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <span className="property-label">Rear & Side Setbacks</span>
            <span className="property-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.05rem' }}>
              R: {reqs?.rear_setback || 2.0}m • S: {reqs?.side_setback || 2.0}m
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Floor-by-Floor Program Breakdown */}
      {floors.length > 0 ? (
        floors.map((floor) => (
          <div key={floor.floor_number} className="card">
            <div className="card-header">
              <h3 className="card-title">
                Floor {floor.floor_number} Room Specifications
              </h3>
              <span className="badge badge-neutral">{floor.room_requirements.length} Programmed Rooms</span>
            </div>

            <div className="table-container">
              <table className="data-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Room Type</th>
                    <th>Count</th>
                    <th>Target Area</th>
                    <th>Min Area Bound</th>
                    <th>Planning Priority</th>
                    <th>Attached Relationship</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {floor.room_requirements.map((rm, i) => (
                    <tr key={i}>
                      <td style={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'capitalize', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                        {rm.room_type.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                      </td>
                      <td>{rm.min_count || 1}</td>
                      <td style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
                        {rm.target_area_sqm ? `${rm.target_area_sqm.toFixed(1)} m²` : '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>
                        {rm.min_area_sqm ? `${rm.min_area_sqm.toFixed(1)} m²` : '5.0 m²'}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span
                          className={`badge ${
                            rm.priority === 'high'
                              ? 'badge-warning'
                              : rm.priority === 'low'
                              ? 'badge-neutral'
                              : 'badge-info'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {rm.priority || 'normal'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        {rm.attached_to_room_id ? (
                          <span className="badge badge-neutral">🔗 Attached Suite</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>None</span>
                        )}

                    </tr>
                  ))}

              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))
      ) : (
        <div className="card">
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            Program requirements were generated and mapped directly to the active floor plan set.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import type { ValidationReport } from '../../api/types';

interface ValidationViewProps {
  validationReport?: ValidationReport | null;
}

const CHECK_CATEGORIES = [
  { id: 'boundary', name: 'Boundary Containment' },
  { id: 'dimension', name: 'Room Dimensions & Area' },
  { id: 'adjacency', name: 'Required Adjacency' },
  { id: 'separation', name: 'Acoustic Separation' },
  { id: 'attached', name: 'Attached Relationships' },
  { id: 'connectivity', name: 'Graph Connectivity' },
  { id: 'door', name: 'Door Placement & Swing' },
  { id: 'window', name: 'Window Exterior Placement' },
  { id: 'staircase', name: 'Staircase Alignment' },
  { id: 'overlap', name: 'Room Non-Overlap' },
];

export const ValidationView: React.FC<ValidationViewProps> = ({ validationReport }) => {
  const [filterSeverity, setFilterSeverity] = useState<'all' | 'error' | 'warning'>('all');

  if (!validationReport) {
    return (
      <div className="card" style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem' }}>
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>Validation report is not available for this project.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const allIssues = validationReport.results.flatMap((r) => r.issues || []);
  const filteredIssues = allIssues.filter((i) => {
    if (filterSeverity === 'all') return true;
    return i.severity === filterSeverity;
  });

  const totalErrors: number = (() => {
    if (typeof validationReport.total_errors === 'number') return validationReport.total_errors;
    if (validationReport.results) {
      return validationReport.results.reduce(
        (acc, r) => acc + (r.issues?.filter((i) => i.severity === 'error').length || 0),
        0
      );
    }
    return 0;
  })();

  const totalWarnings: number = (() => {
    if (typeof validationReport.total_warnings === 'number') return validationReport.total_warnings;
    if (validationReport.results) {
      return validationReport.results.reduce(
        (acc, r) => acc + (r.issues?.filter((i) => i.severity === 'warning').length || 0),
        0
      );
    }
    return 0;
  })();

  const overallValid: boolean = (() => {
    if (typeof validationReport.overall_valid === 'boolean') return validationReport.overall_valid;
    if (validationReport.results && validationReport.results.length > 0) {
      return validationReport.results.every((r) => r.is_valid);
    }
    return true;
  })();

  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100%', margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.25rem' }}>
      {/* Top Summary Banner (Section 15) */}
      <div
        className="card"
        style={{
          padding: '1.25rem 1.5rem',
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.2rem', fontWeight: 700, margin: 0 }}>Validation</h2>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem', marginTop: '0.35rem' }}>
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.95rem', letterSpacing: '0.04em', color: overallValid ? 'var(--status-success)' : '#f87171' }}>
              {overallValid ? 'VALID' : 'INVALID'}
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              ({overallValid ? 'All mandatory architectural constraints satisfied' : 'Mandatory constraint violations exist'})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1.5rem', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>Hard Errors</span>
            <strong style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', color: totalErrors > 0 ? '#f87171' : 'inherit' }}>
              {totalErrors}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'block', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>Warnings/Advisories</span>
            <strong style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', color: totalWarnings > 0 ? '#fbbf24' : 'inherit' }}>
              {totalWarnings}
            </strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Checklist of Verification Categories (Section 15) */}
      <div className="card" style={{ padding: '1.25rem 1.5rem' }}>
        <h3 style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: '0 0 0.85rem 0' }}>Rule Checklist</h3>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.4rem' }}>
          {CHECK_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
            const hasCatError = allIssues.some((i) => i.category === cat.id && i.severity === 'error');
            const hasCatWarn = allIssues.some((i) => i.category === cat.id && i.severity === 'warning');

            const statusSymbol = hasCatError ? (
              <span style={{ color: '#f87171', fontWeight: 600 }}>✗ Failed</span>
            ) : hasCatWarn ? (
              <span style={{ color: '#fbbf24', fontWeight: 500 }}>⚠ Advisory</span>
            ) : (
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--status-success)', fontWeight: 600 }}>✓</span>
            );

            return (
              <div
                key={cat.id}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  padding: '0.45rem 0',
                  borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                  fontSize: '0.875rem',
                }}
              >
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>{cat.name}</span>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>{statusSymbol}</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Issues Table (Only if issues exist) */}
      {allIssues.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card" style={{ padding: '1.25rem 1.5rem' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '0.85rem' }}>
            <h3 style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: 0 }}>Reported Issues</h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
              <button
                className={`btn ${filterSeverity === 'all' ? 'btn-secondary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
                style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '0.15rem 0.5rem' }}
                onClick={() => setFilterSeverity('all')}
              >
                All ({allIssues.length})
              </button>
              <button
                className={`btn ${filterSeverity === 'error' ? 'btn-secondary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
                style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '0.15rem 0.5rem' }}
                onClick={() => setFilterSeverity('error')}
              >
                Errors ({totalErrors})
              </button>
              <button
                className={`btn ${filterSeverity === 'warning' ? 'btn-secondary' : 'btn-outline'} btn-sm`}
                style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '0.15rem 0.5rem' }}
                onClick={() => setFilterSeverity('warning')}
              >
                Warnings ({totalWarnings})
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
            {filteredIssues.map((issue, idx) => (
              <div
                key={issue.id || idx}
                style={{
                  padding: '0.65rem 0.85rem',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border-default)',
                  background: 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                  fontSize: '0.85rem',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'flex-start',
                  gap: '0.65rem',
                }}
              >
                <span
                  className={`badge ${issue.severity === 'error' ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-warning'}`}
                  style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}
                >
                  {issue.severity}
                </span>
                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>{issue.rule_name || issue.category}</div>
                  <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '0.15rem' }}>{issue.description}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import type { Point2D } from '../api/types';

export interface BoundingBox {
  minX: number;
  minY: number;
  maxX: number;
  maxY: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export interface IntersectionResult {
  hasIntersection: boolean;
  intersectingSegments?: [[Point2D, Point2D], [Point2D, Point2D]];
  intersectionPoint?: Point2D;
}

/**
 * Calculates the gross area of a 2D polygon in square meters using the Shoelace formula.
 */
export function calculatePolygonArea(points: Point2D[]): number {
  if (!points || points.length < 3) {
    return 0;
  }

  let area = 0;
  const n = points.length;

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const j = (i + 1) % n;
    area += points[i][0] * points[j][1];
    area -= points[j][0] * points[i][1];
  }

  return Math.abs(area) / 2;
}

/**
 * Format an array of 2D coordinates into an SVG points string.
 */
export function polyToSvgPoints(poly: Point2D[]): string {
  if (!poly || poly.length === 0) return '';
  return poly.map(([x, y]) => `${x},${y}`).join(' ');
}

/**
 * Computes the axis-aligned bounding box for a set of 2D points.
 */
export function getPolygonBoundingBox(points: Point2D[]): BoundingBox {
  if (!points || points.length === 0) {
    return { minX: 0, minY: 0, maxX: 20, maxY: 20, width: 20, height: 20 };
  }

  let minX = Infinity;
  let minY = Infinity;
  let maxX = -Infinity;
  let maxY = -Infinity;

  for (const [x, y] of points) {
    if (x < minX) minX = x;
    if (y < minY) minY = y;
    if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
    if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
  }

  const width = Math.max(maxX - minX, 1);
  const height = Math.max(maxY - minY, 1);

  return { minX, minY, maxX, maxY, width, height };
}

/**
 * Snap a value to the nearest grid increment (e.g. 0.5m or 1.0m).
 */
export function snapToGrid(value: number, step: number = 0.5): number {
  if (step <= 0) return value;
  return Math.round(value / step) * step;
}

// Orientation test: 0 = collinear, 1 = clockwise, 2 = counterclockwise
function orientation(p: Point2D, q: Point2D, r: Point2D): number {
  const val = (q[1] - p[1]) * (r[0] - q[0]) - (q[0] - p[0]) * (r[1] - q[1]);
  if (Math.abs(val) < 1e-9) return 0;
  return val > 0 ? 1 : 2;
}

// Check if point q lies on segment pr
function onSegment(p: Point2D, q: Point2D, r: Point2D): boolean {
  return (
    q[0] <= Math.max(p[0], r[0]) + 1e-9 &&
    q[0] >= Math.min(p[0], r[0]) - 1e-9 &&
    q[1] <= Math.max(p[1], r[1]) + 1e-9 &&
    q[1] >= Math.min(p[1], r[1]) - 1e-9
  );
}

/**
 * Check if two line segments p1q1 and p2q2 intersect strictly or overlap.
 */
export function doSegmentsIntersect(
  p1: Point2D,
  q1: Point2D,
  p2: Point2D,
  q2: Point2D,
  excludeEndpoints: boolean = true
): boolean {
  const o1 = orientation(p1, q1, p2);
  const o2 = orientation(p1, q1, q2);
  const o3 = orientation(p2, q2, p1);
  const o4 = orientation(p2, q2, q1);

  // General strict crossing
  if (o1 !== o2 && o3 !== o4) {
    if (excludeEndpoints) {
      // If any orientation is collinear and shares an endpoint, it's touching, not crossing
      const isSharedEndpoint =
        (p1[0] === p2[0] && p1[1] === p2[1]) ||
        (p1[0] === q2[0] && p1[1] === q2[1]) ||
        (q1[0] === p2[0] && q1[1] === p2[1]) ||
        (q1[0] === q2[0] && q1[1] === q2[1]);
      if (isSharedEndpoint) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  // Collinear overlaps (only if not excluding endpoints or if strictly overlapping)
  if (o1 === 0 && onSegment(p1, p2, q1) && (!excludeEndpoints || (!isSamePoint(p1, p2) && !isSamePoint(q1, p2)))) return true;
  if (o2 === 0 && onSegment(p1, q2, q1) && (!excludeEndpoints || (!isSamePoint(p1, q2) && !isSamePoint(q1, q2)))) return true;
  if (o3 === 0 && onSegment(p2, p1, q2) && (!excludeEndpoints || (!isSamePoint(p2, p1) && !isSamePoint(q2, p1)))) return true;
  if (o4 === 0 && onSegment(p2, q1, q2) && (!excludeEndpoints || (!isSamePoint(p2, q1) && !isSamePoint(q2, q1)))) return true;

  return false;
}

function isSamePoint(p1: Point2D, p2: Point2D, eps: number = 1e-6): boolean {
  return Math.abs(p1[0] - p2[0]) < eps && Math.abs(p1[1] - p2[1]) < eps;
}

/**
 * Checks if a polygon contains any self-intersecting non-adjacent edges.
 */
export function checkPolygonSelfIntersection(
  points: Point2D[],
  isClosed: boolean = true
): IntersectionResult {
  if (!points || points.length < 4) {
    return { hasIntersection: false };
  }

  const n = points.length;
  // Edge list: if closed, edges are (i, i+1) for i = 0..n-1 with last wrapping to 0
  // if not closed, edges are (i, i+1) for i = 0..n-2
  const edgeCount = isClosed ? n : n - 1;

  for (let i = 0; i < edgeCount; i++) {
    const p1 = points[i];
    const q1 = points[(i + 1) % n];

    for (let j = i + 1; j < edgeCount; j++) {
      // Adjacent edges share a vertex, skip
      if (j === i) continue;
      if (j === (i + 1) % n) continue;
      if (isClosed && i === 0 && j === n - 1) continue;

      const p2 = points[j];
      const q2 = points[(j + 1) % n];

      if (doSegmentsIntersect(p1, q1, p2, q2, true)) {
        return {
          hasIntersection: true,
          intersectingSegments: [[p1, q1], [p2, q2]],
        };
      }
    }
  }

  return { hasIntersection: false };
}

/**
 * Check if a 2D point is strictly inside a polygon using ray casting algorithm.
 */
export function isPointInPolygon(point: Point2D, polygon: Point2D[]): boolean {
  if (!polygon || polygon.length < 3) return false;
  const [x, y] = point;
  let inside = false;
  const n = polygon.length;

  for (let i = 0, j = n - 1; i < n; j = i++) {
    const [xi, yi] = polygon[i];
    const [xj, yj] = polygon[j];

    const intersect = yi > y !== yj > y && x < ((xj - xi) * (y - yi)) / (yj - yi) + xi;
    if (intersect) inside = !inside;
  }

  return inside;
}

/**
 * Calculate Euclidean distance from point P to line segment AB.
 */
export function distancePointToSegment(p: Point2D, a: Point2D, b: Point2D): number {
  const dx = b[0] - a[0];
  const dy = b[1] - a[1];
  const l2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  if (l2 < 1e-9) {
    return Math.hypot(p[0] - a[0], p[1] - a[1]);
  }

  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p[0] - a[0]) * dx + (p[1] - a[1]) * dy) / l2));
  const projX = a[0] + t * dx;
  const projY = a[1] + t * dy;
  return Math.hypot(p[0] - projX, p[1] - projY);
}

/**
 * Calculate minimum distance from a point to any edge of the polygon.
 */
export function distanceToPolygonBoundary(point: Point2D, polygon: Point2D[]): number {
  if (!polygon || polygon.length < 2) return 0;
  let minDist = Infinity;
  const n = polygon.length;

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = polygon[i];
    const b = polygon[(i + 1) % n];
    const d = distancePointToSegment(point, a, b);
    if (d < minDist) minDist = d;
  }

  return minDist;
}

/**
 * Calculates a guaranteed interior representative label point for a room polygon.
 * Ensures the label anchor never falls outside or on a wall, even for L-shaped, U-shaped,
 * or non-convex irregular polygons.
 */
export function findInteriorLabelPoint(polygon: Point2D[]): Point2D {
  if (!polygon || polygon.length === 0) return [0, 0];
  if (polygon.length < 3) return polygon[0];

  // 1. Check arithmetic centroid first
  let sx = 0,
    sy = 0;
  for (const [x, y] of polygon) {
    sx += x;
    sy += y;
  }
  const centroid: Point2D = [sx / polygon.length, sy / polygon.length];

  // If centroid is well inside (clearance >= 0.45m), use it
  if (isPointInPolygon(centroid, polygon)) {
    const clearance = distanceToPolygonBoundary(centroid, polygon);
    if (clearance >= 0.45) {
      return centroid;
    }
  }

  // 2. Sample pole-of-inaccessibility across bounding box
  const bbox = getPolygonBoundingBox(polygon);
  const steps = 14;
  const stepX = bbox.width / steps;
  const stepY = bbox.height / steps;

  let bestPoint: Point2D = centroid;
  let maxClearance = -1;

  for (let ix = 1; ix < steps; ix++) {
    const cx = bbox.minX + ix * stepX;
    for (let iy = 1; iy < steps; iy++) {
      const cy = bbox.minY + iy * stepY;
      const candidate: Point2D = [cx, cy];

      if (isPointInPolygon(candidate, polygon)) {
        const dist = distanceToPolygonBoundary(candidate, polygon);
        if (dist > maxClearance) {
          maxClearance = dist;
          bestPoint = candidate;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return bestPoint;
}

export interface LabelStyleConfig {
  nameLines: string[];
  areaText: string;
  nameFontSize: number; // in meters (SVG units)
  areaFontSize: number; // in meters (SVG units)
  lineSpacing: number; // in meters
  isCompact: boolean;
  boxWidth: number;
  boxHeight: number;
}

/**
 * Wrap and adapt room labels based on available room dimensions and area.
 */
export function getAdaptiveLabelConfig(
  roomType: string,
  areaSqm: number,
  polygon: Point2D[]
): LabelStyleConfig {
  const bbox = getPolygonBoundingBox(polygon);
  const w = bbox.width;
  const h = bbox.height;
  const minDim = Math.min(w, h);

  // Normalize name
  const rawName = roomType.replace(/_/g, ' ').trim().toUpperCase();

  // Determine compact abbreviations for very small rooms
  let displayName = rawName;
  const isMicro = areaSqm < 4.0 || minDim < 1.4;
  const isSmall = areaSqm < 9.0 || minDim < 2.0;

  if (isMicro) {
    if (rawName.includes('BATH') || rawName.includes('TOILET')) displayName = 'BATH';
    else if (rawName.includes('POWDER')) displayName = 'POWDER';
    else if (rawName.includes('BED')) displayName = 'BED';
    else if (rawName.includes('KITCHEN')) displayName = 'KIT';
    else if (rawName.includes('LIVING')) displayName = 'LIVING';
    else if (rawName.includes('STORE')) displayName = 'STORE';
  } else if (isSmall) {
    if (rawName.includes('MASTER') && rawName.includes('BED')) displayName = 'M. BEDROOM';
  }

  // Word wrap based on available width
  const words = displayName.split(/\s+/);
  const nameLines: string[] = [];

  // Max characters per line based on width in meters
  // Assuming average char width is ~0.5 * font_size
  // If font size is ~0.25m, each char is ~0.13m
  const maxChars = Math.max(7, Math.floor((w * 0.8) / 0.18));

  if (words.length === 1 || displayName.length <= maxChars) {
    nameLines.push(displayName);
  } else {
    let curLine = '';
    for (const word of words) {
      if (!curLine) {
        curLine = word;
      } else if ((curLine + ' ' + word).length <= maxChars) {
        curLine += ' ' + word;
      } else {
        nameLines.push(curLine);
        curLine = word;
      }
    }
    if (curLine) nameLines.push(curLine);
  }

  // Compute adaptive font sizes in world meters for clean architectural drafting readability
  let nameFontSize = 0.48;
  let areaFontSize = 0.34;

  if (areaSqm >= 24 && minDim >= 3.0) {
    nameFontSize = 0.58;
    areaFontSize = 0.40;
  } else if (areaSqm >= 12 && minDim >= 2.2) {
    nameFontSize = 0.48;
    areaFontSize = 0.34;
  } else if (isSmall) {
    nameFontSize = 0.38;
    areaFontSize = 0.28;
  } else if (isMicro) {
    nameFontSize = 0.28;
    areaFontSize = 0.20;
  }

  // Safe clamping relative to available room dimensions
  nameFontSize = Math.min(nameFontSize, Math.max(0.22, minDim * 0.22));
  areaFontSize = Math.min(areaFontSize, nameFontSize * 0.72);

  const lineSpacing = nameFontSize * 1.28;
  const areaText = areaSqm > 0 ? `${areaSqm.toFixed(1)} m²` : '';

  const totalLines = nameLines.length + (areaText ? 1 : 0);
  const maxLineLen = Math.max(...nameLines.map((l) => l.length), areaText.length);
  const boxWidth = Math.min(w * 0.92, maxLineLen * (nameFontSize * 0.58) + nameFontSize * 0.6);
  const boxHeight = totalLines * lineSpacing + nameFontSize * 0.4;

  return {
    nameLines,
    areaText,
    nameFontSize: Math.round(nameFontSize * 100) / 100,
    areaFontSize: Math.round(areaFontSize * 100) / 100,
    lineSpacing: Math.round(lineSpacing * 100) / 100,
    isCompact: isMicro,
    boxWidth: Math.round(boxWidth * 100) / 100,
    boxHeight: Math.round(boxHeight * 100) / 100,
  };
}

/**
 * Authoritative Validation Status Helper (Phase 5).
 * Strictly distinguishes:
 * - VALID FLOOR PLAN
 * - VALID — REFINED
 * - PLAN COULD NOT BE VALIDATED
 * - REQUIREMENTS ARE INFEASIBLE
 */

export interface ValidationStatusDisplay {
  label: string;
  type: 'valid' | 'refined' | 'invalid' | 'infeasible';
  badgeClass: string;
}

export function getValidationDisplayStatus(
  validationReport?: { overall_valid?: boolean; total_errors?: number; results?: any[] } | null,
  refinementResult?: { iterations?: any[]; status?: string; total_iterations?: number } | null,
  projectStatus?: string
): ValidationStatusDisplay {
  const normStatus = (projectStatus || '').toLowerCase();
  const refStatus = (refinementResult?.status || '').toLowerCase();

  // 1. Infeasible
  if (
    normStatus === 'failed' ||
    refStatus === 'infeasible' ||
    refStatus === 'infeasible_under_constraints'
  ) {
    return {
      label: 'REQUIREMENTS ARE INFEASIBLE',
      type: 'infeasible',
      badgeClass: 'badge-danger',
    };
  }

  // 2. Error counts and validity
  const errorCount =
    validationReport?.total_errors ??
    validationReport?.results?.reduce(
      (acc: number, r: any) => acc + (r.issues?.filter((i: any) => i.severity === 'error').length || 0),
      0
    ) ??
    0;

  const isValid =
    (validationReport?.overall_valid ?? (errorCount === 0)) &&
    normStatus !== 'unresolved' &&
    normStatus !== 'failed';

  if (!isValid || errorCount > 0) {
    return {
      label: 'PLAN COULD NOT BE VALIDATED',
      type: 'invalid',
      badgeClass: 'badge-danger',
    };
  }

  // 3. Valid with refinement vs Valid initially
  const iterationCount =
    refinementResult?.total_iterations ??
    refinementResult?.iterations?.length ??
    0;

  const hadRefinementPass =
    iterationCount > 0 &&
    refStatus !== 'valid_on_initial_pass' &&
    refStatus !== 'no_refinement_required' &&
    refStatus !== 'no_change';

  if (hadRefinementPass) {
    return {
      label: 'VALID — REFINED',
      type: 'refined',
      badgeClass: 'badge-success',
    };
  }

  return {
    label: 'VALID FLOOR PLAN',
    type: 'valid',
    badgeClass: 'badge-success',
  };
}

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Comparative benchmark evaluation between Pipeline Mode and Agentic Mode across Phase 2 cases."""

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from app.evaluation.benchmark import BenchmarkRegistry
from app.orchestration.config import OrchestrationConfig
from app.orchestration.orchestrator import PlanForgeOrchestrator

TEST_CASES = [
    "case_01_small_single_floor",
    "case_04_two_floor_family",
    "case_06_irregular_l_plot",
    "case_15_feasibility_edge",
    "case_16_infeasible_deficit",
]


def run_comparison():
    orch = PlanForgeOrchestrator()
    out_dir = Path("results/phase3_comparison")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    results = {
        "pipeline_mode": {},
        "agentic_mode": {},
        "comparison_table": [],
    }

    for case_id in TEST_CASES:
        case = BenchmarkRegistry.get_case(case_id)
        if not case:
            continue

        print(f"Evaluating {case_id}...")

        # 1. Pipeline Mode
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_pipe = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="pipeline",
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_pipe" / case_id),
        )
        res_pipe = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_pipe)
        pipe_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0

        # 2. Agentic Mode
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_agent = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="agentic",
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_agent" / case_id),
        )
        res_agent = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_agent)
        agent_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0

        score_pipe = res_pipe.validation_report.overall_score if res_pipe.validation_report else 0.0
        score_agent = res_agent.validation_report.overall_score if res_agent.validation_report else 0.0

        row = {
            "case_id": case_id,
            "pipeline": {
                "status": res_pipe.status,
                "is_valid": res_pipe.is_valid,
                "score": round(score_pipe, 1),
                "duration_ms": round(pipe_ms, 1),
                "error": res_pipe.error_message,
            },
            "agentic": {
                "status": res_agent.status,
                "is_valid": res_agent.is_valid,
                "score": round(score_agent, 1),
                "duration_ms": round(agent_ms, 1),
                "decisions_count": len(res_agent.decisions or []),
                "error": res_agent.error_message,
                "infeasibility_evidence": (res_agent.agentic_state or {}).get("infeasibility_evidence", []),
            },
        }
        results["comparison_table"].append(row)

    with open(out_dir / "summary.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)

    print("\n=== PHASE 3 COMPARISON COMPLETE ===")
    for r in results["comparison_table"]:
        print(
            f"{r['case_id']:30} | "
            f"Pipe: {r['pipeline']['status']:7} ({r['pipeline']['score']:4.1f} score, {r['pipeline']['duration_ms']:5.1f}ms) | "
            f"Agent: {r['agentic']['status']:7} ({r['agentic']['score']:4.1f} score, {r['agentic']['duration_ms']:5.1f}ms, {r['agentic']['decisions_count']} dec)"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_comparison()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Three-way comparative evaluation across Phase 2 benchmark cases:
1. Original Pipeline Mode
2. Phase 3 Agentic Mode (Deterministic Policy)
3. Phase 4 Agentic Mode (Configured LLM Action Selector)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict

from app.evaluation.benchmark import BenchmarkRegistry
from app.orchestration.config import OrchestrationConfig
from app.orchestration.orchestrator import PlanForgeOrchestrator

TEST_CASES = [
    "case_01_small_single_floor",
    "case_04_two_floor_family",
    "case_06_irregular_l_plot",
    "case_15_feasibility_edge",
    "case_16_infeasible_deficit",
]


def evaluate_modes() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    orch = PlanForgeOrchestrator()
    out_dir = Path("results/phase4_evaluation")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    summary: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "evaluation_title": "Phase 4 Three-Way Mode Comparison",
        "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
        "cases_evaluated": TEST_CASES,
        "modes": ["pipeline", "agentic_deterministic", "agentic_llm"],
        "comparison_table": [],
    }

    for case_id in TEST_CASES:
        case = BenchmarkRegistry.get_case(case_id)
        if not case:
            continue

        print(f"Evaluating {case_id} across all 3 modes...")

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # 1. Pipeline Mode Baseline
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_pipe = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="pipeline",
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_pipe" / case_id),
        )
        res_pipe = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_pipe)
        pipe_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        val_pipe = res_pipe.validation_report

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # 2. Phase 3 Agentic Mode (Deterministic Policy: use_llm=False)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_det = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="agentic",
            use_llm=False,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_det" / case_id),
        )
        res_det = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_det)
        det_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        val_det = res_det.validation_report
        state_det = res_det.agentic_state or {}
        decisions_det = res_det.decisions or []

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # 3. Phase 4 Agentic Mode (LLM Action Selector: use_llm=True)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_llm = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="agentic",
            use_llm=True,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_llm" / case_id),
        )
        res_llm = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_llm)
        llm_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        val_llm = res_llm.validation_report
        state_llm = res_llm.agentic_state or {}
        decisions_llm = res_llm.decisions or []

        # Tally decision sources for LLM mode
        sources_count = {}
        for d in decisions_llm:
            src = d.get("source", "unknown")
            sources_count[src] = sources_count.get(src, 0) + 1

        budget_llm = state_llm.get("budget", {})

        row = {
            "case_id": case_id,
            "case_name": case.name,
            "pipeline": {
                "status": res_pipe.status,
                "is_valid": res_pipe.is_valid,
                "score": round(val_pipe.overall_score, 1) if val_pipe else 0.0,
                "hard_errors": val_pipe.total_errors if val_pipe else 0,
                "duration_ms": round(pipe_ms, 1),
                "error": res_pipe.error_message,
            },
            "agentic_deterministic": {
                "status": res_det.status,
                "is_valid": res_det.is_valid,
                "score": round(val_det.overall_score, 1) if val_det else 0.0,
                "hard_errors": val_det.total_errors if val_det else 0,
                "duration_ms": round(det_ms, 1),
                "decisions_count": len(decisions_det),
                "tool_calls_count": len(state_det.get("tool_calls", [])),
                "error": res_det.error_message,
                "infeasibility_evidence": state_det.get("infeasibility_evidence", []),
            },
            "agentic_llm": {
                "status": res_llm.status,
                "is_valid": res_llm.is_valid,
                "score": round(val_llm.overall_score, 1) if val_llm else 0.0,
                "hard_errors": val_llm.total_errors if val_llm else 0,
                "duration_ms": round(llm_ms, 1),
                "decisions_count": len(decisions_llm),
                "decision_sources": sources_count,
                "tool_calls_count": len(state_llm.get("tool_calls", [])),
                "llm_calls_count": budget_llm.get("llm_calls_used", 0),
                "fallback_count": sources_count.get("fallback", 0),
                "error": res_llm.error_message,
                "infeasibility_evidence": state_llm.get("infeasibility_evidence", []),
            },
        }
        summary["comparison_table"].append(row)

    summary_file = out_dir / "summary.json"
    with open(summary_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)

    print(f"\nSaved evaluation summary to: {summary_file}")
    print("\n" + "=" * 95)
    print(f"{'Case ID':30} | {'Pipeline':18} | {'Agentic Det':20} | {'Agentic LLM':20}")
    print("=" * 95)
    for r in summary["comparison_table"]:
        p_str = f"{r['pipeline']['status']} ({r['pipeline']['score']}pts)"
        d_str = f"{r['agentic_deterministic']['status']} ({r['agentic_deterministic']['score']}pts)"
        l_str = f"{r['agentic_llm']['status']} ({r['agentic_llm']['score']}pts)"
        print(f"{r['case_id']:30} | {p_str:18} | {d_str:20} | {l_str:20}")
    print("=" * 95)

    return summary


if __name__ == "__main__":
    evaluate_modes()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Phase 5 Comparative Evaluation across 5 benchmark cases:
1. Pipeline Baseline Mode
2. Phase 3 Agentic Mode (Deterministic Policy)
3. Phase 4 Agentic Mode (LLM Action Selector)
4. Phase 5 Adaptive Refinement & Replanning Mode

Outputs saved to results/phase5_evaluation/summary.json.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List

from app.evaluation.benchmark import BenchmarkRegistry
from app.orchestration.config import OrchestrationConfig
from app.orchestration.orchestrator import PlanForgeOrchestrator

TEST_CASES = [
    "case_01_small_single_floor",
    "case_04_two_floor_family",
    "case_06_irregular_l_plot",
    "case_15_feasibility_edge",
    "case_16_infeasible_deficit",
]


def evaluate_phase5() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    orch = PlanForgeOrchestrator()
    out_dir = Path("results/phase5_evaluation")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    summary: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "evaluation_title": "Phase 5 Adaptive Refinement and Strategic Replanning Comparison",
        "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
        "cases_evaluated": TEST_CASES,
        "modes": ["pipeline", "agentic_phase3_det", "agentic_phase4_llm", "agentic_phase5_adaptive"],
        "comparison_table": [],
    }

    for case_id in TEST_CASES:
        case = BenchmarkRegistry.get_case(case_id)
        if not case:
            continue

        print(f"Evaluating {case_id} across baseline and adaptive modes...")

        # 1. Pipeline Baseline Mode
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_pipe = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="pipeline",
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_pipe" / case_id),
        )
        res_pipe = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_pipe)
        pipe_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        val_pipe = res_pipe.validation_report

        # 2. Phase 3 Deterministic Agentic Mode
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_p3 = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="agentic",
            use_llm=False,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_p3" / case_id),
        )
        res_p3 = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_p3)
        p3_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        val_p3 = res_p3.validation_report

        # 3. Phase 4 LLM Agentic Mode
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_p4 = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="agentic",
            use_llm=True,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_p4" / case_id),
        )
        res_p4 = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_p4)
        p4_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        val_p4 = res_p4.validation_report

        # 4. Phase 5 Adaptive Refinement Mode (with Candidate Manager & Adaptive Replanning)
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        cfg_p5 = OrchestrationConfig(
            mode="agentic",
            use_llm=True,
            enable_refinement=True,
            max_refinement_iterations=5,
            enable_rendering=False,
            enable_exports=False,
            output_dir=str(out_dir / "raw_p5" / case_id),
        )
        res_p5 = orch.generate(raw_brief=case.brief, project_name=case.name, config=cfg_p5)
        p5_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        val_p5 = res_p5.validation_report
        state_p5 = res_p5.agentic_state or {}
        cand_history_p5 = state_p5.get("candidate_history", [])
        events_p5 = state_p5.get("events", [])

        # Candidate breakdown
        accepted_cands = sum(1 for c in cand_history_p5 if c.get("acceptance_decision") in ("accepted_best", "accepted_progress"))
        rejected_cands = sum(1 for c in cand_history_p5 if "rejected" in str(c.get("acceptance_decision", "")))
        regression_rejections = sum(1 for c in cand_history_p5 if c.get("acceptance_decision") == "rejected_regression")

        # Decision / replanning metrics
        strategy_changes = sum(1 for e in events_p5 if e.get("type") in ("strategy_updated", "replanning_initiated"))
        refinements_attempted = sum(1 for tc in state_p5.get("tool_calls", []) if tc.get("tool") == "refine_design")
        reallocations_attempted = sum(1 for tc in state_p5.get("tool_calls", []) if tc.get("tool") == "allocate_spatial_regions")
        llm_calls_used = state_p5.get("budget", {}).get("llm_calls_used", 0)
        tool_calls_used = state_p5.get("budget", {}).get("tool_calls_used", 0)

        # Infeasibility detection
        is_infeasible_expected = (case_id == "case_16_infeasible_deficit")
        is_infeasible_detected_p5 = (res_p5.status == "failed" and state_p5.get("run_status") == "infeasible")

        record = {
            "case_id": case_id,
            "case_name": case.name,
            "expected_infeasible": is_infeasible_expected,
            "pipeline": {
                "success": res_pipe.is_success,
                "valid": bool(val_pipe.overall_valid if val_pipe else False),
                "score": round(val_pipe.overall_score, 1) if val_pipe else None,
                "hard_errors": val_pipe.total_errors if val_pipe else 0,
                "warnings": val_pipe.total_warnings if val_pipe else 0,
                "duration_ms": round(pipe_ms, 1),
            },
            "phase3_det": {
                "success": res_p3.is_success,
                "valid": bool(val_p3.overall_valid if val_p3 else False),
                "score": round(val_p3.overall_score, 1) if val_p3 else None,
                "hard_errors": val_p3.total_errors if val_p3 else 0,
                "duration_ms": round(p3_ms, 1),
            },
            "phase4_llm": {
                "success": res_p4.is_success,
                "valid": bool(val_p4.overall_valid if val_p4 else False),
                "score": round(val_p4.overall_score, 1) if val_p4 else None,
                "hard_errors": val_p4.total_errors if val_p4 else 0,
                "duration_ms": round(p4_ms, 1),
            },
            "phase5_adaptive": {
                "success": res_p5.is_success,
                "valid": bool(val_p5.overall_valid if val_p5 else False),
                "score": round(val_p5.overall_score, 1) if val_p5 else None,
                "hard_errors": val_p5.total_errors if val_p5 else 0,
                "warnings": val_p5.total_warnings if val_p5 else 0,
                "duration_ms": round(p5_ms, 1),
                "infeasibility_correctly_handled": is_infeasible_detected_p5 if is_infeasible_expected else (res_p5.is_success),
                "total_candidates": len(cand_history_p5),
                "accepted_candidates": accepted_cands,
                "rejected_candidates": rejected_cands,
                "regression_rejections": regression_rejections,
                "refinements_attempted": refinements_attempted,
                "reallocations_attempted": reallocations_attempted,
                "strategy_changes": strategy_changes,
                "llm_calls_used": llm_calls_used,
                "tool_calls_used": tool_calls_used,
                "best_candidate_id": state_p5.get("best_candidate", {}).get("id") if state_p5.get("best_candidate") else None,
            },
        }
        summary["comparison_table"].append(record)
        print(f"  -> Pipeline: valid={record['pipeline']['valid']} (score={record['pipeline']['score']})")
        print(f"  -> Phase 4 LLM: valid={record['phase4_llm']['valid']} (score={record['phase4_llm']['score']})")
        print(f"  -> Phase 5 Adaptive: valid={record['phase5_adaptive']['valid']} (score={record['phase5_adaptive']['score']}, cands={len(cand_history_p5)}, reg_rej={regression_rejections})")

    with open(out_dir / "summary.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)

    print(f"\nPhase 5 evaluation completed. Results written to {out_dir / 'summary.json'}")
    return summary


if __name__ == "__main__":
    evaluate_phase5()
